Remote Windows Systems Engineer I needs 5+ years experience

Remote Windows Systems Engineer I requires:

- Locations: TN, GA, AL, MS, AR, NC, VA, MO

- COVID-19 vaccine mandate

- Five (5) or more years experience as a Windows Systems Engineer

- Experience with software packaging tools such as AdminStudio is required.

- Extensive experience with PowerShell and other software packaging and scripting tools is also desired.

- Experience building packages for InTune is also a plus.

- Extensive experience in the analysis and design of systems, as well as in troubleshooting and providing technical support for these systems. Skills/Certifications

- Appropriate technical certifications are a plus.

- ITL certification is a plus. SCRUM experience is also desired.

Windows Systems Engineer I duties:

  - Oversees the implementation of system upgrades and modifications, including planning, testing, scheduling and coordination.

  - Ensures that change management and defined security procedures for all assigned systems are executed in accordance with policies and procedures.

  - Minimizes service interruptions through early identification and resolution of problems. Analyzes monitoring and maintenance data and implements changes as required to achieve optimum performance. Makes recommendations for resources required to maintain and/or expand service levels.

  - Develops, maintains, and oversees a schedule of system backups and test restorations.

  - Ensures that the business recovery plan for assigned systems adequately addresses requirements and established time frames.

jobs.summary: Department Overview: Our Technology Infrastructure team operates globally and is responsible for every aspect of the firm's hybrid platform. This ranges from our EUC/Office environments to Trading and Core service Co-Location Data Centres, and extends to...
jobs.description:
Department Overview:

Our Technology Infrastructure team operates globally and is responsible for every aspect of the firm's hybrid platform. This ranges from our EUC/Office environments to Trading and Core service Co-Location Data Centres, and extends to Public Cloud, delivering top-tier technology services to a dynamic and demanding Trading organisation.

In addition to meeting the round-the-clock operational demands of the platforms, we continuously evolve and transform our platforms to maintain a competitive edge that our business requires. We innovate to provide valuable solutions and leverage our skilled Technology teams to deliver against rapidly changing business requirements.

 Role Overview:

As a member of our London-based Infrastructure and Platform Engineering team, this position supports our multi-tenant private and public cloud initiatives.

The role contributes to the delivery of services to our core business areas globally, including Trading, middle and back office, and Technology. The role requires an understanding of platforms including Windows, virtualisation and their associated technologies, delivered through on-premises, hosted and public cloud environments. It involves system integration, support and continuous improvement, with an emphasis on standardisation, repeatability, automation and orchestration.

The successful candidate will cover BAU rota activities alongside business project initiatives. We are looking for a proactive self-starter who can manage their workload, identify opportunities for improvement and work alongside senior engineers to develop their experience in solution design, scoping and architecture across our key technology platforms.

With the team’s broad technology remit, this role would suit someone early in their Windows platform engineering career who is keen to build their experience in a fast-paced environment and gain exposure to a wide range of technologies.

 Experience Required:

- A minimum of 5 years of industry experience. Prior experience in a similar role within a Financial institution will be advantageous.

- Comprehensive platform engineering and support experience biased towards the Microsoft server technology portfolio, including On-premise bare metal hardware deployments (preferably HPE), Advanced virtualisation design, architecture and support across VMware and Microsoft Hyper-V platforms, together with container technologies such as Kubernetes. This should also include enterprise integration experience with security, high availability, networking, load balancing aspects to deliver applications and infrastructure.

- Experience administering Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Entra ID, Teams and SharePoint Online.

- Experience and proficiency in translating requirements through to providing and supporting solutions and environments for both proprietary and commercial software

- Platform engineering and support experience with public cloud platforms, preferably with a major Hyperscaler like Microsoft Azure or AWS.

- Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code methodologies with On-Prem and Cloud IaaS, achieved through automation and orchestration of cross-platform services using tools such as Source Control, Ansible, Jenkins, Terraform and ServiceNow.

- Demonstrable scripting or programming skills in languages such as PowerShell, Python and familiarity with APIs and data structures in JSON/YAML or similar.

- Experience with GenAI technologies via Public Cloud, OpenAI, AWS, etc.

 About You:

The ideal candidate is analytical and methodical, with a proven track record in problem-solving, critical BAU, advanced engineering and technology service delivery in a high-pressure, time-sensitive environment.

You should be passionate about emerging technology trends, innovations and directions, and eager to suggest and implement new solutions to enhance our technology performance. You should also understand the need for rapid delivery while appreciating business risk and constraints to ensure adherence to service levels.

The candidate should have experience working both independently and as part of a diverse team, meeting both broad and specific project/BAU objectives. This role requires excellent organisational skills, open communication, and a collaborative approach.

Your commitment to continuous improvement should be evident, both in learning from others and sharing knowledge to enhance our team's capability and function.

 BlueCrest is committed to providing an inclusive environment for its workforce. As an employer, we provide equal opportunities to all people regardless of their gender, marital or civil partnership status, race, religion or ethnicity, disability, age, sexual orientation or nationality.

jobs.description:
In a nutshell

As our Digital Workspace Solutions Engineer, you are the architect and project driver of the digital tools and standards that power Picnic across the Netherlands, Germany, and France. Moving beyond daily ticket handling, you create and own the long-term roadmap, system standards, process automation, and vendor partnerships.

We are looking for a self-starting engineer who creates long-term vision, dares to decide and takes ownership of outcomes. An analytical fixer with strong IT engineering and project skills: someone who automates a repetitive task once rather than resolve it manually twenty times. You will bridge strategic vision with hands-on technical design to ensure a seamless, secure, and scalable digital architecture.

 Tricks of the Trade

 Standardization & Automation

-

 Design international standards: Define unified hardware portfolios, software authentication policies, and IT standards across all operating regions.

-

 System & access management : Monitor system performance, optimize software delivery, optimize Role-Based Access Controls (RBAC), and support Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) workflows.

-

 Automation: Identify manual bottlenecks, analyze incoming requests and ticket trends, drive Zero-Touch Enrollment (ZTE) setups, and build automations to reduce ticket volume.

 Project & Stakeholder Management

-

 Lead central projects: End-to-end ownership of complex IT projects such as ticket workflow design and zero-touch deployments.

-

 In-house expertise: Topic expert and lead on complex operational and technical challenges, direct support for the delivery team.

-

 Cross-Functional Alignment: Cooperate closely with Security, Tech, Delivery and operations teams to align operational need with DiWS strategy

 Commercial & Vendor Governance

-

 Vendor management: Own the licensing strategy and hardware lifecycle, manage relationships with key suppliers, lead contract negotiations and partner sourcing.

-

 Cost optimization : Drive continuous cost control across hardware and software budgets, identifying structural savings through vendor consolidation, license cleanups, and spend benchmarking.

 About you…

-

Bachelor’s degree (HBO/WO) in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience

-

3+ years working experience with a solid understanding of modern workplace management, IT operations, device management and systems architecture

-

Hands-on mastery of macOS, Windows, Google Workspace, Slack, Jira/Confluence, and MDM solutions (Intune, SOTI, or Workspace ONE)

-

Basic knowledge of scripting skills (E.g. Powershell, Python) and generative AI tools

-

Analytical mind with an architectural perspective and the assertiveness to challenge current setups and drive structural solutions

-

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills to roll out central projects internationally by taking full ownership of outcomes

-

Fluent in English

-

Working on-site from our Amsterdam office and willingness to occasionally travel internationally (Dusseldorf, Hamburg, Paris)

 Picnic Perks

 🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks

Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen and chefs. They prepare delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.

 🚵🏼Health insurance discount & bike plan

We have a partnership with CZ (a health insurance provider). Picnic employees get a discount on CZ insurance packages between 5% and 15%. Furthermore, through our partnership with Lease a Bike, you can rent-to-own a new (e)bike at a discounted rate

 ✍🏼Learning & development

You’ll get ample opportunity to work on yourself at Picnic. We offer personal development through Lepaya courses, Academy training, and more. Interested in improving your mental wellbeing? Through OpenUp you get free access to trained psychologists and many courses.

 All the rest

At Picnic you get 25 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. And your phone and laptop are on us, as well.

jobs.title: Senior Windows Engineer - Managed Services
jobs.summary: The Senior Windows Engineer - Managed Services provides senior-level operational support for Microsoft Windows environments across Managed Services customers. The Senior Windows Engineer - Managed Services provides senior-level operational support for...
jobs.description:
The Senior Windows Engineer - Managed Services provides senior-level operational support for Microsoft Windows environments across Managed Services customers.

The Senior Windows Engineer - Managed Services provides senior-level operational support for Microsoft Windows environments across Managed Services customers. The role is primarily focused on Windows engineering, ticket queue management, daily service monitoring, incident resolution, and break-fix support rather than solution design or architecture. This engineer serves as an escalation point for complex Windows issues, participates in an on-call rotation, and works across technologies and teams to understand the broader impact of changes and incidents. Success requires strong communication, sound technical judgment, and the ability to solve immediate problems while considering downstream effects across the customer environment.

What You Will Do

- Own and manage Windows engineering tickets and service requests through resolution, providing timely and accurate status updates.

- Monitor Windows services and infrastructure, respond to alerts, identify emerging issues, and take appropriate corrective action.

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex break-fix issues involving Windows Server and related enterprise services.

- Serve as a senior escalation point for incidents that require advanced Windows troubleshooting and problem-solving.

- Administer and support Windows Server environments, including physical, virtual, and cloud-hosted systems.

- Support Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, certificate services, authentication, and related Windows services.

- Use PowerShell and other tools to automate routine support, reporting, health-check, and remediation activities.

- Support patching, upgrades, configuration changes, lifecycle activities, and maintenance in accordance with change-management requirements.

- Assess the broader impact of incidents and technical changes across connected systems, customer teams, and other technology towers.

- Communicate clearly with customers and internal teams regarding issues, risks, dependencies, progress, and resolution.

- Document troubleshooting steps, resolutions, support procedures, knowledge articles, and operational standards.

- Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, security, networking, application, and service delivery teams in a multi-technology Managed Services environment.

- Mentor other engineers and share technical knowledge and operational best practices.

- Participate in a scheduled on-call rotation to support service availability outside standard business hours.

What We Expect of You

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field and at least 7 years of relevant infrastructure engineering experience, or equivalent professional experience.

- At least 5 years of experience administering and supporting Windows Server in enterprise environments.

- Strong experience troubleshooting Windows infrastructure incidents and resolving complex operational issues.

- Strong experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Windows security, certificates, and identity services.

- Experience creating PowerShell automation for operational support, reporting, health checks, and remediation.

- Experience with Windows virtualization, clustering, patching, configuration management, monitoring, backup, and recovery technologies.

- Experience working with ticketing systems, managing an engineering queue, and meeting service-level commitments.

- Experience supporting business-critical services within Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.

- Strong communication and customer-service skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Ability to evaluate problems from multiple perspectives, anticipate downstream impacts, identify affected stakeholders, and communicate proactively.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, document solutions clearly, and collaborate across technical teams.

- Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation.

- Experience supporting Windows environments in a Managed Services, multi-customer, or enterprise operations setting, is a plus.

- Experience with Microsoft Azure or hybrid Windows environments, is a plus.

- Experience with Hyper-V, Windows Server Failover Clustering, Microsoft Configuration Manager, Windows Server Update Services, Azure Update Manager, Microsoft Intune, or comparable tools, is a plus.

- Experience with Azure Arc, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, or System Center Operations Manager, is a plus.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Corporate Systems team runs the core collaboration platforms everyone here works in and builds the tooling and automation behind IT. That responsibility extends to the companies we acquire. Their people, devices, and systems have to come into Anthropic securely.

You'll own the IT side of Anthropic's acquisitions: due diligence, integration planning, and integration. Before close, you'll assess a company's IT environment and give the deal team a clear read on risk and effort. You'll define the technical integration plan and its requirements: what moves, where it lands, in what order, what has to be ready on day one, and how each security gap gets closed. After close, you'll carry out that plan and bring the company's people, devices, and systems onto our stack. This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll hold admin, write code, build automation, run the cutovers yourself and bring in other teams when the work calls for their expertise or support. You'll lead this work for IT Engineering and partner with Security, Corporate Development, Legal, People, and Finance at every stage.

M&A will be your primary focus and responsibility, but you'll be a full member of the Corporate Systems team; taking part in planning and reviews, using and contributing to the team’s tooling, and contributing to the roadmap. Early on, M&A will be most of your work, including using Claude to automate the repeatable parts of diligence and integration. As that automation matures, and when M&A load is light, you'll contribute to other parts of the team’s roadmap.

Responsibilities

- Lead technical IT due diligence: assess a company's identity, applications, endpoints, and infrastructure, and brief the deal team on risk and effort before close

- Find the gaps between an acquired environment and Anthropic's security model, rate them, and build the mitigations into the integration plan

- Define the technical integration plan and its requirements: what moves, where it lands, in what order, and what has to be ready on day one

- Run the integration: take over administration, migrate people, devices, and data, and retire what's no longer needed, with support from other IT Engineering teams as required.

- Work with Business Technology, Client Platform, Corporate Network, IT Operations, and Security on their parts of each integration

- Keep Corporate Development, Legal, People, Finance, and the acquired company's team clear on where IT stands

- Build a repeatable IT M&A playbook and automate as much of it as possible with Claude

- When M&A work is light, contribute to core Corporate Systems projects

You may be a good fit if you have

- 8+ years as a hands-on engineer in corporate IT. You have designed and shipped systems, carried out migrations or integrations yourself, and owned at least one area end-to-end, with experience supporting other areas: identity, applications, endpoints, or corporate infrastructure

- Experience administering enterprise identity and collaboration platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, and an SSO provider, and working code in Python or similar against their SaaS APIs

- Working knowledge of endpoint management and security concepts, enough to lead diligence on an unfamiliar fleet

- A proven ability to understand an unfamiliar IT environment quickly and deliver a prioritized view of risk to non-specialists

- A record of leading technical projects that span several teams and run to a fixed date, while doing much of the engineering yourself

- Comfort working autonomously, with ambiguity and confidential information

- Clear communication with executives, legal and corporate development teams, and engineers at acquired companies

Strong candidates may also have

- Prior M&A, carve-out, or company-to-company migration experience

- Experience across the full stack: endpoints, systems, applications, and infrastructure

- Hands-on experience managing a device fleet or running an MDM

- Experience working in or alongside a security team

- A record of building tooling that replaces manual IT work

- Using Claude or similar tools as a core part of how you work

Representative projects

- Assess an acquired company's IT environment that nobody here has seen and produce a prioritized integration plan within days

- Design a way to size integration effort and risk for a company of any shape or size

- Automate bringing acquired people and devices onto Anthropic's identity and device management

- Write the IT risk memo for a live deal and present it to Corporate Development and Security leadership

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

 $325,000 - $360,000 USD

 Logistics

 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

 How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

 Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Patch Management, Security and Compliance

- Administer WSUS and enterprise patch-management processes for Windows servers and endpoints, including testing, deployment rings, scheduling, maintenance windows, validation, exceptions, and remediation.

- Monitor endpoint health, patch status, configuration and security compliance, vulnerability remediation, and deployment success; maintain operational dashboards, compliance reporting, and audit evidence.

Operations and Collaboration

- Follow established Change Control procedures and participate in weekly Change Control meetings for endpoint, server, Microsoft 365, patching, configuration, and production changes.

- Participate in the Infrastructure Services Team on-call rotation supporting all Clarvida server environments, including incident response, troubleshooting, escalation, and service restoration.

- Maintain technical documentation, standards, procedures, and runbooks; collaborate with Systems Engineers and cross-functional IT teams to improve service reliability and operations.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

- 7+ years of hands-on experience supporting enterprise Windows Server and Microsoft infrastructure in a production environment.

- Experience with enterprise endpoint management using Microsoft Intune and SCCM/MECM, including device configuration, application deployment, compliance, patching, reporting, and troubleshooting; experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, Microsoft 365, WSUS, and PowerShell.

- Experience with IT service management/ticketing systems; ServiceNow or similar ITSM experience preferred. Healthcare and distributed support environment experience preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

-
Strong hands-on endpoint management and troubleshooting skills with Microsoft Intune and SCCM/MECM, including device enrollment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, application/software deployment, client health, inventory, reporting, and remediation.

-
Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Microsoft 365 administration, WSUS, virtualization, PowerShell, vulnerability remediation, and Microsoft infrastructure services.

-
Ability to manage production maintenance, incidents, Change Control, documentation, competing priorities, and effective collaboration across technical teams.

-
Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate or equivalent certification is preferred; other relevant Microsoft Windows Server, Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune/Endpoint Manager, virtualization, ITIL, or infrastructure certifications are a plus.

jobs.description:
**Vision RT** is a fast-growing MedTech company transforming radiation therapy for cancer patients by helping make it more accurate, effective, and comfortable. The company is the inventor of, and a market leader in, Surface Guided Radiation Therapy (SGRT). This technology uses advanced 3D cameras to track surface data, providing enhanced guidance across every step of the radiotherapy workflow.

Our systems are used in over 3,000 clinics worldwide, including in 29 of the top 30 Best Hospitals for Cancer (source: US News and World Report 2026 rankings).

The company is recognized as one of Britain’s fastest-growing private tech companies, as featured in the **2025 *Sunday Times 100 Tech***list. Vision RT is also a recipient of the 2026 King’s Award for Enterprise, our fifth in 10 years. It is the UK’s most prestigious accolade for business excellence.

[**Company video**](https://youtu.be/ci5BrRrp4h0 "https://youtu.be/ci5BrRrp4h0") (Available on application page)

With around 400+ employees globally and offices in the UK, Poland, and the USA, Vision RT operates independently as part of the Danish company William Demant Invest A/S, one of the world’s largest investors in healthcare companies. Employees benefit from the security and reach of being part of a large global enterprise, combined with the agility and innovation of a startup.

Vision RT is a company with strong values, a clear mission, and a bright future. It is an exciting and rewarding organization in which to work.

***This position requires extensive travel throughout the US, with travel expected to be up to 90% of working time. Scheduled non-travel periods will be incorporated to support administrative responsibilities, training, professional development, and other business needs. Candidates should be comfortable with frequent overnight travel and occasional weekend travel as required.***

***Base location: Washington DC***

***Region covered: All US***

**About the Role**

We have an exciting opportunity for a proactive and customer-focused Field Service Engineer to join our team.

As a Field Service Engineer, you will be responsible for installing, maintaining, and supporting Vision RT solutions across the US. You will provide both remote and on-site technical support to customers, ensuring systems are operating effectively and delivering an exceptional customer experience.

This role requires extensive travel throughout the assigned territory, with occasional support for other regions as required to provide business continuity and customer coverage.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Install, configure, commission, support, and maintain the Vision RT product portfolio at customer sites.
- Conduct site surveys to assess installation requirements and ensure readiness for system deployment.
- Deliver remote and on-site technical support, diagnosing and resolving software, hardware, operating system, and connectivity issues.
- Perform preventative maintenance, system upgrades, software updates, and product enhancements to maximise system performance and reliability.
- Configure and troubleshoot Microsoft Windows-based systems and associated devices.
- Troubleshoot network connectivity and communication issues, working closely with customer IT teams to resolve technical challenges.
- Maintain accurate service documentation, installation records, maintenance reports, and customer activity logs.
- Build strong relationships with customers by providing a professional, responsive, and customer-focused service experience.
- Travel throughout the assigned region to support installations, maintenance activities, training, and customer requests, with occasional travel to other regions as required.
- Perform physical installation activities including mounting wall monitors, routing communication cables over distances of up to 50 metres, and installing equipment in accordance with safety and quality standards.
- Work safely on ladders and alongside third-party contractors in active construction, hospital, and clinical environments while adhering to PPE and site safety requirements.
- Participate in work activities outside normal business hours, including evenings and occasional weekends, where required.
- Travel to customer sites at short notice when business or customer needs demand.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Windows operating systems, including:

- Windows configuration and system settings
- Device Manager and hardware management
- Disk and storage management
- BIOS and firmware configuration
- Windows services and security settings
- Event Viewer and system troubleshooting tools

- Experience diagnosing and resolving software, operating system, and hardware issues within a customer-facing environment.
- Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including:

- IP addressing and network configuration
- VLANs, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, and network security principles
- Common network protocols and ports
- Windows networking tools and command-line troubleshooting utilities

- Experience troubleshooting network connectivity issues using tools such as ping, tracert, ipconfig, and remote support applications.
- Understanding of cybersecurity best practices, endpoint protection, system hardening, and customer IT security requirements.
- Solid PC hardware knowledge, including:

- Component identification and replacement
- Peripheral device configuration and troubleshooting
- Hardware connectivity and performance considerations

- Experience delivering remote and on-site technical support.
- Strong problem-solving and fault-finding skills with a methodical and analytical approach.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a strong customer-service focus.
- Ability to work independently and effectively manage priorities across multiple customer locations.
- Ability to interpret technical documentation and follow established installation, maintenance, and service procedures.
- Proactive, results-oriented, and committed to delivering a high level of customer satisfaction.

**Desirable Skills & Experience**

- Experience supporting Microsoft Windows Server environments.
- Basic understanding of SQL databases and database connectivity.
- Familiarity with RAID technologies and storage systems.
- Experience working within healthcare technology, medical devices, radiotherapy, medical imaging, or other regulated technical environments.
- Relevant technical certifications such as CompTIA A+, Microsoft certifications, or equivalent industry-recognised qualifications.

Vision RT is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and development without regard to race, colour, religion, sexual orientation, gender, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AWS Windows Infrastructure Engineer based in the United States.**

The AWS Windows Infrastructure Engineer will play a key role in modernizing and securing Windows Server infrastructure within a federal AWS GovCloud environment. You will automate server configuration, deployment, hardening, and compliance to support the migration from Windows Server 2016 to Windows Server 2019 or 2025. Working closely with the Windows Architect, you will translate technical designs and security requirements into repeatable, automated infrastructure solutions. Your work will help improve consistency, operational efficiency, and security across multiple environment tiers. You will leverage AWS services, PowerShell, configuration management tools, and CI/CD pipelines to streamline infrastructure upgrades and ongoing operations. This fully remote, full-time opportunity is suited to an experienced infrastructure engineer comfortable working in regulated environments and supporting federal security requirements.

### Accountabilities

- **Windows Server automation and configuration:**

  - Automate Windows Server configuration, provisioning, deployment, and maintenance using Ansible, PowerShell, PowerShell Desired State Configuration (DSC), or comparable tools.
  - Update existing Windows Server 2016 configuration baselines to meet Windows Server 2019 or 2025 standards.
  - Identify and remediate configuration drift to ensure consistency across environments.
  - Develop and maintain reusable scripts and automation workflows that improve infrastructure reliability and repeatability.
  - **AWS infrastructure and image management:**

    - Build and maintain hardened Windows Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) for upgraded server environments.
    - Automate Amazon EC2 provisioning and related infrastructure configuration.
    - Use AWS services, including Systems Manager, VPC, and EBS snapshots, to support server deployment, administration, and recovery.
    - Apply infrastructure-as-code and image-building practices to standardize infrastructure delivery.
    - **Security hardening and compliance:**

      - Automate Windows operating system hardening and compliance validation against DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), CIS Benchmarks, Group Policy requirements, and applicable security baselines.
      - Identify and remediate security findings, vulnerabilities, and configuration weaknesses.
      - Support audit readiness and security compliance within a regulated federal environment.
      - Implement secure configuration practices aligned with established architectural and operational requirements.
      - **Server upgrades and migration execution:**

        - Execute Windows Server upgrades in planned phases, coordinating migration activities across environment tiers.
        - Perform pre-upgrade backups and snapshots, post-upgrade validation, and automated rollback procedures.
        - Help minimize service disruption and reduce migration risks through repeatable deployment and recovery processes.
        - Validate upgraded systems to confirm functionality, security, and operational readiness.
        - **Systems administration and operational automation:**

          - Automate patching, system inventory, and routine infrastructure tasks using AWS Systems Manager.
          - Automate certificate installation and renewal for Windows servers and associated services.
          - Support Windows Server administration, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, certificate management, and software patching.
          - Where applicable, support software deployments through Group Policy, Windows IIS configurations, and Power BI Gateway.
          - **DevSecOps integration and documentation:**

            - Integrate infrastructure automation into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins and GitHub.
            - Maintain version-controlled, peer-reviewed automation code and follow established development practices.
            - Collaborate within an Agile, DevSecOps environment to improve deployment quality and operational consistency.
            - Document configurations, automation workflows, and operational procedures in Confluence, and track activities and deliverables through Jira.
            - Work under the technical direction of the Windows Architect to implement infrastructure designs and meet project objectives.

            ### Requirements:

            - **Education and experience:** A bachelor's degree and at least five years of relevant experience are required. Candidates with an associate degree must have at least seven years of relevant experience, while candidates with a high school diploma must have at least nine years.
            - **Windows Server automation:** Hands-on experience automating Windows Server configuration and deployment with Ansible, PowerShell DSC, or similar configuration management tools.
            - **PowerShell expertise:** Advanced PowerShell scripting skills, including the ability to develop maintainable automation for infrastructure configuration, validation, and operational tasks.
            - **Migration experience:** Experience supporting Windows Server 2016 migrations or upgrades to Windows Server 2019 or 2025 in AWS environments.
            - **AWS knowledge:** Working knowledge of AWS services supporting Windows workloads, including EC2, AMIs, VPC, Systems Manager, and EBS snapshots.
            - **Windows administration:** Strong Windows Server administration skills, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, certificate management, and patching.
            - **Security and compliance:** Experience automating Windows operating system hardening and implementing security baselines. Experience in federal government or other regulated environments is preferred.
            - **Infrastructure as code and image building:** Experience with tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Packer, or EC2 Image Builder.
            - **CI/CD and version control:** Experience using Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines in an Agile or DevSecOps environment.
            - **Documentation and collaboration:** Ability to document technical solutions, maintain operational runbooks, collaborate with architects and engineering teams, and manage work through tools such as Jira and Confluence.
            - **Security clearance eligibility:** Must be eligible to obtain a Public Trust clearance.
            - **Work schedule:** Ability to work 40 hours per week and maintain availability during core business hours, from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time.

            **Preferred qualifications:**

            - Microsoft Windows Server certification, such as Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Administrator Associate, or an AWS certification, such as AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate.
            - Experience integrating Windows servers with CyberArk for privileged access management.
            - Experience managing software deployments through Group Policy.
            - Experience configuring and maintaining Windows IIS servers and Power BI Gateway.
            - Experience supporting federal government systems, particularly in audit readiness, vulnerability management, and security compliance.

            ### Benefits:

            - **Employment type:** Full-time, W-2 employment.
            - **Remote work:** 100% remote position for candidates based in the United States.
            - **Working hours:** 40 hours per week, with availability required during core business hours of 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time.
            - **Federal technology experience:** Opportunity to contribute to Windows Server modernization and infrastructure security within an AWS GovCloud environment.
            - **Technical development:** Hands-on work with AWS infrastructure, Windows Server automation, infrastructure as code, security hardening, and DevSecOps practices.
            - **Security and compliance exposure:** Opportunity to strengthen expertise in federal security baselines, vulnerability remediation, and regulated infrastructure environments.
            - **Compensation and additional benefits:** A specific salary range, healthcare coverage, paid time off, retirement benefits, and other employee perks were not specified in the provided job description.

jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Apex Fintech Solutions (Apex) powers innovation and the future of digital wealth management by building tech-forward solutions that help simplify, automate, and facilitate access to financial markets for all. Our robust suite of fintech software enables us to support clients such as Stash, Betterment, SoFi, Webull, and eToro, amongst many others; collectively, Apex powers access to the stock market for over 22+ million end customers.

 At Apex, we are changing how the securities industry operates by reinventing the status quo, which was manual, slow, and accessible only by the ultra-wealthy. We're digitizing and democratizing systems so that everyone has an opportunity to invest.

When you're at Apex, you drive this change. You're part of a global team with a clear vision: to be the trusted technology that powers the digital economy. Our offices in Austin, Dallas, Chicago, New York, Portland, Belfast, and Manila are home to over 1,000 employees.

Together, we’re shaping the future of financial innovation. Embrace change. Solve big. Win together. And be G.R.E.A.T. — grit, results, empathy, accountability, and teamwork — with Apex.

We’re proud to be recognized for the innovative work we do, the purpose-driven nature of our work, and the collaborative culture we’ve created. Here are just a few of the many awards we’ve recently received:

**Best Places to Work**

2026, 2025, 2024, 2023 - Presented by BuiltIn

**WealthTech of the Year**

2025 - Presented by US FinTech Awards

**The World’s Top 250 Fintech Companies**

2024 - Presented by CNBC

**ABOUT THIS ROLE**

# About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Endpoint Engineer to own and evolve how our Windows and Mac devices are enrolled, configured, secured, patched, and retired. You'll be the technical lead for Microsoft Intune on Windows, Jamf Pro or Kandji with Apple Business Manager on macOS, and Entra ID Conditional Access or Okta to tie device trust to access.

This role is for someone who treats device management as software engineering. Every policy, profile, and script is written as code, reviewed in Git, rolled out in stages, and reversible. You'll bring new ideas, integrate our MDM, identity, and cloud systems, and replace manual work with automation.

# What You'll Do

**Lead endpoint platform engineering**

- Own Intune end to end: compliance, configuration profiles, Autopilot, app deployment, Scope Tags, and RBAC.

- Manage the Apple lifecycle through Jamf Pro or Kandji and Apple Business Manager, including zero-touch enrollment and app deployment.

- Design and enforce Conditional Access (Entra ID) and Okta device-trust policies with security and identity teams.

**Ship policy as code**

- Ship MDM policy as code across macOS and Windows through a GitOps model (Terraform, Ansible, IntuneCD, or similar), with CI/CD, peer review, staged rollouts, and rollback.

- Own managed browser and extension policy, keeping the control plane auditable.

**Automate and integrate**

- Build integrations and automation across Intune, Jamf/Kandji, Entra ID, and cloud platforms using PowerShell, Python, Microsoft Graph, and services such as Azure Automation, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, or AWS Lambda.

- Automate patching and third-party app updates to close exposure windows without disrupting employees.

- Build dashboards, drift alerts, and AI-assisted automation from fleet telemetry to cut toil.

**Secure and harden**

- Package and deploy apps (Win32, MSI, PKG/DMG) with detection, dependency, and rollback planning.

- Partner with Information Security to remediate vulnerabilities and harden endpoints against CIS Benchmarks, mapped to NIST controls.

**Lead and innovate**

- Serve as the escalation point for complex endpoint incidents, driving root-cause analysis and long-term fixes.

- Set technical standards, document architecture decisions, and mentor engineers.

- Evaluate new tools and apply AI to real operational problems to improve security, reliability, and user experience.

# What We're Looking For

**Required**

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or related technical discipline (or equivalent work experience) required.

- 6+ years in endpoint or systems engineering, with hands-on administration of both Microsoft Intune and an Apple MDM (Jamf Pro or Kandji).

- Deep Intune expertise: compliance, configuration profiles, Autopilot, app protection, Scope Tags, and custom RBAC roles.

- Strong Jamf Pro or Kandji experience: policies/Blueprints, configuration profiles, and zero-touch enrollment.

- Apple Business Manager experience (automated enrollment, VPP, MDM server integration).

- Proven policy-as-code and GitOps experience: infrastructure as code (Terraform modules and remote state, Bicep, Ansible, or CloudFormation) and CI pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar) with code review.

- Strong automation background: PowerShell and Python, plus the Microsoft Graph API.

- Strong Azure experience, including automation and integrations built on services such as Azure Automation, Logic Apps, and Azure Functions.

- Entra ID administration (dynamic groups, app registrations, hybrid identity) and Conditional Access design in production. Okta experience a plus.

- Vulnerability management and patching experience (Defender Vulnerability Management, Rapid7, Qualys, Patch My PC, Winget, or similar) and app packaging experience (PSADT, IntuneWin, PKG).

- Solid grounding in Windows and macOS architecture, Kerberos, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, and certificate-based auth (SCEP/PKCS).

- Strong documentation and communication skills, including the ability to explain tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Nice to Have**

- AWS experience, including automation and integrations built on services such as Lambda, Step Functions, and EventBridge.

- Experience using AI in production to solve operational problems.

- Experience applying CIS Benchmarks and NIST frameworks (such as 800-53 or CSF) to endpoint compliance baselines.

- Microsoft certifications (MD-102, SC-300, AZ-104, or AZ-500), Apple certifications, or cloud certifications (AWS, Azure).

- ServiceNow or similar ITSM experience.

**Work Environment**

- This job operates in a hybrid office environment three days per week.

​*Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.*

**Our Rewards**

We offer a robust package of employee perks and benefits, including healthcare benefits (medical, dental and vision, EAP), competitive PTO, 401k match, parental leave, and HSA contribution match. We also provide our employees with a paid subscription to the Calm app and offer generous external learning and tuition reimbursement benefits. At AFS, we offer a hybrid work schedule for most roles that allows employees to have the flexibility of working from home and one of our primary offices.

Our hiring practices ensure that all qualified applicants receive fair consideration without regard to these characteristics.

Apex Fintech Solutions is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace for all candidates, including those with disabilities. If you require reasonable accommodations to participate in the application or interview process, please submit your request via the [Candidate Accommodation Requests Form](https://forms.monday.com/forms/b649c248edd0e959d5dedf5614bb5793?r=use1). With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

MITRE Mission Computing is a new organization that bridges the gap between Mission and Technology and helps enable MTIRE projects to focus on their work, without worrying about compliance and the underlying platform infrastructure. We apply new technologies that can address the Government's most challenging Systems Engineering problems. This is an opportunity for experienced platform engineers who are highly motivated, innovative, and proactive and interested in owning and maintaining their work to enable the rest of MITRE and sponsors.

We are seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to join a **secure, compliant enterprise platform team**, delivering infrastructure for mission-critical workloads.

jobs.description:
## **Description de l'entreprise**

**Êtes-vous prêt à bâtir l’avenir du retail****?**

Vusion est une entreprise de retail tech en forte croissance. Implanté dans 19 pays sur 3 continents, nous sommes leader mondial des solutions de digitalisation du commerce physique fondées sur l’intelligence artificielles.

Nous inventons des technologies qui créent un impact positif sur la société en permettant un commerce durable et centré sur l’humain.

Ensemble, nous développons des solutions avant-gardistes, formons des partenariats durables avec nos clients et réinventons les magasins de demain grâce à nos solutions IoT et data.

Nous croyons que l’entrepreneuriat est une vocation, et que notre esprit de start-up nourrira votre ambition.

Plus d'informations sur notre entreprise et nos solutions.

## **Description du poste**

**Nous construisons. Nous créons un impact positif.**

Vous serez en charge de l'environnement informatique utilisé au quotidien par les collaborateurs de Vusion à l'international (Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Intune, Jamf, Windows et Mac).

Vous accompagnez l'équipe Digital Workplace, assurerez la fiabilité des outils et superviserez la résolution des incidents techniques complexes.

Vous conduirez également les projets d'amélioration et de modernisation des outils pour simplifier le travail des collaborateurs et améliorer leur expérience numérique.

Rattaché(e) à la DSI Groupe, vous pilotez l’équipe en charge de l’environnement de travail numérique et garantissez la performance et l’évolution des solutions mises à disposition des collaborateurs (outils collaboratifs, workplace, mobilité, intranet/portails, adoption).

**Stratégie et feuille de route Digital Workplace :**

- Construire la feuille de route (upgrades, migrations, modernisation, nouveaux services).
- Définir la vision de l’Expérience Employé : simplicité, efficacité, cohérence des outils.
- Gérer la priorisation avec les parties prenantes métiers, l’IT, la cybersécurité et le management.

**Run / Fiabilité des services :**

- Garantir la disponibilité et la performance des services : gestion des incidents majeurs, des problèmes et des processus de changement.
- Superviser le support de niveau 2/3 (ou coordonner avec les équipes support), analyser les incidents récurrents et piloter l’amélioration continue du service.
- Gérer les versions, les correctifs, la compatibilité et la standardisation

**Adoption, communication et conduite du changement :**

- Définir et déployer une stratégie d’adoption (formations, support utilisateurs, réseau de champions, guides).
- Mesurer l’usage et l’impact (taux d’adoption, satisfaction, ROI).
- Animer la communauté interne et promouvoir les bonnes pratiques.

**Budget, gestion des fournisseurs et amélioration continue :**

- **Piloter le budget** (licences, services, équipements), optimiser les coûts et la valeur.
- Mettre en place des tableaux de bord KPI/OKR et piloter les initiatives d’amélioration continue.

## **Qualifications**

**Qualifications recherchées**

- **Expérience significative (5 ans et plus)** en **Digital Workplace** / **End User Computing**
- La maîtrise de **l'anglais** est indispensable (B2-C2)
- Expertise solide des environnements Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Entra ID, Power Platform).
- Maîtrise des solutions MDM/UEM : Microsoft Intune et Jamf Pro pour la gestion du cycle de vie des équipements, les politiques de conformité et le déploiement applicatif.
- Bonne connaissance des environnements **Windows et macOS** : déploiement des OS, configuration, résolution d’incidents et support aux utilisateurs sur les deux plateformes.

## **Informations complémentaires**

**Nous innovons. Nous accélérons. Nous forgeons nos carrières.**

Notre mission consiste à faire du magasin physique un véritable atout digital.

Nous sommes des entrepreneurs en quête d’innovation, nos équipes sont internationales et curieuses du monde qui nous entoure.
La diversité culturelle est inscrite dans notre ADN. C’est une force unique qui nous permet de travailler ensemble pour servir nos clients partout dans le monde.

La croissance de notre Groupe est un véritable catalyseur pour votre développement de carrière. Votre évolution sera rapide et vous aurez toute latitude pour façonner votre propre avenir, en France comme à l’international.

Vous êtes la clé de notre succès : des talents agiles, innovants, passionnés, et qui n’ont pas peur de prendre des risques, d’échouer et d’apprendre de leurs erreurs. Quel que soit votre rôle chez Vusion, vous contribuerez à réinventer et réimaginer le commerce de demain.

**Ce n’est pas tout à fait le poste de vos rêves ?**

*Partagez cette offre ou recherchez une autre opportunité parmi toutes les offres d’emploi sur* *vusion.com/careers/*

**Job Title: Desktop Engineer – Level 2**

**Location:** 1 Centre Street, New York, NY 10007
**Work Arrangement:** Onsite
**Duration:** Approximately 2 Months
**Work Schedule:** 35 Hours per Week
**Pay Rate:** $30 per Hour

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a skilled **Desktop Engineer – Level 2** to provide desktop support, workstation deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting services. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience supporting Windows-based environments, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and modern device management tools.

The candidate will be responsible for deploying and maintaining desktop equipment, resolving technical issues, managing device configurations, and maintaining IT documentation in accordance with established security policies and configuration standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Deploy, configure, maintain, and support desktop computers, laptops, and peripherals.
- Install and configure operating systems, business applications, device drivers, and software updates.
- Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network connectivity, and end-user technical issues.
- Perform workstation imaging, device provisioning, system reconfiguration, and equipment deployment.
- Provide technical support for Microsoft Windows, Microsoft 365, and Active Directory environments.
- Manage device enrollment, configuration, and deployment using tools such as Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot.
- Provide onsite and remote technical support to end users, ensuring timely issue resolution.
- Document incidents, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and equipment inventory accurately.
- Follow IT security policies, access controls, device configuration standards, and established procedures.
- Review, maintain, and update official IT documentation related to security policies and procedures.
- Ensure desktop systems and devices comply with organizational IT standards and security requirements.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

- Hands-on experience in desktop support, desktop engineering, or end-user computing support.
- Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows operating systems, hardware, software, and network connectivity.
- Experience with Microsoft 365 and Active Directory.
- Familiarity with desktop imaging, workstation deployment, and device provisioning.
- Experience with Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot for device enrollment and configuration.
- Strong incident documentation, problem-solving, and communication skills.
- Ability to work independently and provide effective onsite technical support.

**Work Environment**

This is an onsite assignment in New York, NY, expected to last approximately two months. The selected candidate will provide Level 2 desktop engineering and end-user support for 35 hours per week.

**Note:** The assignment duration is approximate and may depend on project requirements.

jobs.description:
**MANTECH** seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented **Endpoint Security System Administrator** to join our team in **Doral, FL**.

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

- Installing, configuring, maintaining, and administering Enterprise Security System (ESS/HBSS) modules and endpoint security capabilities.
- Managing endpoint policy enforcement, agent deployments, vulnerability scanning, and security baseline compliance across enterprise systems.
- Conducting routine system troubleshooting, event monitoring, threat detection, and incident response coordination.
- Maintaining system baselines, agent software repositories, and configuration management controls for security tools.
- Collaborating with cross-functional technical teams, systems administrators, and cybersecurity leadership to optimize network defense.
- Performing security updates, system patches, engine upgrades, and baseline verification across physical and virtual assets.
- Recommending and implementing continuous process improvements to streamline ESS management and operational security.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field with 5+ years of experience in systems or security administration.
  - OR a master’s degree and 3+ or more years of relevant experience
  - OR an associate’s degree and 7+ or more years of relevant experience
  - OR a high school diploma and 9+ or more years of relevant experience
- Proven experience administering Trellix/McAfee Enterprise Security System (ESS/HBSS) policies, modules, and ePolicy Orchestrator (ePO).
- Strong background in endpoint protection, host intrusion prevention, rogue system detection, and security compliance auditing.
- Experience maintaining baseline configurations, patch management schedules, and security event logs.
- Experience creating, maintaining, and communicating complex technical documentation and security administration workflows.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Relevant professional certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Trellix/HBSS Advanced Administrator, or CISSP.
- Prior experience supporting U.S. Military Command operations or Department of Defense enterprise technical environments.
- Familiarity with DoD STIG implementation, vulnerability management tools (e.g., ACAS), and automated compliance reporting.
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across multi-disciplinary engineering teams in dynamic operational settings.

**Clearance Requirements:**

- Must hold a current/active top secret security clearance.

**Physical Requirements:**

- Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50%.
- Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.
- Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

Our team of strategists, designers, technologists, and engineers partners with the world’s most innovative enterprises and admired brands to deliver real business results through the transformative power of AI. As part of our AI-First strategy, we empower every employee to build AI fluency and actively engage with AI tools to drive innovation and efficiency. We break boundaries, obsess over outcomes, and shape the future for our clients. Join a company where bold ideas and brilliant minds converge to redefine what’s possible - while building a career filled with growth, balance, and purpose.

Perficient currently has a career opportunity for a **MDM Engineer - Customer** to join our team located in the United States. This role is primarily office-based at a local Perficient location, with travel and on-site client engagements expected as needed. Candidates located in one of these metro areas can be considered: Chicago, IL, Detroit, MI, Houston, TX, Austin, TX, Dallas, TX, Charlotte, NC, and Atlanta, GA.

The Solutions Architect is expected to be knowledgeable in two or more technologies within the Data & Analytics domain. The Solutions Architect may or may not have a programming background, but will have expert infrastructure architecture, client presales / presentation, team management and thought leadership skills.

You will provide best-fit architectural solutions for one or more projects; you will assist in defining scope and sizing of work; and anchor Proof of Concept developments. You will provide solution architecture for business problems, perform platform integration with third party services, and design and develop complex features for clients' business needs.

You will collaborate with some of the best talent in the industry to create and implement innovative high quality solutions, participate in Sales and various pursuits focused on our clients' business needs. You will also contribute in a variety of roles in thought leadership, mentorship, systems analysis, architecture, design, configuration, testing, debugging, and documentation. You will challenge your leading edge solutions, consultative and business skills through the diversity of work in multiple industry domains.

- Strong experience with data modeling in various industries
- Expertise in at least two hyperscaler technologies – AWS, Azure, GCP
- Familiarity in cloud-based data warehouse and/or lakehouse technology platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks etc.
- Ability to communicate complex solutions to technical and non-technical users at various levels – typically department directors to C-Suite
- Experience with both on-premises and cloud technologies and platforms
- Expertise architecting solutions with multiple disciplines – performance, scalability, security

- Ability to create strong presentations using various tools

The Desktop Engineering System Administrator 1, with a team, assists to help support and maintain the Enterprise Mobile Device Management (MDM) environment for the LSU A&M campus. Responsibilities include managing existing application deployments, thin imaging, department on boarding and driver support for both on-premises and cloud based endpoints.

The position also assists with the operation, configuration, and maintenance of departmental servers, including Active Directory, Group Policy, certificate management, as well as file and print services. An intermediate understanding of Windows Server 2019 and higher is required.

Experience with VMware 8.x, Hyper-V, Veeam, and PowerShell without the assistance of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is preferred.

Utilize Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) to design, build, and maintain custom operating system images for deployment via PXE boot. Collaborate with campus departments to ensure images meet the needs of lab, department, and base system configurations across the university.

Develop and manage application deployments that support LSU academic departments, faculty, and staff, including software used in campus computer labs. (20%)

Responsible for the deployment, configuration, and management of Microsoft Intune and related Mobile Device Management (MDM) technologies such as Apple School Manager. Ensures secure, compliant, and efficient management of enterprise endpoints across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android platforms.

Routinely collaborates with ITS Security, Network and Server Infrastructure, and Desktop Support teams to implement and maintain endpoint standards, enforce security policies, and support overall IT operations to allow for end user productivity. (20%)

Collaborate with technical assets to support the student Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) environment using Windows 365, ensuring 24/7 operational availability. Additionally, this would also include the management of VDI pools, imaging, application deployment, and licensing. (15%)

Ensures reliable, secure, and efficient printing operations across the organization through the maintenance of print servers, queues, drivers, and print management solutions. Assisting with the Print Desk and Copier Management when needed. (10%)

Assist in the maintenance and administration of the enterprise wide infrastructure, and escalate system anomalies to senior staff for analysis and resolution. Collaborate with the ITS Security team to deploy, manage, and maintain enterprise software and tools that support IT risk mitigation strategies. (10%)

Collaborate with staff and management to develop training materials, customer documentation, and deployment management standards. Create and maintain support articles and process documentation. (10%)

Provide Tier 3 support to desktop support analysts, ensuring consistent adoption and compliance with UECM standards across all departments. (10%)

Other duties as assigned. (5%)

Bachelor's degree with 1 year of experience. jobs.description:
Cognizant is seeking a Systems Engineer in Mountain View for a full-time opportunity. This role will work from the office 5 days a week.

The Systems Engineer will be the primary handler of Level 2 and Level 3 escalations, working closely with technology service owners to resolve complex issues, drive root cause analysis, and improve the reliability of our endpoint and infrastructure environment. This role requires engineering-level thinking — diagnosing, documenting, and systematically eliminating recurring problems while owning the employee experience across our core technology stack.

Responsibilities:

**Endpoint & Device Management**

- Own macOS endpoint management — enrolment, configuration profiles, patch management, and policy enforcement via MDM (JAMF or equivalent)
- Troubleshoot and resolve advanced macOS issues; maintain endpoint compliance posture with the security team.

**Identity & Access Management**

- Administer and troubleshoot Okta — SSO, MFA policies, application assignments, and lifecycle management.
- Handle escalated access issues; support and maintain Active Directory accounts, group policies, and Ous.

**Network & Connectivity**

- Troubleshoot VPN connectivity via Global Protect and Zscaler ZPA/ZIA; apply networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VLANs, firewall rules) to resolve connectivity issues.
- Collaborate with network and security teams on escalated cases requiring deeper infrastructure context.

**Collaboration & Productivity Tools**

- Serve as escalation point for Microsoft 365 — Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and licensing.
- Manage and troubleshoot Zoom Rooms, Zoom Phone, and video conferencing hardware.

**Security & Compliance**

- Apply endpoint security principles — EDR tooling, patch compliance, and security policy enforcement.
- Support security-related incidents; follow and help maintain IT security standards and audit requirements.

**Escalation Handling & Collaboration**

- Bridge Level 1 service desk and technology service owners; manage complex cross-platform tickets end-to-end.
- Document solutions, create runbooks, and contribute to the knowledge base to reduce repeat escalations.

Qualifications:

- 5 plus years of Okta experience.
- 7 to 9 years of experience with MDM tools.
- 7 plus years of experience with Active Directory, M365 and Remote Desktop tools.

The salary range for this role is between $80,000 and $105,000 depending on the skills and qualifications of the candidate. Applications will be accepted till 10/22/2026.

jobs.description:
Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,500 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 25+ million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

#LI-Hybrid

We are looking for an Endpoint Security Engineer to own the security of Nexthink’s corporate endpoint estate: roughly 1,200 devices (550 macOS, 650 Windows) managed through Microsoft Intune and Jamf. You will turn endpoint security from a set of point controls into a measurable, continuously improving program covering what runs on our devices, how quickly we patch them, and how we prove it to auditors.

This is a hands-on role at a pivotal moment, as we build out a dedicated security function. Your first priorities include application baselines and allowlisting, a formal application lifecycle from approval to removal, and stronger vulnerability and compliance posture across both platforms. As a company that sells digital employee experience, we expect security that protects people without getting in their way.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Endpoint Hardening**

- Define and maintain security baselines for macOS and Windows (CIS or equivalent), delivered through Intune and Jamf.
- Own hardening standards: disk encryption, firewall, local admin removal and privilege management.
- Evaluate endpoint security tooling and steer vendors while keeping internal ownership of design.

**Application Control & Software Governance**

- Design and roll out application allowlisting using MDM-native capabilities and/or tools such as Santa, with developer-friendly exception models for Engineering and Product.
- Build and maintain the software and binary inventory: discover, classify and risk-rate applications, and define baselines from the results.
- Run remediation campaigns for unauthorized or high-risk software, from communication to uninstallation and verification.
- Operate the application lifecycle process end to end: request, security review, deployment, monitoring and retirement.

**Vulnerability & Patch Management**

- Own endpoint vulnerability management: scanning, risk-based prioritization and remediation tracking against SLAs.
- Define patching and update rings for OS and third-party applications with EUC across macOS and Windows.
- Drive remediation of critical and zero-day vulnerabilities and report on exposure and performance to Security leadership.

**Zero Trust & Data Protection**

- Partner with IAM and Security to enforce device compliance and device trust in Conditional Access.
- Support endpoint data protection controls (e.g. Microsoft Purview DLP, USB and removable media controls) and hardware-backed authentication such as passkeys and security keys.

**Compliance & Reporting**

- Document endpoint controls and maintain automated evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2 and ITGC audits.
- Turn security posture into clear metrics for IT leadership, Security and Finance.

**Automation & Digital Employee Experience**

- Automate security operations with PowerShell, Python, shell scripting, Microsoft Graph and the Jamf and Intune APIs.
- Use Nexthink’s own DEX platform to measure endpoint health and the employee impact of security changes, and build self-service remediation to reduce tickets.

**Primary Metrics**

- Device compliance and security baseline adherence (macOS and Windows)
- Mean time to remediate critical and high vulnerabilities, against SLA
- Patch and OS currency against SLAs
- Application control coverage and share of unclassified binaries
- Unauthorized or high-risk application count, and time to remediate
- Standing local admin count
- Endpoint-related audit findings and evidence automation coverage
- Employee experience impact of security controls (Nexthink DEX score)

- 5+ years in endpoint security, security engineering, or end-user computing with a strong security focus.
- Hands-on experience securing macOS and Windows at scale with Microsoft Intune and Jamf (or equivalent).
- Practical experience with vulnerability management tooling, prioritization and remediation workflows.
- Experience with application control and allowlisting (MDM-native controls, Santa, AppLocker, WDAC or similar).
- Strong knowledge of OS security and hardening frameworks (CIS, NIST, Apple platform security).
- Good understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access and Zero Trust applied to devices.
- Scripting skills in PowerShell, Python or Bash; familiarity with REST APIs and Microsoft Graph.
- Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2 or ITGC controls and audit evidence.
- Ability to work with Engineering and Product teams and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders. Fluent English; Spanish is a plus.
- Nice to have: DEX tools experience, Microsoft Purview, or certifications (e.g. MD-102, SC-300, Jamf Certified, GIAC, CISSP, Security+).

***Please apply with a copy of your CV in English.***

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:

- 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
- 📍 Amazing centrally located offices near the Bernabeu Stadium.
- 🩺 Private Health Insurance (Sanitas) and daily meal vouchers of 11 EUR .
- 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work.
- 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 23 days of holidays we offer) plus 3 company-paid volunteer days.
- 🤸 Up to 25 EUR per month for a gym subscription.
- 🛴 Flexible compensation plan for childcare & public transportation.
- 🧑‍🏫 Reimbursement of up to 50% of the cost of English & Spanish classes.
- 🍉 Fresh fruit, cookies, and soft drinks in the office.
- 🍕 Regular company and team events like Pizza talks, Team Building activities, Christmas parties, hosting Meetups at the office and more!
- 📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.
