They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities.

We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients' needs and exceeding their expectations. Join FactSet's Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure team as the Lead Infrastructure Operations Engineer, the senior technical owner of infrastructure operations at our Virginia data center.

You will combine hands-on engineering, project oversight, vendor and stakeholder management, and mentorship to keep the facility and its supporting infrastructure reliable, scalable, and cost-effective. As a key member of our collaborative team, you will be the point of contact between the data center, partner departments, and director-level stakeholders.

You will help ensure that the tools and processes behind our infrastructure keep improving. What You'll Do: 6+ Serve as the senior technical owner of infrastructure operations at the Virginia data center. Lead the enhancement of infrastructure software and hardware tooling to improve deployment, connectivity, and the user experience. Provide project management and technical oversight for large-scale technology rollouts and facility buildouts. Drive continuous improvement in infrastructure design, with a focus on autonomy and scalability. Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve complex production issues, and act as the escalation point for infrastructure support. Partner with director-level stakeholders and other departments to align goals and integrate tools, systems, and projects. Manage contractor and vendor relationships to deliver regionalized services and contracts that are cost-conscious and beneficial to end users. Champion best practices, coach and mentor engineers, and foster technical excellence across the team. Monitor capacity across our infrastructure in the datacenter. What We're Looking For: Significant experience in data center or enterprise infrastructure operations, including hardware, networking, and systems support, with a record of increasing responsibility. Bachelor degree in computer science or related. Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and rollouts from planning through delivery. Experience with alerting, monitoring, and incident management in a production environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including with director-level and cross-departmental audiences. Experience coaching and mentoring engineers. Nice to Have: Experience negotiating and managing vendor and contractor relationships, particularly with telecoms. Experience with hybrid (on-premises and cloud) infrastructure environments. Scripting or automation skills used to improve operational tooling and deployment. Experience with facility buildouts, colocation, or regional service and contract management. Experience managing assets with ITSM and DCIM tooling. Company Overview:FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better.

Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn. At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective.

jobs.description:
WELLTOWER – REIMAGINE REAL ESTATE WITH US

At Welltower, we’re transforming how the world thinks about senior living and wellness-focused real estate. As a global leader in residential wellness and healthcare infrastructure, we create vibrant, purpose-driven communities where housing, healthcare, and hospitality converge. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and endlessly ambitious—guided by our mantra: The only easy day was yesterday.

We’re looking for bold, independent thinkers who thrive on challenge, embrace complexity, and are driven to deliver long-term value. Every team member is empowered to think like an owner, innovate fearlessly, and lead from where they stand. If you're passionate about outcomes and inspired by the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare infrastructure, we want you on our best-in-class team.

About The Role

Welltower is seeking a Digital Workplace Engineer with deep specialization in Microsoft Intune and modern endpoint management. This role supports the design, implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of Welltower’s digital workplace ecosystem, with a primary focus on endpoint management, device security, application delivery, and user experience across Microsoft 365. The engineer will partner closely with Security, Identity, Service Desk, Infrastructure, and business teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable workplace technology services.

Key Responsibilities

Digital Workplace Engineering & Platform Ownership

Engineer and support modern digital workplace capabilities across Microsoft 365 and endpoint services. Maintain standards, configurations, documentation, and lifecycle practices for workplace technology platforms. Contribute to digital workplace roadmap execution with a focus on secure, reliable, and user-friendly experiences.

Microsoft Intune & Endpoint Specialization

Lead Microsoft Intune design, implementation, governance, and operational management across Windows, iOS, and Android. Design and enforce device compliance policies, endpoint security baselines, configuration profiles, and enrollment strategies. Implement and optimize Windows Autopilot provisioning, device enrollment, zero-touch deployment, and device lifecycle processes.

Application, Patch & Configuration Management

Package, deploy, and maintain Win32, Microsoft Store, and mobile applications through Intune. Support software update rings, feature update policies, driver/firmware strategies, and patch compliance reporting. Troubleshoot application deployment failures, policy conflicts, and configuration drift to improve reliability and user adoption.

Endpoint Security, Access & Compliance

Partner with Security and Identity teams to align endpoint posture with Zero Trust principles and Conditional Access requirements. Support Microsoft Defender for Endpoint integration, endpoint security policy deployment, attack surface reduction settings, and device risk remediation. Manage BYOD strategies including Mobile Application Management, app protection policies, and data protection controls.

Operational Support & Service Excellence

Provide Tier 2/3 escalation support for endpoint, application, compliance, and digital workplace service issues. Monitor endpoint health, compliance, deployment status, and service performance trends. Identify recurring issues and lead corrective actions, knowledge documentation, and service improvement initiatives.

Automation, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Develop automation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, and Intune reporting capabilities. Create operational reporting for device posture, application deployment, compliance, and remediation progress. Continuously improve endpoint performance, service reliability, and the employee technology experience.

Collaboration & Governance

Collaborate with Security, Identity, Service Desk, Infrastructure, Procurement, and business stakeholders. Participate in governance processes including change management, standards development, operational readiness, and documentation. Provide guidance and enablement to support teams for endpoint and digital workplace processes.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of this employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

TRAVEL

Minimal travel

Minimum Requirements

5+ years of experience in digital workplace, endpoint engineering, systems administration, or Microsoft 365 operations. Required specialization in Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager, including Autopilot, enrollment, compliance, configuration profiles, and endpoint security baselines. Strong experience with Windows endpoint management, application packaging/deployment, update management, and troubleshooting endpoint policy behavior. Experience integrating or operating Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and endpoint security controls in a modern workplace environment. Working knowledge of Conditional Access, Entra ID concepts, Zero Trust principles, and cloud-first workplace architecture. jobs.description:
Job Description

 Who We Are

HIKE2 is an advisory and innovation partner helping organizations design and build what’s next.

We work with complex and regulated industries, including law firms, financial services, insurance, professional services, and high-growth SaaS companies, to modernize operating models and embed data, automation, and AI into the core of how work gets done.

Our clients aren’t just upgrading technology. They are rethinking workflows, activating governed AI, and designing environments where humans and intelligent systems work side by side.

We believe meaningful transformation happens when strategy, data, design, and engineering move together. Siloed initiatives don’t scale. Real progress requires clarity of vision, strong data foundations, responsible governance, and disciplined execution.

Our teams bring deep industry expertise, human-centered design, and advanced data and cloud capabilities to architect secure, scalable solutions built for real-world complexity. From modern data platforms to AI-enabled workflows and enterprise automation, we help organizations move from experimentation to measurable impact.

We thrive in change and move from blank slate to working systems. We care deeply about outcomes, trust, and building long-term partnerships.

We don’t just implement technology. We help design the future of work.

 The Role

HIKE2 is hiring a senior Master Data Management Engineer for its data and integration practice. You will architect and build resolved identity and relationship foundations for financial services clients.

 Own the end-to-end MDM and relationship-graph architecture on an engagement, from data modeling through integration, data quality, and governance. Design and configure match and merge logic, survivorship and trust rules, validation rules, and golden-record management. Build entity resolution, the golden record, and the graph, along with the pipelines that feed them and syndicate trusted master data back to consuming systems. Establish the data-quality baseline and the survivorship and stewardship operating model, including steward workflows and issue queues. Define the identity seam between the client identity platform and the MDM layer, turning an authenticated claim into a resolved party. Set engineering standards, document a repeatable delivery approach, and mentor and grow a small team. Collaborate with data governance, CRM and source-system owners, and business stakeholders, and translate complex MDM concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Job Requirements

The following is the depth we expect. A strong candidate is hands-on across most of these areas, not familiar with them in theory.

 Identity resolution and matching

 Design and implement deterministic and probabilistic match logic, configuring match rules, thresholds, and trust scoring, and tuning them over time to balance false merges against missed matches. Weight strong identifiers such as tax ID and date of birth above shared attributes like name and address, and handle nicknames, transliteration, and address standardization. Build and maintain crosswalks between each source system's local key and the canonical party identifier.

 Golden record and survivorship

 Design golden, or best, record construction with attribute-level survivorship and trust rules that define which source wins per attribute and why, with full lineage. Implement merge, unmerge, split handling, and manage record consolidation safely in production. Establish validation rules and the golden-record lifecycle: create, update, retire.

 Party and relationship data modeling

 Model the party domain across person, legal entity, household, and account, with relationships, hierarchies, crosswalks, and reference data. Design the relationship graph ontology: households, beneficial ownership (UBO) chains, advisor-to-client, entity-to-account, collateral, and exposure, with effective dating so relationships are time-valid. Define measurable data-quality metrics and the minimum required attributes for each domain.

 Data quality and stewardship

 Build automated data profiling and a measured baseline for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and duplication. Implement data-quality rules, validation logic, and exception handling, and design steward workflows, issue queues, and dashboards that make stewardship efficient. Partner with governance to define master data policies, standards, and the stewardship operating model, and maintain data dictionaries per domain.

 Integration and pipelines

 Design inbound and outbound integration patterns to ingest source data and syndicate trusted master data back to operational, analytical, and reporting systems. Build ingestion and integration jobs, implement change data capture, and stand-up real-time resolve-and-lookup services with acceptable latency. Consume an authenticated claim from the identity platform and translate it to a resolved party identifier through the orchestration and integration layer.

 Cloud data platform

 Build on a modern cloud data stack, Azure preferred, using the medallion or lakehouse pattern across bronze, silver, and gold. Manage multiple environments (development, test, QA, production) with performance tuning, monitoring, and cost awareness.

 Graph engineering

 Implement the relationship graph on a property-graph store (Neo4j with Cypher, or Cosmos DB with Gremlin), keyed strictly on the canonical party identifier. Build graph queries and traversals for multi-hop questions such as UBO chains and advisor-to-borrower authorization, returning explainable, evidenced assertions with effective dates.

 Programming and platforms

 Strong SQL and proficiency in Python, with Java or .Net as needed to extend MDM platforms and build services. Hands-on with at least one enterprise MDM platform (Informatica MDM, Reltio, Semarchy, Ataccama, or Profisee) and the judgment to weigh build-lite on the existing stack against a packaged product. Comfortable with data governance and quality tool (for example Ab Initio or Collibra) and with workflow tooling.

 Security, governance, and regulatory

 Build for audit and regulatory review: full lineage, decision logs, and traceable survivorship. Apply KYC, AML, and beneficial ownership requirements under the Bank Secrecy Act and USA PATRIOT Act, and handle PII, tokenization, and access controls appropriately. Desired ExperienceTen to fifteen years in enterprise data engineering and architecture, with master data management delivered in production, not just designed. Demonstrated ability to both architect and build, having designed the system and then implemented it, not a design-only background. Financial services required, private and commercial banking strongly preferred, where a client is at once a person, an entity, a household member, and a borrower, and where party is a regulated, first-class concept. Proven physical MDM design with a party model, and experience resolving duplicated or unresolved entities upstream in identity. Familiarity with enterprise identity platforms, including Ping, and how digital identity binds to data identity. Experience building for audit in a regulated industry, having survived a real audit or examination. AI-assisted MDM: intelligent match scoring, automated survivorship suggestions, and anomaly flagging, kept governed, auditable, and validated before promotion to master. Experience with the systems common to banking estates: core banking (for example Fiserv), CRM (for example Salesforce), loan origination and servicing (for example Broadridge), and client due diligence (for example Fenergo). A track record of mentoring or leading a small engineering team, and consulting or client-facing delivery experience. Exposure to externalized authorization or relationship-based access control, where the graph supplies context and a decision point applies policy.

 Certifications

Certifications are preferred, not mandatory. We value demonstrated, hands-on delivery above any credential, and a candidate certified on one platform who can clearly reason across others is stronger than one certification alone. A current certification in one or more of the following is a plus.

 MDM platforms

 Informatica: Professional or Practitioner certification in MDM, MDM SaaS or Cloud, or Informatica Data Quality (IDQ), and related Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) credentials. Reltio Certified Professional, for the Reltio Connected Data Platform. Semarchy xDM certification (Discovery or Practitioner). Ataccama ONE certification. Profisee certification, particularly for teams on the Microsoft and Azure stack.

 Cloud, data platform, and graph

 Microsoft Azure: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert, given our Azure-preferred stack. Databricks or Snowflake certification where the client stacks calls for it. Neo4j Certified Professional, or an equivalent graph credential, for the relationship graph work.

 Governance and adjacent

 Data governance or quality credentials such as Collibra Ranger, or the DAMA CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional). A recognized cloud security or privacy certification is a plus given the regulated setting.

The salary range for this position is: $125,000-$175,000+k/annually. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. This range is exclusive of any bonuses or commissions. As an innovation consultancy, we recognize that talent is not always related to job history and skills come from valuable experiences that aren’t always shown on a resume. jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Description

At Senra Systems, we believe that the future of manufacturing lies not in automation, but in configuration.

We supercharge electrical wire harness manufacturing through software configuration, transforming skilled assembly tasks into high-throughput production lines. We enable customers to design what they want, when they want it and deliver harness builds at record-breaking speed.

What You'll Do

 Manage day-to-day IT operations across our Redondo Beach and Cypress facilities, including hardware, software, networking, identity, endpoints, and user lifecycle management. Administer and maintain Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Windows/macOS endpoints, servers, cloud infrastructure, and core business applications. Support production-floor technology and troubleshoot systems that directly impact manufacturing operations, minimizing downtime and escalating issues appropriately. Own and maintain the corporate and production printing environment, including standard office printers and specialized label/production printing systems such as Zebra, Brady, and Brother, including connectivity, drivers, print services, configuration, and troubleshooting. Manage and support conference room and audiovisual technology, including Microsoft Teams Rooms, displays, cameras, microphones, room resource accounts, and related meeting-room equipment. Support wired and wireless network infrastructure across both facilities, including switches, wireless access points, VLANs, DHCP/DNS, VPN connectivity, firewalls, and network-connected production devices. Provision, configure, deploy, and maintain laptops, desktops, tablets, mobile devices, kiosks, and shared/production workstations. Set up and support new hires with appropriate equipment, Microsoft 365 licensing, security controls, application access, and access to internal manufacturing systems. Administer identity and access controls, including account provisioning/deprovisioning, MFA, groups, permissions, service accounts, and shared/resource accounts. Monitor system, network, and endpoint health and proactively identify issues before they impact office or manufacturing operations. Maintain endpoint security, patching, backups, disaster recovery, and system configuration standards. Support IT and cybersecurity compliance requirements, including CMMC and NIST SP 800-171, through implementation, documentation, evidence collection, access controls, configuration management, and remediation activities. Maintain accurate documentation of infrastructure, configurations, assets, procedures, troubleshooting steps, and IT policies. Manage IT vendors and service providers and assist with hardware/software procurement, licensing, renewals, and lifecycle management. Provide hands-on technical support across departments and skill levels — from executives and engineers to manufacturing and production technicians. Travel regularly between Senra's Redondo Beach and Cypress facilities to provide onsite support and maintain consistent IT standards across both locations. Take ownership of technical issues from identification through resolution, coordinating with internal teams, vendors, MSPs, and other partners when necessary.

What We're Looking For

3+ years of experience in systems administration, IT infrastructure, or a similar hands-on technical role. Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals, including DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, firewalls, switching, and wireless networking. Hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Windows, and macOS environments. Experience with identity and access management, endpoint management, security controls, and user lifecycle administration. Experience supporting printers, production/label printing systems, audiovisual equipment, conference rooms, kiosks, and other network-connected devices. Comfortable supporting both corporate users and manufacturing/production -floor technology where system availability directly impacts operations. Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to independently diagnose issues across endpoints, applications, identity, networking, and peripherals. Excellent communication skills and the ability to support everyone from executives and engineers to production technicians. Comfortable operating with significant autonomy, taking ownership of issues end-to-end, and building scalable processes in a fast-growing environment. Ability to regularly travel between our Redondo Beach and Cypress facilities.

Nice to Have

 Experience supporting IT in aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or another regulated environment. Familiarity with CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, or similar cybersecurity and compliance frameworks. Experience with AWS or other cloud infrastructure. Experience supporting specialized manufacturing systems, production equipment, or operational technology.

 Compensation:

 Compensation will be based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors. Salary Range: $90,000-$120,000 This is an onsite position requiring regular presence at both our Redondo Beach, CA and Cypress, CA locations.

 Benefits:

 Unmatched opportunities to drive impact on a friendly and mission-driven team Own a piece of the pie with equity participation! Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and long-term disability coverage Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Dependent Spending Account (DSA) for health-related expenses 20 vacation days per year and 12 company holidays for rest and relaxation a 401(k) plan to set yourself up for retirement Choose a record you love, and we'll add it to our growing vinyl collection! $50/month DoorDash credit – lunch is on us! Up to $100/month reimbursement for gym memberships Fully stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages Regular team-building events, lunches, and the occasional breakfast burrito! Bright, open office with communal spaces for collaboration and free parking Conveniently located near the metro, major freeways and local dining spots

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Contact us at jobs@senrasystems.us or visit our website .

jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do.

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

 Job Details

Position Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Endpoint Engineer to join our team. This role is primarily focused on Active Directory, Group Policy Management, and Intune policies as they relate to endpoints and users. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of designing, implementing, and optimizing endpoint engineering solutions in large-scale environments while ensuring seamless integration with organizational goals and user productivity. This position requires a proactive, self-motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced, global environment, managing multiple responsibilities, projects, and demands across various time zones with minimal oversight.

Key Responsibilities

 Active Directory, Group Policy Management, and Intune Policy Engineering

- Design, implement, and manage Active Directory and Group Policies to support endpoint and user requirements across a global organization.

- Develop, implement, and optimize Intune policies tailored to endpoint and user management, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and compliance standards.

- Lead the transition of on-premises policies to cloud-based solutions, including Microsoft Intune , preparing for future migration to Microsoft Entra .

- Harmonize business requirements from application owners with endpoint policies to balance usability and security while maintaining operational excellence.

- Ensure endpoint policies are scalable and adaptable to meet the needs of a large, global organization with tens of thousands of users and endpoints.

Endpoint Engineering and Platform Management

- Manage and optimize management platforms, including but not limited to: Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM)Microsoft IntuneJamf (macOS management) NinjaOne (remote monitoring and management)

- Leverage Microsoft cloud-native technologies , including Microsoft Graph API , to streamline and automate endpoint management tasks.

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex endpoint engineering issues across multiple platforms and operating systems, including Windows, macOS, and mobile devices.

- Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in endpoint engineering to continuously improve the organization’s endpoint strategy.

Collaboration and Cross-Functional Support

- Collaborate with infrastructure teams, application owners, and business stakeholders to implement endpoint solutions that meet organizational needs.

- Represent the user experience in cross-domain discussions, advocating for end-user productivity and minimizing disruption during policy changes.

- Work closely with security teams to address ad-hoc requests, ensuring endpoint solutions align with security goals while prioritizing usability.

- Act as a liaison between infrastructure and security teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment on endpoint-related initiatives.

Security and Hardening Support

- Field security-related requests and collaborate with security teams to ensure endpoint policies adhere to CIS (Center for Internet Security) Levels 1 & 2 benchmarks.

- Provide guidance on endpoint hardening practices, ensuring systems are secure, resilient, and compliant while prioritizing the user experience.

- Participate in security meetings as needed, offering technical expertise and insights into endpoint engineering strategies.

Leadership and Communication

- Act as a subject matter expert (SME) in Active Directory , Group Policy , and Intune policies , providing mentorship and guidance to junior engineers.

- Translate technical concepts into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment across various levels of the organization.

- Drive strategic initiatives related to endpoint management, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and priorities.

Required Qualifications

- 20+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, with a primary focus on Active Directory , Group Policy Management , and Intune policies as they relate to endpoints and users.

- Proven expertise in managing endpoint platforms such as MECM, Intune, Jamf, NinjaOne, and other similar tools.

- Demonstrated ability to transition on-premises policies to cloud-based solutions, particularly Intune, and prepare for Microsoft Entra migrations.

- Experience with Microsoft cloud-native technologies , including Microsoft Graph API , Azure Active Directory , and related tools for endpoint management and automation.

- Exceptional troubleshooting skills across endpoint engineering platforms, operating systems, and user domains.

- Experience navigating large global organizations with tens of thousands of users and endpoints, including integrated and non-integrated entities.

-
 Self-starter with a proactive mindset , capable of managing multiple responsibilities, projects, and demands in a highly dynamic global environment across multiple time zones.

- Ability to work independently with minimal oversight, driving initiatives forward while maintaining accountability and focus.

- Strong collaboration skills to engage effectively across domains and organizational levels, ensuring alignment between infrastructure, security, and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in enterprise-scale environments with complex endpoint requirements.

- Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect, or similar.

- Strong familiarity with Microsoft Entra and its integration into endpoint and identity management strategies.

Key Competencies

-
 Technical Expertise : Deep understanding of Active Directory , Group Policy , Intune policies , and endpoint engineering platforms.

-
 Self-Motivation and Independence : Ability to work autonomously, managing competing priorities and navigating complex global environments with confidence and efficiency.

-
 User-Centric Approach : Ability to prioritize user experience and productivity in policy design and implementation.

-
 Problem-Solving : Proficiency in identifying and resolving complex endpoint engineering issues.

-
 Collaboration : Strong ability to work across teams and domains, fostering partnerships between infrastructure, security, and business units.

-
 Communication : Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts and advocate for user experience in cross-functional discussions.

   What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. jobs.description:
### About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

### **About the Role**

We’re hiring an IT Systems Engineer to help build, secure, and improve the systems our employees rely on every day, with a particular focus on identity and access management (IAM) and mobile device management (MDM).

You’ll share ownership with our IT and Security engineers to improve how we manage identities, application access, and devices. This is a hands-on role that combines technical configuration, security judgment, and automation. We’re looking for someone who uses AI effectively to troubleshoot, build, and improve IT workflows. Experience managing IT systems as code using Terraform is a strong plus.

This role requires in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday from one of our offices (SF, NY, or ATX). For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

### **What You Will Do**

- Configure and improve Okta, including application integrations, single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), groups, access policies, and automated provisioning.
- Build reliable onboarding, role-change, and offboarding workflows that keep employee access appropriate and up to date.
- Configure and maintain MDM solutions, including device enrollment, configuration profiles, software deployment, patching, encryption, and compliance controls.
- Partner with Security to define and implement least-privilege access, device security standards, access reviews, and device-based access policies.
- Design and maintain scripts, API integrations, and automation across Okta, MDM, Google Workspace, Slack, and IT service management systems.
- Help expand management of IT systems through code, including opportunities to use Terraform for Okta configuration and other supported resources.
- Use AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, and workflow improvements while validating outputs and protecting company data.
- Serve as an escalation point for complex identity, device, and systems issues; address root causes and prevent recurring problems.
- Support AWS identity and access configurations as part of the broader IT environment.
- Maintain clear documentation for configurations, access policies, integrations, and operational procedures.
- Identify opportunities to simplify the IT environment, reduce technical debt, and improve SaaS lifecycle processes.

### **About You**

- Strong hands-on IT systems engineering experience, with deep expertise in either IAM or MDM and solid working knowledge of the other.
- Experience administering Okta and integrating applications using technologies such as SAML, OIDC, and SCIM.
- Experience configuring and operating an MDM platform such as Jamf, Kandji/Iru, Intune, or an equivalent.
- Strong understanding of security principles, including least privilege, authentication and authorization, endpoint hardening, and secure handling of credentials and company data.
- Proficiency with scripting languages such as Python or Bash, APIs, and workflow automation tools.
- Demonstrated experience using AI to solve technical problems and improve IT operations, with the judgment to review generated code and validate proposed changes.
- Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to follow problems across identity, devices, applications, and integrations.
- Comfortable sharing ownership, collaborating with Security and other teams, and explaining technical decisions clearly.
- Able to take projects from identifying a problem through implementation, documentation, and ongoing maintenance.

### **A Strong Plus**

- Experience using Terraform to manage Okta or other IT systems as code, including version-controlled configurations, code review, repeatable deployments, and configuration drift management.

### **Success in This Role Looks Like**

- More reliable identity lifecycle workflows, with timely provisioning, access changes, and deprovisioning.
- Better device enrollment, patching, and compliance through consistent MDM configurations and automation.
- Clearer access policies and repeatable access reviews developed in partnership with Security.
- Less manual work through maintainable automation and effective use of AI.
- More consistent, reviewable system configurations through expanded use of code where appropriate.
- Fewer recurring identity and device issues through root-cause fixes.
- Reliable documentation that helps the team operate, troubleshoot, and improve shared systems.

### **Benefits**

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
- Generous paid time off and parental leave
- Professional development stipend
- Daily lunch and commuter benefits (SF office)

### Compensation & Benefits:

- Competitive compensation package, including equity.
- Inclusive Healthcare Package.
- Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
- Flexible Time Off.
- We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $180,000.00 - $288,000.00. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

### **Disclosures:**

- **Privacy:** Please review our [Job Applicant Privacy Policy](https://vercel.com/legal/job-applicant-privacy-notice) for more information on how we handle your data.
- **Equal Opportunity:** Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 IT INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEER, VIRTUALIZATION & STORAGE

 As an IT Infrastructure Engineer on the infrastructure team, you will collaborate with internal teams to deliver innovative solutions for SpaceX’s growing infrastructure demands. You will ensure quality and reliability of systems across the software lifecycle while scaling and supporting data center infrastructure, virtualization, Kubernetes, and storage environments. You should have strong opinions on designing, testing, and operating virtualization platforms and multi-tier storage (enterprise + HPC) and be ready to build the next generation of SpaceX data center platforms.

 RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Implement and maintain a scalable, robust VMware environment and identify efficiencies supporting critical applications

- Design, implement, and maintain storage infrastructure across high-performance, capacity, archive, backup/recovery, and disaster recovery tiers

- Architect and operate high-throughput, low-latency storage and support exabyte scale file systems (e.g., VAST,) for simulation, telemetry, and high-concurrency workloads

- Administer enterprise storage platforms (NetApp, Pure FlashArray/FlashBlade, Cohesity, Scality) and manage access controls, permissions, and protocols (NFS, CIFS/SMB, iSCSI)

- Perform data center deployments, monitor performance, and troubleshoot production issues across virtualization, storage, transport (RDMA), and protocol layers

- Develop automation/tooling for monitoring, capacity planning, configuration management, and alerting; define standards for deployment and performance tuning

- Collaborate with compute, networking, and application teams to align virtualization and storage strategies with workload requirements

- Participate in on-call rotation, scheduled maintenance, and occasional physical installation support

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, engineering or related technical field and 3+ years of engineering experience in an enterprise environment; OR 5+ years of engineering experience in lieu of a degree

- 1+ years of professional experience managing virtualized server environments

- 5+ years of experience in IT storage engineering with enterprise platforms (NetApp, Pure Storage, Scality, Vast or similar)

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Experience with full lifecycle management of large-scale VMware environments and supporting container infrastructure with Kubernetes

- Experience with data center infrastructure management (DCIM) tools

- Deep knowledge of RDMA, congestion control, lossless Ethernet, RoCEv2, and/or InfiniBand storage fabrics in HPC or latency-sensitive environments

- Experience automating infrastructure with Python, PowerShell, or Ansible

- Familiarity with HPC schedulers (Slurm, LFS) and how storage tiers interact with job scheduling

- Linux and Windows OS system administration experience

jobs.description:
### **About Anthropic**

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

### About the role

The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) treats Anthropic's device fleet as a platform we build and run. We run our own MDM as a production service and manage every piece of device configuration as code. Policies, configuration profiles, queries, remediation scripts, and software all ship through pull requests, CI, a staging environment, and a canary group before they reach the fleet. The fleet is mostly macOS, plus a small number of Linux machines and a growing mobile footprint.

You'll own that platform end to end: the infrastructure underneath the MDM, the configuration on top of it, the patching and software pipelines that keep thousands of devices patched and secure, and the telemetry that tells us what is actually true on every device. You'll also build automation that cuts down on manual operational work. You'll work with Security teams on hardening, compliance controls, and detection and response, and with developer and infrastructure teams to make sure those controls don't get in the way of their work. Your work will let us base access decisions on whether a device can be trusted.

We value people who double check a compliance report before they believe it. The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You'll help define the endpoint roadmap, make architecture decisions, and own the platform every Anthropic employee's work runs on. You'll also help us meet the security standards our Responsible Scaling Policy requires as models advance.

### Responsibilities

- Own endpoint configuration as code: author, review, test, and progressively roll out MDM policies, configuration profiles, and remediation scripts across macOS and mobile, with canary stages and rollback built in
- Operate the MDM platform itself as a production service, including infrastructure as code, observability, upgrades, and incident response
- Build patch management automation with rapid enforcement timelines while maintaining good user experience
- Design zero touch provisioning that turns a sealed box into a productive machine on day one
- Support a small number of Linux machines alongside the Mac fleet
- Turn fleet telemetry into policy, dashboards, and early drift warnings, and use Claude to automate manual ops work
- Partner with Corporate Security on endpoint hardening, binary authorization, and compliance controls
- Take shifts on the team's rotation for incoming requests and escalations, and serve as the deep escalation tier for endpoint issues IT Operations can't resolve

### You may be a good fit if you

- Have 8+ years building secure IT systems in complex environments, including leading projects across multiple teams
- Have managed endpoint fleets of thousands of macOS devices through a modern MDM
- Treat endpoint configuration as code that is version controlled and peer reviewed, rather than clicking in consoles
- Go deep on macOS internals such as launchd, configuration profiles, TCC, and system extensions
- Write Python and shell scripts
- Write design docs and runbooks so teammates can review and support what you build

### Strong candidates may also have

- Have operated an MDM or device management platform as a service, not only consumed one as SaaS
- Have worked with open source endpoint and device management tooling (Munki, osquery, AutoPkg)
- Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetry
- Have experience running infrastructure as code in a public cloud
- Have working knowledge of Linux administration (packaging, systems, config management)
- Have used LLMs to automate ops work

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$285,000—$325,000 USD

### **Logistics**

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit [anthropic.com/careers](http://anthropic.com/careers) directly for confirmed position openings.

### **How we're different**

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

### **Come work with us!**

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about [our policy](https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance) for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**

**The Opportunity:**

As an experienced, entrepreneurial Solutions Specialist, you will serve as the principal technical authority in modernizing enterprise and desktop solutions across hybrid multi-cloud environments. You will architect, validate, and execute high-availability desktop solutions centered on Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) hybrid and public cloud bare-metal infrastructure.

Acting as a trusted advisor to enterprise CIOs, CTOs, and Cloud Directors, you will bridge the gap between cloud infrastructure engineering and end-user experience to deliver secure, scalable, and cost-optimized ecosystems.

**About the Team:**

The successful candidate will join the EMEA Solution Specialists & Systems Engineering Organization at Nutanix—a forward-thinking group dedicated to solving complex enterprise infrastructure, cloud, and AI workload challenges. We are part of a mature, financially viable cloud software company that prides itself on bringing radical simplicity to complex technology.

In this role, you will report to the Manager, Systems Engineering. The position is fully remote within the EMEA region, offering high flexibility, but requires the ability to travel up to 25% including dedicated time doing customer discovery, architectural workshops, executive briefings, and partner collaboration across EMEA.

**Your Role:**

As Solutions Specialist, you will act as a primary technical deal architect and domain expert, driving pre-sales architecture, technical discovery, proof-of-concept (POC) validations, and enterprise cloud and desktop modernization strategies.

Domain Leadership & Enablement: Maintain authoritative, deep-dive expertise across multiple Nutanix products like EUC, Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2), and the broader ecosystem. Deliver cross-functional knowledge transfer to regional SEs, sales teams, and channel partners.

Technical Validation & Demonstrations: Lead advanced technical product presentations, live demonstrations, hands-on Proof of Concepts (POCs), and technical feasibility assessments for enterprise prospects.

Strategic Discovery & Qualification: Drive deep technical discovery and qualify opportunities for emerging technologies and enterprise cloud and desktop modernization across enterprise, federal, and commercial accounts.

Cross-Domain Solution Pairing: Collaborate closely with specialists across Nutanix Enterprise AI (NAI), Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP), and External Storage to deliver full-stack solution architectures.

Opportunity Expansion & Field Feedback: Identify portfolio expansion opportunities within installed accounts, synthesize customer feedback, and partner directly with Nutanix Product Management and Engineering to influence the product roadmap.

Workload Migration: Formulate zero-downtime migration paths for enterprise desktop workloads into modern cloud desktop architectures.

Disaster Recovery (DR): Establish automated disaster recovery strategies via Nutanix Disaster Recovery and advanced cloud bursting methods.

Storage & Profile Management: Implement enterprise profile management strategies utilizing FSLogix, scalable file/block storage platforms, and Nutanix Unified Storage (NUS).

Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop automated deployment templates using Terraform, PowerShell, and REST APIs to streamline NC2 cluster provisioning, host pool scaling, and image management.

Performance Validation: Lead technical discovery, capacity sizing, and performance validation utilizing NVIDIA vGPU / RTX vWS acceleration to guarantee an optimal user experience globally.

Cloud Desktop Architecture: Design scalable, high-availability virtual desktop solutions (AVD and hybrid desktop pools) bridging on-premises data centers and public cloud bare-metal environments (Azure & AWS).

Multi-Cloud Integration: Design cross-cloud network topologies, routing, and identity frameworks connecting desktop host pools with enterprise back-end application stacks.

Ecosystem Alignment: Collaborate with Microsoft Azure and AWS technical field teams to align cloud desktop deployments with enterprise consumption agreements and marketplace commitments.

**Technical & Architectural Experience**

Enterprise Architecture: Deep, proven experience in enterprise pre-sales systems engineering, cloud consulting, or infrastructure architecture specializing in public cloud VDI design.

Cloud Desktop Mastery: Advanced, hands-on architectural experience with Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) in hybrid and pure-cloud models.

Core Systems Control: Expert-level command of Microsoft FSLogix (Profile Containers, App Attach), Entra ID, conditional access, and zero-trust security architecture.

Software-Defined Infrastructure: Strong experience extending infrastructure to public clouds via Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2 on Azure/AWS), Nutanix Unified Storage (NUS), AOS, AHV, and Prism Central.

**Field & Pre-Sales Capability**

Experience: 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing pre-sales technical role (Solutions Architect, Systems Engineer, or Specialist Architect) within an enterprise software, cloud, or infrastructure organization. Prior experience in high-performance computing (HPC) or graphic-intensive VDI environments.

Consultative Selling: Proven track record of leading architectural design workshops, executing successful POCs, answering RFIs/RFPs, and handling complex technical objections from DBAs, Infrastructure Architects, and CXOs.

Business Acumen: Ability to articulate enterprise cloud and desktop TCO, licensing savings, operational efficiency gains, and risk reduction to senior IT leadership.

**Soft Skills & Operational Requirements**

Communication: Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills; able to translate intricate enterprise cloud and desktop engineering concepts into clear business outcomes for non-technical stakeholders.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience / industry certifications (e.g., Nutanix NCP/NCA, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect, Oracle OCP, or Microsoft SQL/PostgreSQL certifications).

Travel Flexibility: Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% across the EMEA region as required for customer engagements, team offsites, and industry events.

--

jobs.description:
Role Summary

We are seeking a hands-on Desktop Engineer to support enterprise laptop refresh and end-user computing initiatives. This role is responsible for imaging and configuring new touchscreen laptops, coordinating shipment and return logistics, maintaining asset inventory records, and providing remote user support to ensure successful device deployment.

The ideal candidate combines technical desktop support skills with strong customer service and project coordination capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Laptop Deployment & Refresh

Configure, image, and deploy Windows-based touchscreen laptops and mobile devices.
Install and validate standard enterprise software, security tools, and configurations.
Perform device setup, testing, and quality assurance prior to shipment.
Execute laptop refresh and replacement programs for remote and onsite users.
Migrate user profiles, files, settings, and applications from existing devices to new hardware.

Asset Management & Inventory

Track and maintain inventory of laptops, peripherals, docking stations, monitors, and accessories.
Manage asset lifecycle from procurement through deployment, recovery, and disposal.
Update asset repositories and CMDB records with accurate device information.
Monitor inventory levels and coordinate hardware ordering as needed.

Shipping & Logistics Coordination

Coordinate shipment of new devices directly to remote users and client locations.
Create shipping labels and track delivery status.
Manage return logistics for old equipment.
Ensure returned devices are received, documented, wiped, and processed according to security policies.
Work with vendors, shipping providers, and internal teams to resolve delivery issues.

Remote User Support

Provide phone, Teams, and remote support to end users during device setup and activation.
Assist users with VPN, Microsoft 365, email, MFA, printers, and network connectivity issues.
Guide employees through laptop migration and onboarding processes.
Troubleshoot hardware and software issues remotely and escalate when appropriate.
Deliver a positive user experience throughout deployment activities.

Technical Support

Support Windows 10/11 operating systems and enterprise desktop environments.
Troubleshoot device performance, security, connectivity, and application issues.
Support Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Intune, SCCM/MECM, VPN, and endpoint security solutions.
Create and maintain deployment, support, and troubleshooting documentation.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of Desktop Support, EUC, or Desktop Engineering experience.
Experience imaging and deploying Windows laptops at scale.
Knowledge of Microsoft Windows 10/11 administration.
Experience with Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, SCCM/MECM, or similar endpoint management tools.
Familiarity with Active Directory, Azure AD (Entra ID), and Microsoft 365.
Experience supporting remote users via phone and remote-control tools.
Strong organizational and inventory management skills.
Excellent communication and customer service abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting large-scale laptop refresh programs (500+ users).
Knowledge of asset management platforms and CMDB tools.
Experience with ServiceNow or other ITSM tools.
A+, Microsoft, or ITIL certification.
Experience supporting touchscreen and mobile device deployments.

Key Skills

Laptop Imaging & Deployment
Windows 10/11 Administration
Microsoft Intune / Autopilot
SCCM / MECM
Microsoft 365 Support
Active Directory / Entra ID
Asset & Inventory Management
Shipping & Logistics Coordination
Remote End User Support
Hardware Refresh Programs
ServiceNow
Customer Service & Communication

Success Metrics

Successful deployment of new laptops with minimal user disruption.
Accurate inventory and asset tracking.
Timely shipment and recovery of devices.
High end-user satisfaction scores.
Reduced deployment and setup issues through proactive support.
Compliance with device security and lifecycle management standards.

Honda is constantly innovating and developing solutions to drive our business with record success. We strive to be a company that serves as a source of “power” that supports people around the world who are trying to do things based on their own initiative and that helps people expand their own potential. To this end, Honda strives to realize “the joy and freedom of mobility” by developing new technologies and an innovative approach to achieve a “zero environmental footprint.”We are looking for qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, continuous improvement values, and a strong work ethic to join our team.If your goals and values align with Honda’s, we want you to join our team to Bring the Future!Job PurposeThe senior North America (NA) Digital Workplace Client Engineer is responsible for engineering, implementing, and managing the full spectrum of North America's modern workplace endpoint platforms.

Primary technologies include Microsoft Intune as the cloud-native Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) solution, Windows client platforms, iOS/iPadOS mobile devices via Apple Business Manager (ABM), and next-generation virtual endpoint solutions including Windows 365 Cloud PC and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD). The role also encompasses Microsoft Entra ID Join and Hybrid Entra ID Join strategies for identity-based endpoint access.The senior Client Engineer serves as the North America subject matter expert (SME) and Level 4 escalation authority for client endpoint technologies, defining technical standards, multi-year roadmaps, and architecture that position NA as the global model for modern endpoint engineering. This role partners closely with Microsoft and other key vendors, participates in product roadmap planning, and drives the transition from legacy on-premises management (SCCM, Group Policy) to a fully cloud-native endpoint model.This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Team Manager, NA Digital Workplace Client Engineering Services.

The North
America environment serves as the reference architecture and foundation for global endpoint standards adoption across the Honda enterprise.Key Accountabilities• Engineer, implement, and support Microsoft Intune as the primary Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) platform for Windows, iOS/iPadOS, MacOS and virtual endpoints. Manage device enrollment, configuration, compliance, application deployment, Windows Autopilot, and Apple Business Manager integration.

providing technical guidance to support teams.Lead the transition from SCCM and Group Policy-based management to cloud-native endpoint management through Intune, including migration planning, jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Senior Endpoint Engineer/Administrator (Level 3) responsible for the design, deployment, and advanced support of endpoint management solutions across a large, distributed physical and virtual device estate using Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) and Microsoft Intune in a co-managed environment. Owns application packaging, third-party patch management, security vulnerability remediation, advanced PowerShell automation, and at-scale incident troubleshooting, partnering closely with Information Security, Networking, and Support teams to keep the endpoint fleet secure, compliant, and reliable.

Key Responsibilities

Package, test, and deploy Windows and third-party applications through MECM and Intune (Win32 apps), using PSADT and other silent-install packages with reliable detection logic and dependency handling. MECM/Intune co-management experience: client settings, boundaries and boundary groups, deployment collections, Autopilot profiles, compliance policies, and configuration baselines across the enterprise endpoint estate. Design, write, and maintain advanced PowerShell scripts for automation, remediation, and reporting, including Intune and MECM. Identify, prioritize, and remediate security vulnerabilities across the endpoint fleet in partnership with Information Security – driving CVE/patch-compliance reporting and mitigation timelines for OS and third-party applications. Third-party application patching lifecycle – identifying, packaging, testing, and deploying updates (e.g., via Patch My PC, MECM, application/patch deployment) to minimize vulnerability exposure windows. Networking knowledge (DNS, DHCP, IP addressing/subnetting, VLANs, boundary/content distribution) to resolve connectivity issues affecting client communication, application delivery, and patch distribution. Leverage AI-assisted tools (Claude, Copilot and other scripting assistants) and automation/orchestration to streamline packaging, remediation, and reporting – tracking work in JIRA and version-controlling scripts/configs in GitHub. Partner and collaborate with multiple technical teams (Architecture, Networking, Information Security, Support, etc.) to develop and support endpoint solutions. Triage and resolve escalations from Endpoint Support and Security, acting as a technical escalation point for Level 1/2 teams.

This job profile description is a standardized, non-contractual reference description and global reference tool provided for organizational consistency and talent architecture purposes across Cencora. It does not alter actual job duties, responsibilities, reporting lines, working conditions, grading, compensation, or other essential terms and conditions of employment.

Actual duties and responsibilities may vary based on business needs, local requirements, and operational practices. Where a team member's role is governed by an employment agreement, local terms and conditions, prior job description or collective bargaining agreement, those documents shall prevail in case of any inconsistency. Mandatory local laws shall also prevail.

Experience And Educational Requirements

Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related technology field (equivalent experience considered). At least 8 years of IT experience, including 5+ years in infrastructure/endpoint engineering. Advanced, hands-on expertise with Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) and Microsoft Intune, including co-management, Autopilot, compliance policies, and Win32 application deployment. Demonstrated experience remediating security vulnerabilities – identifying, prioritizing, and patching OS and third-party application vulnerabilities, including CVE triage and patch-compliance reporting (Microsoft Defender/vulnerability management tooling). Advanced PowerShell scripting ability (functions, modules, error handling, remoting, Graph API/Intune scripting), plus familiarity with VBScript for legacy support. Proven ability to troubleshoot complex incidents at scale across large, distributed endpoint environments, with strong root-cause analysis skills. Strong application packaging experience (.MSI/.MST, Win32; App-V/MSIX familiarity a plus) using, PSAppDeployToolkit, Advanced Installer, and Orca. Experience managing third-party application patching programs (e.g., Patch My PC, Ivanti, or similar). Solid understanding of Active Directory and Group Policy for managing user/computer objects, including GPO troubleshooting (gpresult, RSoP). Working knowledge of wired/wireless networking fundamentals: DHCP, DNS, IP addressing, subnetting, and VLANs, and how they affect client-server communication and content distribution. Familiarity with Windows 11 Enterprise features, settings, and deployment; BIOS/UEFI configuration; Bitlocker and Microsoft Defender. Experience with virtualization technologies (Citrix, VMware) and thin/zero-client delivery is a plus. Solid track record of delivering thoughtful, effective, and timely solutions to complex business problems that enhance the end-user experience.

Additional / Preferred Skills

AI-assisted automation and Copilot-style tools (Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Claude) to speed up scripting, triage, and remediation. Service-Now for Incident, request logging. GitHub (or Azure DevOps) for version-controlled scripts and Intune/MECM configuration-as-code, including basic CI/CD pipelines. JIRA (or similar) for ticketing, sprint/backlog tracking, and change management. Working familiarity with Azure AD/Microsoft Entra ID, conditional access, and Windows Autopatch. Experience mentoring Level 1/2 engineers and producing clear runbooks/knowledge-base documentation. ITIL foundations or equivalent incident/problem/change management experience.

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. For details, visit https://www.virtualfairhub.com/cencora

Full time

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) treats Anthropic's device fleet as a platform we build and run. We run our own MDM as a production service and manage every piece of device configuration as code. Policies, configuration profiles, queries, remediation scripts, and software all ship through pull requests, CI, a staging environment, and a canary group before they reach the fleet. The fleet is mostly macOS, plus a small number of Linux machines and a growing mobile footprint.

You'll own that platform end to end: the infrastructure underneath the MDM, the configuration on top of it, the patching and software pipelines that keep thousands of devices patched and secure, and the telemetry that tells us what is actually true on every device. You'll also build automation that cuts down on manual operational work. You'll work with Security teams on hardening, compliance controls, and detection and response, and with developer and infrastructure teams to make sure those controls don't get in the way of their work. Your work will let us base access decisions on whether a device can be trusted.

We value people who double check a compliance report before they believe it. The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You'll help define the endpoint roadmap, make architecture decisions, and own the platform every Anthropic employee's work runs on. You'll also help us meet the security standards our Responsible Scaling Policy requires as models advance.

Responsibilities

Own endpoint configuration as code: author, review, test, and progressively roll out MDM policies, configuration profiles, and remediation scripts across macOS and mobile, with canary stages and rollback built inOperate the MDM platform itself as a production service, including infrastructure as code, observability, upgrades, and incident responseBuild patch management automation with rapid enforcement timelines while maintaining good user experienceDesign zero touch provisioning that turns a sealed box into a productive machine on day oneSupport a small number of Linux machines alongside the Mac fleetTurn fleet telemetry into policy, dashboards, and early drift warnings, and use Claude to automate manual ops workPartner with Corporate Security on endpoint hardening, binary authorization, and compliance controlsTake shifts on the team's rotation for incoming requests and escalations, and serve as the deep escalation tier for endpoint issues IT Operations can't resolve

You may be a good fit if you

Have 8+ years building secure IT systems in complex environments, including leading projects across multiple teamsHave managed endpoint fleets of thousands of macOS devices through a modern MDMTreat endpoint configuration as code that is version controlled and peer reviewed, rather than clicking in consolesGo deep on macOS internals such as launchd, configuration profiles, TCC, and system extensionsWrite Python and shell scriptsWrite design docs and runbooks so teammates can review and support what you build

Strong candidates may also have

Have operated an MDM or device management platform as a service, not only consumed one as SaaSHave worked with open source endpoint and device management tooling (Munki, osquery, AutoPkg)Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetryHave experience running infrastructure as code in a public cloudHave working knowledge of Linux administration (packaging, systems, config management)Have used LLMs to automate ops work

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$285,000—$325,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
