jobs.description:
Company Description
- ------------------

Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let's create a world we want to live in.

Job Description
- --------------

We are looking for an**Endpoint Management Specialist** profile to join our IT team. The position provides advanced technical support to internal users across different countries and global regions, while also contributing to system administration and network operations to ensure stable and secure IT services.

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you'll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you'll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

**Due to the international scope of the role, working hours are not fixed and may include evening, night, weekend, or rotating shifts, depending on the regions being supported.**

**Key responsibilities:**

**Endpoint Operations \& Support**

* Provide Level 2/3 support for endpoint-related incidents and service requests.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and device management issues.
* Manage incidents through their full lifecycle and perform root cause analysis.
* Support user onboarding, offboarding, and device provisioning activities.

**Endpoint Management**

* Support and maintain Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 services.
* Configure and test device policies, compliance policies, and configuration profiles.
* Monitor endpoint compliance and support remediation activities.
* Assist with device lifecycle management and deployment processes.

**Software Packaging \& Deployment**

* Package, test, and deploy software applications and updates.
* Troubleshoot application deployment issues.
* Support application lifecycle management and software maintenance.

**Testing \& Continuous Improvement**

* Validate new endpoint configurations, policies, and solutions before production rollout.
* Participate in pilot deployments and testing activities.
* Contribute to process improvements, automation, and service optimization initiatives.

**Documentation \& Knowledge Management**

* Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Document recurring issues and standard solutions.
* Support knowledge sharing within the Endpoint Management team.

Qualifications
- -------------

* 4 years of experience in Endpoint Management, IT Operations, or advanced IT Support
* Experience with Microsoft Intune and endpoint management solutions
* Knowledge of software packaging and application deployment
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Understanding of endpoint security and compliance concepts
* Basic PowerShell knowledge is an advantage
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* Fluent **English**(C1 or C2)

Additional Information
- ---------------------

* To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working
* We promote your professional and personal development through individual training and further education at the Drees \& Sommer Academy
* We support your health with a bonus for sports enthusiasts. We offer the possibility of subscribing to a private health insurance policy
* Employees benefit from tax advantages related to their commuting expenses for the office
* Fiscal advantages for employees expenses in meal costs during worktime. Employee referral program with attractive bonus scheme
* Supporting career and family by receiving tax benefits for kindergarten expenses

Nuestro Centro de Soporte tiene establecida una gestión del talento enfocada en potenciar el bienestar y el rendimiento del equipo.

Preferencia desde Madrid, Bilbao, Barcelona

**¿QUÉ HARÁS EN TU DÍA A DÍA?**

* Documentar incidencias, soluciones implementadas y procedimientos de soporte.
* Proporcionar orientación y formación básica a usuarios para garantizar un uso eficiente de las plataformas.
* Realizar mantenimiento preventivo, evolutivo y correctivo en sistemas y equipos.
* Gestión de dispositivos Android, iOS/iPadOS, Windows, MacOS y Linux.

**¿QUÉ ESPERAMOS DE TI?** Experiencia valorable en soluciones de Digital Employee Experience (DEX) y observabilidad del puesto de trabajo.

Experiencia en la resolución de incidencias, peticiones y cambios, siguiendo procedimientos ITIL y acuerdos de nivel de servicio (SLA).

Capacidad para realizar análisis, diagnóstico y escalado de incidencias complejas en entornos corporativos multitecnología.

Experiencia en troubleshooting avanzado mediante análisis de logs, trazas, eventos de sistema, herramientas de diagnóstico y captura de tráfico.

Conocimiento Valorable.

* Workspace ONE UEM (aka Airwatch)
* Ivanti EPMM (aka MobileIron)
* Intune
* SOTI MobiControl
* AppLivery
* IBM MaaS360
* Android Enterprise (COBO, BYOD, COPE y COSU).

* Digital Employee Experience (Riverbed Aternity, Nexthink, etc.)
* Ecosistema Samsung (Knox Manage, Knox Asset Intelligence, Knox Service Plugin, etc.)
* Infraestructura de correo Exchange y O365

* Explotación de APIs REST y herramientas Postman, Fiddler, etc.

* Automatización de tareas mediante PowerShell, Bash o APIs REST.

jobs.description:
Dexian has an immediate opportunity available for a detail-oriented and motivated Endpoint Administrator with MS Intune experience to manage, maintain, and optimize a unified endpoint management environment for our premier aerospace customer. The Endpoint Administrator will be the primary point of contact for the deployment, configuration, compliance, and security of all corporate-owned and BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) endpoints. Utilizing the Microsoft 365 stack-specifically Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID-you will ensure seamless, secure hardware and software lifecycles across Windows and iOS platforms.

A typical workday may consist of the following duties as directed by the client:

Policy & Profile Management: Build, test, and deploy Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies, and security baselines to standardize client environments.Application Packaging & Deployment: Package, test, and distribute internal and third-party software updates, web links, and store apps across the enterprise.Modern Provisioning: Administer and monitor modern device deployment systems, such as Windows Autopilot and Apple Business Manager, ensuring a zero-touch or minimal-touch provisioning pipeline for new hires.Identity & Access Control: Collaborate with identity teams to manage device registration, primary user changes, group memberships, and targeted Conditional Access enforcement.Troubleshooting & Escalations: Act as the Tier 2/3 escalation point for device enrollment failures, application installation blocks, and profile synchronization issues.Reporting & Governance: Monitor Intune reporting dashboards daily to identify non-compliant devices, update patch status deficiencies, and remediate systemic configuration drift.Documentation: Maintain clear, concise documentation outlining deployment processes, app packaging standards, and device lifecycle flows.REQUIREMENTS AND SKILLS:To be successful in this role, you should possess the following skills:

Security Stack Exposure: Familiarity integrating Intune with security tools like Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or implementing data protection via MAM (Mobile Application Management) without full device enrollment.Problem-Solving & Analytical Rigor: A structured, logical approach to debugging deployment failures, policy conflicts, and log file analysis.Cross-Functional Communication: The ability to explain technical enrollment steps or security restrictions clearly and empathetically to non-technical business professionals.Adaptability: Curiosity and willingness to stay current with Microsoft's continuous cloud release notes, feature changes, and best-practice evolutions.To be eligible for this position, you must meet or exceed each of the following:

Experience: Four to six (4 - 6) years of progressive experience in IT systems administration, with a minimum of 2-3 years dedicated specifically to managing and deploying policies within Microsoft Intune (Cloud-only or Hybrid/co-management configurations).Technical Ecosystem Knowledge: Solid foundation in Microsoft 365 workloads, including Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory), Conditional Access policies, and Group Policy Objects (GPOs).Ability to install, configure, monitor and troubleshoot Microsoft and third-party enterprise applications across large endpoint environments.Maintain desktop and application packaging of standard, engineered, and tested configurations for remote distribution utilizing Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) and Intune.Managing endpoint configuration, compliance, and automation through enterprise tools such as MECM/SCCM, Intune, or similar technologies.OS Support: Demonstrated experience configuring, enrolling, and troubleshooting Windows 10/11 endpoints. Basic exposure to managing mobile operating systems (iOS) via MDM (Mobile Device Management) profiles.Scripting Essentials: Basic proficiency with PowerShell for writing, editing, and deploying automated scripts or application wrappers to endpoints.Performing post deployment remediation and cleanup patching using PowerShell or similar scripting tools to automate updates, enforce configuration baselines, and resolve inconsistent patch states.Core Infrastructure: Solid understanding of core networking and identity concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and modern identity provisioning.SECURITY CLEARANCE:This position requires an active Department of Defense security clearance at the SECRET level or ability to obtain and maintain this clearance. U.S. citizens ONLY are eligible for a security clearance and this position.

LOCATION:This is an on-site position, and the successful candidate may be based in one of the following locations: El Segundo, CA, Chantilly, VA or Colorado Springs, CO.EDUCATION and CERTIFICATIONS:Associate's degree or higher requiredPossession of or progress toward the Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) certification.COMPENSATION:Dexian reasonably expects to offer $38.00 - $45.00 per hour for this position based on location, skills and experience.Additional benefits include generous time off, health, vision and dental insurance and matching 401k.ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:Submit/Pass a 10-year background check, criminal history, drug screening, and fingerprints.Valid driver's license/Real-ID with clean driver's history.Applicants must have a strong work ethic, be extremely organized and detail-oriented, be a self-starter with excellent time management, problem solving, and multitasking skills.Excellent face-to-face customer service skills - at least 1 year experience in a customer service position, such as: call center, retail, or other customer facing role.Demonstrated problem solving skills with ability to research, resolve and complete tasks within pre-determined deadlines and schedules.Able to process work quickly and accurately despite interruptions, changing timelines and priorities, on a regular basis.Strong command of Microsoft Office Suite including Outlook, Excel, and Word programs.Working knowledge of app/database ticketing systems. Knowledge of ServiceNow, a plus.Position may require dexterity and ability to sit, stand, walk extended distances.Keywords: Intune, Endpoint, MECM, SCCM

jobs.title: Lead Infrastructure Engineer - Microsoft 365 Office Client Engineer
jobs.summary: Assume a vital position as a key member of a high-performing team that delivers infrastructure and performance excellence. Your role will be instrumental in shaping the future at one of the world's largest and most influential companies. As a Lead...
jobs.description:
Assume a vital position as a key member of a high-performing team that delivers infrastructure and performance excellence. Your role will be instrumental in shaping the future at one of the world's largest and most influential companies.

 As a Lead Infrastructure Engineer at JPMorganChase within Employee Platforms, you own the packaging, validation, and release execution for Office client software across a global virtual and physical desktop estate.

 In the Microsoft 365 Office Client Engineering space, you own the packaging, validation, and release execution for Office client software across a global virtual and physical desktop estate. You are accountable for getting validated updates and new capabilities onto the desktop safely, at scale, and on a predictable schedule. This is a hands-on engineering role with release accountability. You will build the test and deployment pipeline that turns a multi-week manual cycle into a repeatable run, define the ring strategy and go/no-go criteria that protect line-of-business add-ins and macros, and act as the technical escalation point with Microsoft. The environment is heavily customized and tightly controlled, so speed has to be earned through automation, evidence, and a rollback path that works.

 Job Responsibilities Own engineering, deployment, patching, validation, and support of Office 365 Apps across enterprise desktop environments. Lead release planning and execution using pilot groups, deployment rings, quality gates, and rollback procedures. Automate deployment, testing, monitoring, and operational processes using scripting and infrastructure tools. Troubleshoot complex application and endpoint issues using logs, telemetry, and root-cause analysis. Serve as the technical escalation point for software releases, infrastructure incidents, and vendor support engagements. Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate infrastructure analysis and design documentation, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements. Partner with application, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure compatibility, compliance, and operational readiness. Applies reuse-first, AI-assisted practices within delivery and automation routines to identify recurring issues and validate remediation options, ensuring changes are traceable/auditable and aligned to resiliency and security expectations. Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills Formal training or certification on infrastructure engineering concepts and 5+ years of applied experience. Deep experience with Microsoft Office 365 deployment, servicing, configuration, and support. Strong expertise with Microsoft Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Intune, and endpoint management technologies. Experience managing enterprise software releases, deployment governance, validation, and rollback planning. Proven troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills across endpoint and infrastructure platforms. Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support infrastructure engineering workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity. Ability to review and validate AI-assisted recommendations before implementation, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to resiliency, security, and auditability expectations. Deep knowledge of one specific infrastructure technology and scripting languages. Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI-enabled workplace technologies. Experience supporting Citrix, Azure Virtual Desktop, or similar virtual desktop environments. Experience with application compatibility testing, add-ins, and enterprise software packaging. Experience using telemetry, monitoring, and analytics tools to drive release and operational decisions. Experience implementing automation that improves operational efficiency and reduces manual effort.

jobs.description:
Job SummaryWe are looking for an experienced Device Management Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Intune (Endpoint Manager) and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD).

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Device Management Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Intune (Endpoint Manager) and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD). The candidate will be responsible for designing, deploying, and managing modern workplace solutions, including device lifecycle management, application deployment, security compliance, and virtual desktop infrastructure on Azure.

 Key Responsibilities

Device Management (Microsoft Intune / MEM)

- Manage end-to-end device lifecycle (enrollment, configuration, compliance, retirement) for Windows, iOS, Android, and macOS devices using Microsoft Intune.

- Design and deploy configuration profiles, compliance policies, and conditional access policies in collaboration with the security team.

- Implement and manage Windows Autopilot for zero-touch device provisioning.

- Package, deploy, and update applications (Win32, MSI, LOB, Microsoft Store apps) via Intune.

- Manage Windows Update for Business rings, feature/quality update deployments, and patch compliance reporting.

- Implement endpoint security policies including BitLocker, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint integration, ASR rules, and device encryption.

- Handle mobile device management (MDM) and mobile application management (MAM/APP) policies for BYOD and corporate devices.

- Migrate devices from legacy management (SCCM/ConfigMgr, GPO) to modern cloud management, including co-management setups.

Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD)

- Design, deploy, and manage AVD host pools, application groups, and workspaces.

- Create and maintain golden images using Azure Image Builder / custom images; manage image versioning via Azure Compute Gallery.

- Configure and manage FSLogix profile containers, including storage (Azure Files / Azure NetApp Files) and permissions.

- Implement autoscaling plans to optimize session host capacity and Azure consumption costs.

- Publish RemoteApps and full desktop sessions based on business requirements.

- Monitor AVD environment health, session performance, and user experience using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and AVD Insights.

- Troubleshoot session connectivity, profile load issues, latency, and host performance problems.

General / Cross-Functional

- Administer Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) — device registration, hybrid join, group management, and conditional access.

- Automate routine tasks using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API.

- Maintain documentation — SOPs, architecture diagrams, runbooks, and knowledge base articles.

- Provide L2/L3 support for escalated endpoint and AVD incidents; work within ITIL-based incident/change management processes.

- Collaborate with security, network, and infrastructure teams on compliance audits and hardening initiatives.

- Stay current with Microsoft roadmap changes and recommend improvements to the modern workplace environment.

 Required Skills & Qualifications

- 4–5 years of experience in IT infrastructure/endpoint management, with at least 2–3 years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Intune and Azure Virtual Desktop.

- Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), conditional access, and identity-driven security.

- Proven experience with Windows Autopilot, application packaging, and compliance/configuration policy design.

- Hands-on experience with FSLogix, host pool management, image management, and AVD scaling.

- Solid PowerShell scripting skills; exposure to Microsoft Graph API is a plus.

- Understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, proxy) as they relate to endpoint and AVD connectivity.

- Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and endpoint security baselines.

- Experience with SCCM/ConfigMgr and co-management scenarios preferred.

- Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

 Preferred Certifications

- MD-102: Microsoft 365 Certified – Endpoint Administrator Associate

- AZ-140: Configuring and Operating Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop

- AZ-104: Microsoft Azure Administrator (nice to have)

- SC-300 or MS-102 (added advantage)

We're not just a workplace - we're a Great Place to Work certified employer!

Proudly certified as a Great Place to Work, we are dedicated to creating a supportive and inclusive environment. At Sonic Healthcare USA, we emphasize teamwork and innovation. Check out our job openings and advance your career with a company that values its team members!

Sonic Healthcare USA is seeking a highly skilled Intune Engineer to join our Information Technology team. This role is responsible for the design, implementation, administration, and continuous improvement of Microsoft Intune and the broader Microsoft Endpoint Management ecosystem. The Intune Engineer will ensure the secure, compliant, and efficient management of Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices while delivering an exceptional end-user experience.

The ideal candidate is passionate about endpoint management, automation, security, and modern workplace technologies. This individual will partner closely with Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Identity & Access Management, Service Desk, and Digital Workplace teams to support key initiatives including Zero Trust, Microsoft 365 optimization, endpoint lifecycle management, and device modernization..

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Management & Engineering

Design, implement, and manage Microsoft Intune policies, device configurations, compliance policies, and endpoint security settings.

Administer and optimize Microsoft Endpoint Manager (MEM), Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and Microsoft Defender integrations.

Develop and maintain device enrollment, provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management processes.

Create, test, and deploy application packages across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android platforms.

Implement and support Windows Autopilot deployments for zero-touch provisioning.

Monitor and manage device compliance, remediation, and policy enforcement activities.

Evaluate and implement endpoint management best practices to improve security, user experience, and operational efficiency.

Security & Compliance

Partner with Cybersecurity teams to implement endpoint security controls and Zero Trust strategies.

Configure and support Conditional Access policies integrated with Intune and Entra ID.

Support compliance initiatives related to HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC, and other regulatory requirements.

Monitor and remediate endpoint vulnerabilities, configuration drift, and security risks.

Collaborate with Security Operations teams to strengthen endpoint detection, response, and threat mitigation capabilities.

Automation & Innovation

Develop automation solutions using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, and Power Automate.

Build proactive monitoring and remediation scripts to improve endpoint health and supportability.

Streamline onboarding, offboarding, device refresh, and lifecycle management processes.

Evaluate emerging Microsoft Endpoint Management technologies and recommend adoption opportunities.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual effort and improve service delivery.

Operations & Support

Serve as an escalation point for complex endpoint management and device-related issues.

Support operating system deployments, software distribution, patch management, and endpoint updates.

Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, procedures, and knowledge articles.

Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and problem management activities.

Partner with Service Desk teams to improve support processes and reduce recurring issues.

Reporting & Analytics

Develop dashboards and reporting for endpoint compliance, patching, endpoint health, and user experience metrics.

Track and report key operational performance indicators and service-level objectives.

Provide recommendations to improve endpoint security, compliance, and operational effectiveness.

Experience packaging and deploying enterprise applications.

Strong PowerShell scripting and automation experience.

Experience supporting Windows 10 and Windows 11 enterprise environments.

Strong understanding of endpoint security, compliance, device management, and identity management concepts.

Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

jobs.description:
About the RoleWe are seeking an experienced Level 3 Engineer and Microsoft 365 Specialist to design, build, and strengthen internal technology platforms while delivering high-quality technical support across a diverse small-business client environment.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Level 3 Engineer and Microsoft 365 Specialist to design, build, and strengthen internal technology platforms while delivering high-quality technical support across a diverse small-business client environment.

This is a hands-on position suited to an experienced MSP professional who combines strong technical capability with a practical builder mindset. The initial focus will be on enhancing internal systems, configuring and improving RMM and PSA platforms, strengthening documentation and service-management standards, and uplifting Microsoft 365 security and endpoint-management environments.

You will also provide Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 incident triage, incident management, and technical support while proactively identifying opportunities to improve security, scalability, automation, and service delivery.

About the Client

You will be working with a South Australian managed services provider supporting a carefully selected portfolio of small-business clients. The organisation combines enterprise-level technology expertise with a personalised, trusted-partner approach and is entering an exciting stage of growth.

As part of this growth, the business is strengthening its internal systems, tools, security controls, and service-management capabilities to deliver increasingly secure, structured, and scalable technology services.

Ideal Profile

Experience & Role Requirements

- Minimum five years of relevant experience across IT engineering, systems administration, or technical support.

- Demonstrated Level 3 capability within Microsoft 365 environments, including strong hands-on experience with Intune, Conditional Access, Windows Autopilot, and Microsoft Purview.

- Previous experience working within a managed services provider environment.

- Proven ability to design, implement, and support production systems rather than solely administer established environments.

- Strong incident triage and incident-management experience across Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 issues.

- Experience configuring or improving RMM and PSA platforms and associated workflows.

- Working knowledge across networking, endpoint management, identity, security, backup, and SaaS administration.

- Ability to audit technology environments, identify control or configuration gaps, and deliver structured remediation.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills with excellent technical documentation discipline.

Technical Skills

- Strong Microsoft 365 administration and security expertise.

- Hands-on capability with Microsoft Intune, Conditional Access, Windows Autopilot, and mobile device management.

- Experience with Microsoft Purview, data loss prevention, and information/document classification.

- Knowledge of RMM and remote-support platforms; NinjaOne experience is highly regarded, while TeamViewer familiarity is beneficial.

- Experience configuring PSA platforms and service-management workflows.

- Microsoft Azure capability, particularly virtual machine and terminal-server provisioning, is highly regarded.

- Experience with Microsoft 365 and SaaS backup solutions, including NinjaOne SaaS Backup, is advantageous.

- Familiarity with multi-tenant management solutions such as CIPP or Microsoft Lighthouse is advantageous.

- Experience supporting Ubiquiti UniFi networking and Lenovo and HP desktop environments.

- Sound understanding of SaaS concepts, cybersecurity controls, and secure administration practices.

Qualifications & Certifications

- Relevant Microsoft certifications covering Microsoft 365, endpoint management, security, or Azure, or equivalent demonstrable technical capability.

- ITIL certification is highly regarded, supported by practical knowledge of IT service management and change management.

- A tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline is desirable.

Professional Attributes

- Methodical, structured, and highly attentive to detail.

- Proactive and self-directed, with the confidence to identify priorities and recommend improvements.

- Strong commitment to clear, accurate, and maintainable technical documentation.

- Practical builder mindset with ownership of solution quality, usability, and maintainability.

- Comfortable balancing platform-development initiatives with client support requirements in a growing MSP environment.

- Curious about AI, automation, and emerging technologies, with an ability to explore them responsibly.

- Reliable and trustworthy when managing privileged access to client environments.

Responsibilities

- Design, configure, and continuously improve internal IT systems, tools, and service-delivery capabilities.

- Build and administer remote monitoring and management environments, including supporting the transition toward NinjaOne and existing TeamViewer capabilities.

- Configure and enhance PSA platforms and associated operational workflows.

- Deliver Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 technical support, including incident triage and incident management.

- Implement and administer Microsoft Intune, Conditional Access, Windows Autopilot, and mobile device management environments.

- Configure Microsoft Purview capabilities, including data loss prevention and information/document classification.

- Implement and maintain Microsoft 365 and SaaS backup solutions.

- Support secure administration across multiple Microsoft 365 tenants using appropriate tenant-management platforms.

- Assess and audit internal and client environments, identifying security, configuration, and control gaps and implementing structured improvements.

- Support Microsoft Azure and broader systems-engineering activities, including virtual machine and terminal-server provisioning.

- Configure and support Ubiquiti UniFi networking environments and Lenovo and HP desktop devices.

- Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, implementation records, standards, procedures, and change records.

- Apply structured IT service-management and change-management practices across technical work.

- Help strengthen client environments against relevant cybersecurity standards and controls, including SMB1001 Gold where applicable.

- Explore practical applications of AI and automation to improve internal processes, service delivery, and client outcomes.

- Proactively identify priorities, ask informed questions, and recommend improvements with limited day-to-day direction.

How we take care of our team

💰 Get paid in Australian Dollars

🩺 Generous OPD coverage from doctor visits to all your medical needs
🏡 Home office setup allowance to build your ideal workspace

🎉 Work hard, play hard – regular team events & engagement activities

📚 We invest in you – reimbursement for industry certifications
🗣️ Open-door culture – your ideas and feedback always matter
🌍 Flexible work – home or office, wherever you do your best work
🏆 Rewards & recognition that actually recognize you
🥳 Great christmas & financial year-end parties to unwind with your loved ones

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, End User Services & IT Automation
jobs.summary: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks...
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

At Smartsheet, we're scaling our India Global Capability Centre, and we're hiring a Senior Manager to lead IT End User Services in a Mac-first environment.

You'll sit at the center of our AI and automation strategy for the service desk, leading two teams: Security & Desktop Systems, who pair Service Desk support with first-line security triage, and IT Automation, who build the AI agents and workflows that make that work faster. You'll decide where agents, deterministic automation, and people each belong, and own your teams' performance against SLAs and quality targets.

You'll partner daily with our US IT leadership, aligning on standards and sharing what works. For the right candidate, there is a clear path to Director within 12-18 months as we continue to scale the India GCC.

**A note on the role:** This is a hands-on leadership role, though not a hands-on-every-day one. You'll stay close enough to the technology to prototype, review, and debug alongside your engineers, and to step in when the team is stretched or something breaks. If you want to lead from a distance, this isn't the right fit. If you want to lead from credibility, it is.

#### You Will

**AI & Automation Strategy**

- Own the AI and automation strategy for the service desk, lead the IT Automation Engineers in delivering it, and decide which workflows suit AI agents, deterministic automation, or people
- Identify high-volume, repetitive Tier 1 work, prioritise it by impact, and ensure it is automated and measured
- Apply AI where it meaningfully reduces toil (e.g. intelligent ticket triage, SOC alert summarisation, AI-assisted knowledge base drafting), and design and review agent-based workflows end to end, including the tools they call and where a human approves
- Set guardrails for automated actions, including identity verification, least-privilege access, permissions-aware data retrieval, audit logging, and human approval for sensitive requests
- Set automation standards, review technical designs before deployment, and help build, debug, and fix automations when they fail or stall

**Security & Desktop Systems**

- Lead the India-based Security & Desktop Systems Specialists, working daily with US counterparts and peer service desk managers in other regions to align priorities, coverage, and ways of working
- Own team performance against SLAs, quality standards, and service desk metrics, and drive continuous improvement
- Oversee resolution of tickets across hardware, software, network, and user access
- Own desktop administration across a Mac-first fleet (macOS and Windows), including software deployment, system configuration, user provisioning, enrollment, and hardware lifecycle management
- Step in hands-on when volumes spike or critical issues arise, and coach people through the fix
- Keep knowledge base articles and process documentation current, high quality, and consistently maintained

**Security Operations (Tier 1)**

- Oversee the team's first-line SOC responsibilities, including alert triage, escalation, and response
- Ensure the team follows incident response playbooks, and improve them as threats and tooling evolve
- Partner with the wider security organisation so Tier 1 handoffs are fast, accurate, and well documented
- Track SOC quality and response metrics, and build the team's security capability over time
- Balance support and security workload so neither is neglected as volumes change

**People Leadership**

- Set clear direction, track progress, remove blockers, and escalate capacity constraints
- Partner with peer managers across regions to align service standards, share automation and best practices, and keep the global service desk experience consistent
- Design and lead onboarding for new team members
- Coach and mentor India-based engineers and specialists, support their career growth, and hire and develop top technical talent

#### You Have

**Experience**

- 8+ years in IT support, Service Desk, or end user services operations, with deep working knowledge of the systems and processes involved
- 4+ years leading technical support teams in matrixed or distributed organisations, including influencing peers and stakeholders across regions without direct authority
- Hands-on experience applying AI/LLM capabilities to IT workflows, such as function/tool calling, MCP, or API-based orchestration, and the judgment to know when to use agents, deterministic automation, or humans
- Experience overseeing Tier 1 security operations, such as alert triage, escalation, and incident response, ideally including endpoint (EDR) alerts
- Experience leading engineers who build automation or integrations, with enough technical depth to review their work, set direction, and contribute when needed
- A track record of setting direction and delivering cross-functional projects through ambiguity, and of stepping into technical problems credibly when the team needs it

**Technical skills**

- Strong hands-on expertise in macOS endpoint management through Jamf (or a comparable Apple MDM such as Kandji or Mosyle), including zero-touch enrollment, policy and patch management, and Apple Business Manager. Our fleet is roughly 80% macOS.
- Working knowledge of Windows endpoint management through Intune, covering the remaining 20% of our fleet
- Solid understanding of identity and productivity platforms (Okta, Entra ID, or Active Directory; M365)
- Working knowledge of an ITSM platform such as Freshservice, including workflow design, API integrations, and governance
- Working knowledge of scripting or programming (Python, PowerShell, or shell) sufficient to review and contribute to automation work
- Familiarity with EDR platforms (including macOS coverage), firewalls, and ITIL or equivalent frameworks

**Preferred**

- Experience building agents with LLM APIs/SDKs or agent frameworks, including retrieval (RAG) over IT knowledge
- Experience building and scaling a service desk or IT automation function

**Work Style**

- Excellent English communication, strong self-motivation, and reliable follow-through
- Comfortable moving between leading the team and rolling up your sleeves
- Willing to join a short early-morning call for US handover, and the occasional evening global meeting
- Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

If you meet most of this but not every bullet, we'd still like to hear from you.

**Get to Know Us:**

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

RANGO SALARIAL: $140,000 USD - $160,000 USD

La compensación específica se basará en la experiencia, habilidades,
calificaciones, consideraciones comerciales y otros factores relacionados con el
puesto permitidos por la ley. En Russell Investments, el salario es solo una parte de
nuestro paquete de compensación. Nuestro enfoque de recompensas totales
incluye un bono anual por desempeño (sujeto a criterios de elegibilidad) además
de la participación en nuestros programas competitivos de beneficios, que
incluyen atención médica, jubilación, vacaciones y programas de bienestar.

DESCRIPCIÓN DEL PUESTO:

En Russell Investments, nuestro propósito es mejorar la seguridad financiera de las
personas.

Buscamos un Ingeniero Senior de Ciberseguridad – IAM y Seguridad de Endpoints
para liderar el diseño y la ingeniería de las capacidades de seguridad de
identidad, endpoints y acceso privilegiado en un entorno híbrido global.

Este rol combina experiencia práctica en ingeniería con alineación
arquitectónica, centrándose en soluciones escalables, automatizadas y basadas
en el riesgo, fundamentadas en los principios de Confianza Cero (Zero Trust).

RESPONSABILIDADES CLAVE

* Liderar la implementación y optimización de controles de identidad,
  endpoints y acceso privilegiado en entornos híbridos.

* Gestionar el ciclo de vida de la identidad, la seguridad de endpoints y
  la gobernanza de accesos, asegurando configuraciones seguras y la
  aplicación coherente de estándares.

* Impulsar la automatización y la eficiencia operativa en los procesos de
  aprovisionamiento, cumplimiento y gestión de accesos.

* Aplicar los principios de Confianza Cero (Zero Trust) y modelado de
  amenazas para fortalecer el diseño de seguridad de identidad y endpoints.

* Colaborar con Operaciones de Ciberseguridad para mejorar las capacidades
  de detección, respuesta y monitorización de controles.

* Realizar evaluaciones de riesgos y validación de controles, centrándose
  en el compromiso de identidad y las amenazas de endpoints.

* Colaborar con equipos globales y mentorizar a ingenieros para promover
  prácticas de seguridad consistentes y escalables.

CALIFICACIONES Y EXPERIENCIA

* Más de 8 años de experiencia en ingeniería de ciberseguridad.

* Sólida experiencia práctica en IAM, seguridad de endpoints y gestión de
  acceso privilegiado.

* Experiencia en entornos híbridos (on-premises y cloud).

* Capacidad para traducir principios arquitectónicos en soluciones de
  ingeniería prácticas.

* Se requiere título de Grado universitario.

* Certificaciones preferidas: CISSP, CISM o equivalente.

EXPERTISE TÉCNICO

* Gestión de Identidad y Acceso (autenticación, autorización, federación,
  gobernanza)

* Gestión de Acceso Privilegiado y aplicación del principio de mínimo
  privilegio

* Seguridad de endpoints, hardening y detección/respuesta de amenazas

* Gestión de dispositivos y cumplimiento de endpoints

* Arquitectura de Confianza Cero (Zero Trust) y modelos de seguridad
  centrados en la identidad

* Modelado de amenazas y prácticas de seguridad basadas en el riesgo

* Automatización/scripting para operaciones de seguridad

* Familiaridad con los marcos NIST, ISO y CIS

COMPETENCIAS BÁSICAS

* Liderazgo técnico y resolución de problemas práctica

* Toma de decisiones basada en el riesgo

* Colaboración entre equipos globales

* Comunicación clara y efectiva

VALORES Y CULTURA

* Actuar con integridad innegociable y mantener los más altos estándares
  profesionales.

* Demostrar curiosidad intelectual, buscando avanzar continuamente la
  postura de ingeniería de ciberseguridad de la firma.

* Encarnar la colaboración, la transparencia y la responsabilidad en todos
  los compromisos.

* Dedicado a proteger la confianza del cliente a través de la excelencia en
  seguridad y la gestión proactiva de riesgos.

REQUISITOS ESPECIALES

* Soporte ocasional fuera del horario laboral para operaciones globales

Este puesto no es elegible para patrocinio de inmigración basado en
empleo.

Los solicitantes deben estar legalmente autorizados para trabajar en los
Estados Unidos sin patrocinio del empleador, ahora o en el futuro.

IGUALDAD DE OPORTUNIDADES DE EMPLEO

Russell Investments se compromete a proporcionar igualdad de oportunidades de
empleo para todos los asociados y solicitantes de empleo, independientemente de
raza, religión, ascendencia, credo, color, género (incluida la identidad de
género, que se refiere al sexo real o percibido de una persona, e incluye la
autoimagen, apariencia, comportamiento o expresión, ya sea diferente o no de lo
tradicionalmente asociado con el sexo biológico de una persona), edad, origen
nacional, estatus de ciudadanía, discapacidad, condición médica, estatus militar,
estado de veterano, estado civil, orientación sexual, estado de desempleo
pasado o presente, o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Overview:

The Digital Workplace Engineer is part of the Digital Workplace Services team within Chatham's IT organization, focused on creating a modern, seamless technology experience for employees across the firm. This role on the team will focus on AI and automation, helping the firm scale intelligent, self-service solutions using AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Codex, alongside tools like Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and PowerShell. In this role, you'll act as a modern solution evangelist within IT, working alongside a broader network of technology champions across the firm to drive adoption of AI, automation, and modern workplace capabilities.

In this role you will:
• Serve as a modern solution evangelist within IT, partnering with a firmwide network of technology champions to promote AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools-helping employees understand practical ways to apply these solutions to their work through articles, demos, webinars, and hands-on sessions.
• Partner directly with business units to consult on process challenges, identify automation opportunities, and design and build solutions using Power Automate, Power Apps, PowerShell, and Microsoft Graph.
• Actively engage with vendors and the broader AI and automation community to stay ahead of emerging tools, techniques, and best practices, bringing new capabilities back to the firm.
• Provide insightful feedback to IT leadership on AI and automation tooling to help shape strategic product and engineering decisions.
• Partner with IT to champion standards, governance, and best practices for citizen development and AI usage across the Power Platform and beyond, including automation of identity and access workflows in Microsoft Entra ID.
• Drive adoption and best practices across the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, etc.), partnering with the broader Digital Workplace Services team on the firm's core collaboration tools.
• Take ownership of key performance indicators tied to adoption, efficiency gains, and employee engagement with AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools.
• Lead engagements with the business to understand challenges and propose solutions for process improvement and business process automation.

Your impact:
• Serve as a technical leader and modern solution evangelist, advocating for the practical adoption of AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools across the firm, in partnership with the firm's broader network of technology champions
• Lead innovation by identifying and delivering automation solutions that eliminate manual work and unlock employee capacity
• Drive business process automation through hands-on consulting, Power Platform development, and self-service enablement
• Be a key contributor to developing IT's vision and roadmap for AI, automation, and modern workplace strategy

Contributors to your success:
• 3-5+ years of experience in a similar role, with a demonstrated track record of building automation solutions and driving technology adoption.
• Exceptional communication and consulting skills, with the ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and translate them into automated solutions.
• Solid working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, etc.), with the ability to champion adoption alongside the wider Digital Workplace Services team.
• Hands-on experience developing solutions with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps), PowerShell scripting, and Microsoft Graph; familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (identity, access, and app registrations) is a plus.
• Strong emphasis on customer service and the ability to teach people of all technical abilities.
• Practical experience applying AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Codex, Cursor) to real business problems, with enthusiasm for staying current on the fast-evolving AI landscape.
• Experience with Lean process improvement is a plus

For Denver based candidates, the compensation range for the position is expected to be between $82,000 and $100,000 annually. Total compensation, including base pay, discretionary individual bonus and company bonus, may be higher than range listed, depending on applicant's skills, qualifications, and experience. Benefits include health insurance, life and disability insurance, 401k, EAP, paid holidays and paid time off.

The M365 Engineer - Modern Workplace implements, administers, and supports business-focused Microsoft 365 services across SharePoint Online, Microsoft Viva, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Azure services, and Copilot. This role partners with business and technical teams to deliver secure, reliable, well-governed collaboration, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled workplace solutions. The engineer serves as an escalation point for complex incidents and service requests, supports platform governance and adoption, and maintains documentation, standards, and automation to improve operational efficiency.

Job Description
Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. To be considered, candidates must already be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship as security clearance is required.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
Modern Workplace Platform Administration & Governance: Administer and support SharePoint Online, Microsoft Viva, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Azure services, and Copilot capabilities with an emphasis on governance, lifecycle management, reliability, and service health.

SharePoint Online & Content Collaboration: Support collaboration sites, content management, permissions, site architecture, document management, adoption, and information governance practices across SharePoint Online and related Microsoft 365 workloads.

Business Enablement & Low-Code Solutions: Partner with business stakeholders to identify automation, workflow, reporting, and digital transformation opportunities using Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot Studio, and related platform capabilities.

Microsoft Fabric & Analytics Support: Support Fabric and Power BI administration activities that enable data integration, dataflows, reporting, business intelligence, and analytics use cases in alignment with organizational governance standards.

Azure Services Management: Administer Azure services that support Modern Workplace solutions, including subscriptions, resource groups, storage accounts, serverless services, application integrations, automation, and operational governance outside of Entra ID administration.

Copilot Readiness & Adoption: Support Copilot for Microsoft 365 readiness, governance, adoption, communication, end-user enablement, and related operational processes.

Integration & Automation: Automate administrative and operational tasks using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform automation, Azure Automation, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and other scripting or integration technologies as appropriate.

Security, Compliance & Change Management: Partner with security, compliance, infrastructure, networking, and service desk teams to maintain a secure, stable, and compliant environment while supporting change management, release planning, DLP, retention, access controls, and platform governance activities.

Escalation, Documentation & Knowledge Transfer: Serve as an escalation point for complex Microsoft 365 incidents and service requests; develop and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, standards, operational procedures, training materials, and adoption resources; and mentor or provide knowledge transfer to support staff as needed.

Continuous Improvement & Microsoft Roadmap: Monitor platform health, licensing, service advisories, Message Center updates, Azure and Microsoft 365 roadmap changes, emerging AI and collaboration capabilities, and recommend improvements that strengthen reliability, security, user experience, and operational efficiency.

Bachelor’s degree in Information Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, related field, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.

EXPERIENCE:

3+ years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 in an enterprise environment.

Experience administering and governing SharePoint Online and related collaboration workloads.

Experience with Microsoft Viva, Power Platform, Power BI, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric, or similar business solution platforms.

Experience supporting Microsoft Azure services related to Modern Workplace solutions, including platform governance and application integrations.

Experience supporting Copilot for Microsoft 365 readiness, adoption, governance, or enablement activities.

Experience with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, Power Platform automation, Azure Automation, Logic Apps, REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, or similar scripting and automation technologies.

Familiarity with security and compliance concepts such as MFA, Conditional Access, DLP, retention policies, and information governance.

Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to work independently on complex incidents, problems, and service requests.

COMPETENCIES - SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/ABILITIES:

Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to business and technical audiences.

Business acumen and the ability to translate business needs into feasible Microsoft 365, Azure, automation, reporting, and collaboration solutions.

Self-directed, highly motivated, and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic enterprise environment.

Ability to quickly learn new Microsoft technologies, business processes, and platform capabilities.

Ability to partner effectively with security, compliance, networking, infrastructure, service desk, business units, and vendor partners.

Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, service health management, operational documentation, and continuous improvement practices.

Ability to obtain and maintain required security clearance.

Knowledge in the area of NIST compliance strongly desired.

ISC's HireIT Services team provides best-in-class IT service delivery in a matrix environment to clients across a diverse collection of campus organizations.

jobs.description:
Overview:

  Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai.

   Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees.
  Responsibilities:

  This position will support our newly awarded DCSA contract.

    Description

 Empower AI is seeking a MECM / SCCM Engineer to engineer and operate the Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager infrastructure that manages thousands of endpoints for a Department of War agency across Pre-Production, NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves. The engineer designs and maintains the MECM hierarchy, distribution points, boundaries, collections, client health, and reporting; engineers automated patch and software deployment, task sequences, and PXE provisioning; and validates every significant change in pre-production and the Digital Twin environment before release. As a privileged user, the engineer is a Tier III escalation resource and a primary contributor to CAT I/II/III patch compliance and RMF evidence for the endpoint environment. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

    THIS IS AN ONSITE ROLE IN QUANTICO, VA (RKB) WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

    JOB DUTIES:

  Engineer, operate, and maintain the MECM/SCCM infrastructure across enclaves: hierarchy and site health, distribution points, boundaries and boundary groups, collections, client health remediation, role-based administration, and reporting.
  Design and maintain automated deployment mechanisms (software update deployments, application deployments, task sequences, PXE/OSD provisioning) and analyze deployment results to resolve failures and improve success rates.
  Plan and validate MECM upgrades, client updates, and configuration changes in pre-production and the Digital Twin environment, and implement them through formal Change Management with rollback plans.
  Produce MECM compliance and deployment reporting (patch compliance, image deployment cycle time, client health) for the Customer Support Metrics Dashboard and provide artifacts supporting the endpoint POA&M.
  Design, engineer, test, and implement endpoint infrastructure solutions including hardened image pipelines, automated provisioning, configuration baselines, endpoint management platform enhancements, and VDI integration across multiple security enclaves.
  Support the evaluation and phased implementation of a Digital Twin capability for network and system modeling, including building and maintaining the pre-production replica, defining test procedures, and validating significant changes before production deployment.
  Develop engineering artifacts for Government approval: requirements, design documents, test plans and results, implementation and rollback plans, change packages, and as-built documentation.
  Engineer and integrate automation, AI/ML, and analytics capabilities (e.g., predictive analytics on service data, automated remediation, ServiceNow integrations) that improve support across all tiers, upon Government approval.
  Qualifications:
  REQUIREMENTS:

  Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years of related experience (an additional 4 years of related experience may be substituted for the degree).
  Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  Must have an Active Top Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T5/T5R) to start; this is a Privileged User position.
  Must be willing and able to obtain TS/SCI eligibility after start, if required by mission needs.
  Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.
  Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE, CySA+, GSEC, SSCP, or CCNA-Security).
  Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.
  Minimum of 3 years of experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or senior systems administration in an enterprise Windows environment.
  Hands-on experience with MECM/SCCM and/or Intune, Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, virtualization (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V), and PowerShell scripting.
  Experience developing engineering documentation (requirements, designs, test plans, change packages) and executing changes through formal Change Management.
  Experience applying DISA STIGs, working with ACAS/Nessus results, and supporting RMF control implementation and evidence collection.
  Understanding of IP networking, VDI, and endpoint security concepts sufficient to design and troubleshoot integrated solutions.
  Strong analytical, technical writing, and communication skills; ability to participate in an after-hours on-call rotation.

    DESIRED SKILLS:

  CompTIA Security+ CE, CySA+, or CASP+ CE; Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate; VMware VCP.
  Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or Intelligence Community environments across NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves.
  Experience building lab, pre-production, or digital twin environments for change validation and network modeling.
  Experience integrating AI/ML, RPA, or predictive analytics into IT operations, and familiarity with ServiceNow integrations and APIs.
  Familiarity with DoD Zero Trust Reference Architecture, DoDAF, and DoD ICAM Strategy.
  Experience with eMASS and RMF documentation.
  ITIL 4 Foundation certification.

   PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

   This position requires the ability to perform the below essential functions:

  Sitting for long periods
  Standing for long periods
  Ambulate throughout an office
  Ambulate between several buildings

It is the policy of Empower AI not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status. Empower AI is a VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

jobs.description:
About the position

The MDM Systems Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the end-to-end integration workflows, automated data pipelines, and system architectures that power our Master Data Management (MDM) ecosystem. Operating at the intersection of data engineering, platform architecture, and business domain requirements, this role ensures seamless, governed data flows (\"Data as a Service\") between our primary Product Information Management platform (IPIM/Precisely/EnterWorks), Snowflake data warehouse, and downstream consumers (Salesforce, E-Commerce, Tableau). The ideal candidate combines hands-on SQL and data engineering principles with strong systems analysis experience to optimize the master data lifecycle and drive operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Design, implement, and maintain scalable batch and real-time data integration pipelines (APIs, ETL/ELT) connecting source systems (Mainframe, legacy SQL) to MDM/PIM platforms and Snowflake.Map data lineage, JSON/REST API payloads, and complex business transformation rules across enterprise boundaries to deliver clean, synchronized master data sets.Lead efforts to transition legacy, decentralized transformations (Alteryx, local SQL scripts) into optimized Snowflake cloud tables and automated orchestration workflows.Supervise and maintain structural data integrity, global taxonomy hierarchies, and attribute schemas within enterprise PIM/MDM platforms (e.g., Enter Works, Precisely or similar), enforcing automated validation rules and business logic.Write intermediate-to-advanced SQL queries and profiling scripts to perform automated data validation, backend regression testing, and anomaly detection across staging and production environments.Configure and manage outbound data syndication feeds to downstream enterprise applications, including Salesforce, e-commerce platforms, and reporting layers.Deconstruct complex business requirements, stakeholder asks, and domain rules into explicit technical specifications, system flow diagrams, and actionable Jira sprint tasks.Investigate and resolve high-priority data pipeline failures, sync gaps, and integration anomalies submitted via ITSM tools (Ivanti) and Jira, enforcing target SLAs.Evaluate downstream technical and reporting impacts prior to executing schema updates, taxonomy modifications, or API ingestion changes.Maintain detailed technical documentation, system flows, and data dictionaries in Confluence.Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software/Data Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent professional experience).2–5 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, integration engineering, or systems analysis within an enterprise MDM, PIM, or cloud data warehouse environment.Strong proficiency writing complex SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions) for database validation, pipeline profiling, and schema analysis.Hands-on experience with enterprise MDM/PIM platforms (EnterWorks, Informatica, or similar) and cloud data platforms (Snowflake).Solid understanding of APIs (REST/GraphQL, JSON/XML), ETL/ELT pipeline mechanics, and automated data orchestration.Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and service desk tools (Ivanti or similar) for managing sprint backlogs and incident tickets.Strong systems thinking and analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to bridge communications seamlessly between data engineering teams and non-technical business partners.

Job Description:

Overview:

We don't simply hire employees. We invest in them. When you work at Chatham, we empower you - offering professional development opportunities to help you grow in your career, no matter if you've been here for five months or 15 years. Chatham has worked hard to create a distinct work environment that values people, teamwork, integrity, and client service. You will have immediate opportunities to partner with talented subject matter experts, work on complex projects, and contribute to the value Chatham delivers every day.

The Digital Workplace Engineer is part of the Digital Workplace Services team within Chatham's IT organization, focused on creating a modern, seamless technology experience for employees across the firm. This role on the team will focus on AI and automation, helping the firm scale intelligent, self-service solutions using AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Codex, alongside tools like Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and PowerShell. In this role, you'll act as a modern solution evangelist within IT, working alongside a broader network of technology champions across the firm to drive adoption of AI, automation, and modern workplace capabilities.

In this role you will:

 Serve as a modern solution evangelist within IT, partnering with a firmwide network of technology champions to promote AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools-helping employees understand practical ways to apply these solutions to their work through articles, demos, webinars, and hands-on sessions.

 Partner directly with business units to consult on process challenges, identify automation opportunities, and design and build solutions using Power Automate, Power Apps, PowerShell, and Microsoft Graph.

 Actively engage with vendors and the broader AI and automation community to stay ahead of emerging tools, techniques, and best practices, bringing new capabilities back to the firm.

 Provide insightful feedback to IT leadership on AI and automation tooling to help shape strategic product and engineering decisions.

 Partner with IT to champion standards, governance, and best practices for citizen development and AI usage across the Power Platform and beyond, including automation of identity and access workflows in Microsoft Entra ID.

 Drive adoption and best practices across the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, etc.), partnering with the broader Digital Workplace Services team on the firm's core collaboration tools.

 Take ownership of key performance indicators tied to adoption, efficiency gains, and employee engagement with AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools.

 Lead engagements with the business to understand challenges and propose solutions for process improvement and business process automation.

Your impact:

 Serve as a technical leader and modern solution evangelist, advocating for the practical adoption of AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools across the firm, in partnership with the firm's broader network of technology champions

 Lead innovation by identifying and delivering automation solutions that eliminate manual work and unlock employee capacity

 Drive business process automation through hands-on consulting, Power Platform development, and self-service enablement

 Be a key contributor to developing IT's vision and roadmap for AI, automation, and modern workplace strategy

Contributors to your success:

 3-5+ years of experience in a similar role, with a demonstrated track record of building automation solutions and driving technology adoption.

 Exceptional communication and consulting skills, with the ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and translate them into automated solutions.

 Solid working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, etc.), with the ability to champion adoption alongside the wider Digital Workplace Services team.

 Hands-on experience developing solutions with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps), PowerShell scripting, and Microsoft Graph; familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (identity, access, and app registrations) is a plus.

 Strong emphasis on customer service and the ability to teach people of all technical abilities.

 Practical experience applying AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Codex, Cursor) to real business problems, with enthusiasm for staying current on the fast-evolving AI landscape.

 Experience with Lean process improvement is a plus

For Denver based candidates, the compensation range for the position is expected to be between $82,000 and $100,000 annually. Total compensation, including base pay, discretionary individual bonus and company bonus, may be higher than range listed, depending on applicant's skills, qualifications, and experience. Benefits include health insurance, life and disability insurance, 401k, EAP, paid holidays and paid time off.

About Chatham Financial:

Chatham Financial is the leading independent capital markets advisor, delivering an integrated blend of expert advice and powerful technology to help you reduce risk and seize opportunity. With decades of capital markets strategy, execution, monitoring, and performance expertise, we serve as an unwavering advocate for your best interests and your innovation partner. It's clear ahead.

Our commitment is to carry that light forward in every partnership, every solution, and every market we serve.

We help guide the way-giving clients the insight and momentum to move forward with confidence, no matter what lies ahead.

Position Purpose:

The Home Depot is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to join the IT Endpoint Engineering and Security team. This role develops, maintains, and supports enterprise endpoint infrastructure, platforms, and services across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.

The Senior Systems Engineer will support technologies spanning endpoint management, patch management, software delivery, vulnerability remediation, endpoint security, configuration management, and automation. Relevant platforms may include Tanium, Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), Microsoft Intune, Broadcom Altiris, BigFix, Ivanti, or similar enterprise endpoint management and software distribution technologies.

This engineer will partner with architecture, security, infrastructure, and operations teams to continuously improve and mature endpoint services through strategic initiatives, automation, and operational improvements.

Senior Systems Engineers are expected to leverage enterprise tooling, scripting, automation, telemetry, and custom applications to monitor service health, optimize performance, troubleshoot complex issues, and improve the reliability and scalability of endpoint services.

The role may participate in an on-call rotation supporting routine upgrades, platform maintenance, application support, security remediation, root cause analysis, and post-mortem reviews related to service interruptions or security incidents.

The Senior Systems Engineer is expected to operate independently while also serving as a technical mentor to other engineers. Based on their experience,

Senior Engineers will help establish engineering standards, create and improve operational processes, lead technical initiatives, and ensure engineering and operational best practices are followed.

- 3–5 years of relevant engineering experience.

- Professional experience as a Systems Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Endpoint Engineer, Security Engineer, or similar technical role.

- Experience monitoring and troubleshooting Windows, macOS, and/or Linux endpoints, including operating system configuration, application behavior, system performance, and connectivity.

- Experience troubleshooting endpoint-to-server and endpoint-to-cloud network communications.

- Experience supporting enterprise infrastructure and application services, including databases and supporting platform components.

- Experience with operating system command-line utilities and scripting or automation technologies such as PowerShell, Python, Bash/Shell scripting, or similar languages.

- Experience working as part of a collaborative, cross-functional engineering organization.

- Experience operating or delivering a production service and providing recommendations related to service strategy, architecture, reliability, scalability, and continuous improvement.

- Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to perform root cause analysis across complex enterprise environments.

- Experience with endpoint management technologies such as Tanium, SCCM/MECM, Intune, Altiris, BigFix, Ivanti, or similar platforms.

- Experience with endpoint security technologies including Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR), anti-malware, application control/allowlisting, file integrity monitoring, vulnerability management, or device management.

- Experience with endpoint security products such as CrowdStrike, Carbon Black, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Palo Alto Cortex, or similar technologies.

- Experience integrating vulnerability management and endpoint management platforms to automate identification and remediation of vulnerabilities.

- Experience managing physical and virtual infrastructure and troubleshooting network, systems, application, or security-related issues.

- Familiarity with software troubleshooting tools, runtime analysis, application dependencies, software packaging, and software update technologies.

- Experience supporting large-scale enterprise environments with thousands of endpoints or servers.

- Experience supporting highly available or 24x7 production environments, particularly retail or other distributed enterprise environments.

As part of the Corporate IT team, you will keep identity, devices and tools running smoothly for the whole company.
