jobs.description:
****Descripción del Puesto:**** En TD SYNNEX estamos expandiendo la práctica de Endpoint en MCA y buscamos un Account Manager que lidere el desarrollo del negocio multimarca de Endpoint (PCs, notebooks, monitores, periféricos, impresión y otras soluciones de usuario final; excluye Advanced Solutions). Tendrás a cargo una cartera definida de partners y cuentas clave, con foco en maximizar ingresos, rentabilidad y nuevas líneas de negocio. Serás un referente para nuestros socios del canal, impulsando planificación de cuentas, generación de pipeline, gestión de licitaciones y adopción de nuestras plataformas digitales.

****Lo que harás:****

* Desarrollar y hacer crecer la cartera de partners: planificación de cuenta, mapeo de decisores, detección de oportunidades y activación de campañas.
* Ser una persona de confianza para los clientes, manteniendo relaciones estratégicas con visitas presenciales periódicas.
* Diseñar y ejecutar planes estratégicos para impulsar el negocio actual y el crecimiento incremental.
* Identificar, registrar y hacer seguimiento de oportunidades (pipeline) asegurando la calidad del funnel y el cumplimiento de metas.
* Coordinar recursos internos y liderar la interacción con Inside Sales, Operaciones de Venta y las Unidades de Negocio Especialistas (SBUs).
* Identificar oportunidades/proyectos conjuntamente con los BDM y equipos de Vendor Management.
* Relevar requerimientos del cliente y elaborar propuestas que agreguen valor, protegiendo el margen y el mix de productos/soluciones.
* Gestionar licitaciones y concursos (sector público y privado), coordinando inventario, plazos y documentación.
* Monitorear inventario y forecast, articulando con operaciones y vendors para asegurar disponibilidad y niveles de servicio.
* Detectar necesidades y problemas del cliente, resolviéndolos o escalándolos a las áreas correspondientes.
* Obtener insights mediante el perfilado y análisis de la cartera, generando acciones para maximizar oportunidades y expandir la base de partners.
* Completar en tiempo y forma el reporte y la administración en los sistemas de TD SYNNEX (CRM, reportes, profiling).
* Impulsar el uso de la plataforma de e‑commerce de TD SYNNEX (InTouch), promoviendo sus beneficios y aumentando la adopción.
* Mantener y mejorar los acuerdos de nivel de servicio (SLAs) con clientes y áreas internas.
* Operar bajo las mejores prácticas, políticas y objetivos de TD SYNNEX, asegurando el cumplimiento normativo y ético.

**Lo que buscamos**

* 3 años de experiencia relevante en ventas B2B o gestión de cuentas en la industria de tecnología (mayorista, fabricante u OEM, o reseller), preferentemente en categorías de Endpoint (computación personal, impresión, periféricos, colaboración).
* Red de relaciones y cartera activa en el canal de Argentina, con historial comprobable de desarrollo de partners y crecimiento de cuentas.
* Experiencia multimarca y trabajo con vendors/OEMs; capacidad para priorizar y balancear portafolio protegiendo margen.
* Sólida gestión de pipeline, pronóstico, negociación y cierre; dominio de CRM (ideal Salesforce) y Excel/herramientas de análisis.
* Experiencia en gestión de licitaciones y concursos, deseable con conocimiento del sector público.
* Enfoque a resultados, autonomía, capacidad de influencia sin autoridad formal y colaboración transversal.
* Habilidad para trabajo en campo con viajes frecuentes dentro del país.
* Inglés intermedio/avanzado para interactuar con equipos regionales y materiales de vendors.

**Será un plus**

* Experiencia previa en mayoristas o vendors líderes de Endpoint
* Haber impulsado adopción de plataformas de e‑commerce B2B; conocimiento previo de InTouch.

****Las condiciones de trabajo:****

* Entorno Profesional de Oficina (Híbrido).
* Horas de trabajo no estándar, según lo requiera el negocio.

Tú qué sacas de esto?

* **Aprovecha al máximo nuestra Organización Global:**establece contactos con otros nuevos compañeros de trabajo dentro de sus primeros 30 días a través de nuestro programa de incorporación.
* **Haz crecer tu carrera:**nuestra primera prioridad es contratar internamente y ayudar a nuestra gente a crecer. Como compañero de trabajo, tendrás más oportunidades profesionales disponibles. También puedes acelerar su camino hacia el éxito con programas formales sobre liderazgo y desarrollo profesional, y muchos más cursos a pedido.
* **Trabaja con proveedores de clase mundial:**nuestros representantes de televentas actuales están trabajando con algunas de las marcas más importantes en tecnología.
* **Eleva tu bienestar personal:**aumenta tu bienestar financiero, físico y mental a través de seminarios, eventos y nuestro Programa global de asistencia para el empoderamiento de la vida (LEAP por sus siglas en Inglés).
* **Diversidad, equidad e inclusión:** no es solo una frase para nosotros; valorando cada voz es cómo tenemos éxito. Únete a nosotros para celebrar nuestra diversidad global a través de educación inclusiva, conversaciones significativas entre pares y oportunidades equitativas de crecimiento y desarrollo.

¿No cumples con todos los requisitos? Aplica de todos modos:

En TD SYNNEX, estamos orgullosos de ser reconocidos como un excelente lugar para trabajar y líder en la promoción y práctica de la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión.

Si está entusiasmado por trabajar para nuestra empresa y cree que es un buen candidato para este puesto, lo alentamos a que presente su solicitud.

¡Puedes ser exactamente la persona que estamos buscando!

At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.

**What's In It For You?**

* **Elective Benefits:** Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
* **Grow Your Career:**Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
* **Elevate Your Personal Well-Being:** Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
* **Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion:**It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
* **Make the Most of our Global Organization**: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
* **Connect with Your Community:** Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.

**Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.**At TD SYNNEX, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!

Whether your next career chapter involves making memories for guests or supporting our properties in our Corporate Office, every role---from Guest Services to Finance, Culinary to IT---offers opportunities to grow and make a meaningful impact.

* Competitive health \& wellness benefits, 401(k) \& company match

* Paid Sick Days, Vacation, and Holidays, Paid Bereavement, Paid Pet Bereavement

* Training \& Development opportunities, career growth

* Tuition Reimbursement

* Pet Insurance

**What We're Looking For**:

A motivated security professional eager to contribute to the improvement of Loews Hotels' security posture. An individual with a strong security background, committed to continuous learning and the implementation of innovative solutions. An Engineer who is ready to collaborate closely with other members of the Security Operations and IT Service teams to deploy robust security measures across the enterprise. Reporting to the Manager, Endpoint Security Operations, this role serves as a significant contributor to the development, implementation, and maintenance of endpoint security solutions that safeguard against cyber threats and vulnerabilities.

**Who You Are**:

* A highly motivated and results driven self-starter

* An IT security enthusiast who is passionate about technology and problem solving

* A service-oriented team player who works well in a dynamic, fast paced environment

* An excellent communicator with an ability to adapt to the communication style of others

* A continuous learner that stays abreast of industry knowledge and technology

* Veterans and military spouses encouraged to apply

**What You'll Do**:

* Provide subject matter expertise on endpoint security technologies including the design, configuration, integration and deployment of enterprise security software and infrastructure

* Enhance and maintain endpoint security platforms and processes including Anti-Virus, Anti Malware, Encryption, System Hardening, EDR, MDM, Web Content Management, DNS Security, Identity Solutions SIEM and Patch Management

* Perform threat analysis, monitor security events for signs of security breaches and triage any suspicious behavior

* Ensure security solutions, policies and procedures are sufficient to meet and respond to threats to our data and endpoint infrastructure. Recommend and provide technical support processes, metrics, and SLAs

* Maintain and enforce endpoint security policies and standards in alignment with corporate Governance, Security-Risk and Audit policies, procedures, industry regulation, best practices, and security frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, CIS)

* Create and Deliver reports pertaining to endpoint security and compliance

* Support and document the implementation of approved endpoint security software and infrastructure components

* Oversee projects from inception to closure ensuring completion according to business requirements and stakeholder standards

* Ensure compliance with corporate Governance, Security-Risk and Audit policies, procedures, and best practices

* Perform continuous mentorship and development of junior staff members; serve as a point of contact for escalation and engagement

* Develop technical documentation, policies, and procedures for endpoint security application use and support; communicate technical standards to Information Technology teams and junior team members

* Regular attendance in conformance with standards

* May be required to work varying schedules to reflect business needs

* Required to attend all mandatory training sessions and meetings

* Demonstrate a proactive approach towards work activities

* Manage multiple projects to timely, successful completion

* Perform other duties as assigned

**Your Qualifications Include**:

* 5+ years of experience in Information Security in an enterprise environment

* 2+ years of experience as a technical project lead and primary support role

* Extensive hands-on experience and expertise in endpoint security technologies and solutions to include:

* Privileged Access Management

* Endpoint Privilege Management

* Threat hunting and remediation

* Exploit mitigation

* Vulnerability assessment, management, and monitoring tools

* Anti-virus/malware telemetry

* Configuration and operation of Windows/MAC/Linux operating systems

* Triaging security events from SIEM and other security appliances

* Identity and cyber security software-based tools, audits and compliance

* Incident response, documentation, and reporting

* Mobile device management, Cloud, security, and investigations

* Network protocols -- IP, DHCP, DNS

* Microsoft Active Directory, Azure Active Directory and associated components

* Web Content Management

* Patch Management and RMM
* Strong knowledge of host and networked based attack methodologies

* Solid understanding of various governance frameworks such as ITIL and NIST

* Expertise in endpoint security best practices

* Knowledge of network and firewall infrastructure

* Preferred experience and certifications:

*

* Knowledge of Security Technologies from Ivanti, Sentinel One, Palo Alto Networks, Sophos, Cisco Umbrella and Idira (formerly CyberArk)

*

* Experience in retail, travel, restaurants, or hospitality

*

* Experience in compliance with PCI and SOX

*

* Microsoft Security Certifications

* Must be able to safely lift and carry computer equipment (computers, monitors, servers, switches, firewalls, etc.)

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex security issues

* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams

* Ability and willingness to work a flexible schedule to include weekends and holidays

* Must be willing to travel domestically or abroad up to 20% of the time

jobs.title: Systems Development Engineer II
jobs.summary: At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers...
jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

 What you'll do at Jamf:

In this role the Systems Development Engineer II at Jamf is responsible for automation and development of our backend infrastructure that powers the Jamf Cloud that our customers rely on to manage Apple devices in their organizations. This includes providing the internal infrastructure that our Software Development Engineers use to build and deploy Jamf products in the Cloud.

  You may be required to work periodically at a Jamf office or collaborative work location with other Jamf employees in your area for certain events or moments that matter.

  What you can expect to do in this role :

- Develop, deploy, and maintain production environments by identifying and applying automation, tools, and techniques such as Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, Serverless, and Containerization

- Ensure security best practices are identified and integrated into system designs and configuration

- Assist in evaluating, planning, configuration, and implementation of new software services

- Develop custom tools and automation through programming and scripting.

- Support Software Development by maintaining and scaling our Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery environment as needed

- Apply Data Lifecycle Management to sensitive data through backups, permissions management, and auditing

- Participate in an on-call rotation, triaging and escalating alerts, and assisting in disaster recovery as necessary for services the team is responsible for

- Member of an Agile Team providing code reviews, velocity estimation, planning input, and participating in other Agile Methodology workflows

- Work and communicate effectively with Product Owners, Development teams, and Cloud and Delivery teams

- Create and maintain technical documentation

- Performs other duties as required and completes all job functions as per departmental policies and procedures

- #LIRemote

 What we are looking for:

- Minimum of 2 year experience in one or more of (Required):

  - Continuous Integration Tools and Techniques (e.g. Jenkins, Bamboo, Github Actions)

  - Configuration management and deployment tools (e.g. Ansible, Chef, Puppet).

  - Systems Administration or similar role focused on performance analysis, capacity planning, and forecasting.

- Minimum of 2 year experience as a power user of various operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows, Mac) (Required).

- Minimum of 2 year experience in a current programming language (e.g. Python, Golang) (Required)

- Minimum of 2 year experience using Source Control Management tools (e.g. Git, Subversion) (Required).

- Minimum of 2 year experience using issue tracking software (e.g. JIRA) (Preferred).

- Experience developing enterprise grade software with understanding of the software development life cycle (Preferred).

- Experience with infrastructure as code techniques (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation) (Preferred)

- Experience in enterprise security and hardening best practices (Preferred).

- Experience building and maintaining cloud native services (e.g. Amazon Web Services, Azure, GCP) (Preferred)

- Experience working with monitoring and logging tools (e.g. LogicMonitor, Sumologic, ELK) (Preferred)

- Experience with containerization concepts and Kubernetes (Preferred)

- Experience working with structured databases (e.g. MySQL, DynamoDB) (Preferred)

- Hands-on experience with AI-driven coding assistants like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, others to enhance development productivity.

- 4 year / Bachelor's Degree (Preferred)

- A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered.

- Certificates commonly held by those in the role include one or more of: LPIC-1, LPIC-2, LPIC-3, RHCE (RedHat Certified Engineer), AWS Solutions Architect Associate, AWS Certified Developer Associate, AWS Certified SysOps Associate. (Preferred)

 SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

- Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory

- Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches

- Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf

 OTHER REQUIREMENTS

- This position will perform work that the U.S. government has specified can only be performed by a U.S. citizen located physically in the U.S., and therefore any employment offer will be contingent upon verification of both of these requirements. Applicants who are not U.S. citizens or who are located outside of the U.S. are strongly encouraged to apply for other positions at Jamf, which is an equal-opportunity employer.

 How we help you reach your best potential:

- Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News

- Named a 2024 Best Technology Company to Work For by U.S. News

- Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024

- Named a 2024 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News

- Our developers work in agile delivery teams to produce new features, improve software components, and are the subject matter experts for our Jamf product offerings.

- You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.

- We constantly push the boundaries of technology, our developers support new innovations and OS releases the moment they are made available by Apple.

- Several Jamf engineers are named in patents and with team names like CatDog, ThunderSnow and Dalek you can expect to have some fun while building cutting-edge software.

- You will have the opportunity to work with a small and empowered team where the culture is based on trust, ownership, and respect.

- We offer a clear career path that enables you to grow under supportive leadership and management

- Visit our Jamf Engineering blog to learn more about the innovative projects our team is working on and what we learn from each challenge we solve. A blog written by engineers, for engineers at medium.com/jamf-engineering

- 22 of 25 world’s most valuable brands rely on Jamf to do their best work (as ranked by Forbes).

- Over 100,000 Jamf Nation users, the largest online IT community in the world.

 Pay Transparency

At Jamf, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

The national pay transparency range below represents all U.S. locations and accounts for geographic differences in pay, resulting in a broader range.

National Pay Transparency Range

 $93,700 - $169,840 USD

 What it means to be a Jamf?
 We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

 What does Jamf do?
 Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

If you need an accommodation, please contact your Recruiter or Recruiting Coordinator directly. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager. Jamf is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against individuals who request reasonable accommodation for disability or religious beliefs. To request accommodations please email us at recruiting@jamf.com

jobs.title: Sr IT Systems Administrator
jobs.summary: Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by...
jobs.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.

With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai

About the Role

Waabi is seeking an Sr IT Systems Administrator to join our growing IT Operations team and provide hands-on technology support for our San Francisco, CA site while helping scale IT operations across all Waabi locations.

This is a high-ownership, onsite role focused on ensuring employees have reliable, secure, and efficient technology experiences. You will support day-to-day IT operations, manage endpoint and identity systems, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and partner with teams across the organization to deliver scalable solutions.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on problem solver who enjoys working across multiple layers of IT, from supporting users and managing endpoints to maintaining office infrastructure and improving IT processes. You will collaborate closely with the broader IT team to provide remote support to other Waabi locations and participate in the IT Support on-call rotation.

You will…

End User Support & IT Operations
Provide onsite technical support for employees at the San Francisco, CA location, including hardware, software, networking, and access issues
Serve as a trusted IT partner for local teams, providing timely troubleshooting and solutions
Support remote users and collaborate with IT team members across other Waabi locations
Participate in the IT Support on-call rotation to provide after-hours support as needed
Manage incidents and requests through Jira Service Management, ensuring timely resolution and clear communication
Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures
Endpoint Management & Device Lifecycle
Administer endpoint management platforms for Windows, macOS, and Linux devices
Support device enrollment, configuration profiles, security policies, application deployment, and compliance reporting
Assist with zero-touch deployment processes using technologies such as Windows Autopilot and Apple Business Manager/Automated Device Enrollment
Manage workstation lifecycle including provisioning, configuration, troubleshooting, replacement, and retirement
Support mobile device management and secure BYOD access workflows
Maintain accurate hardware inventory and asset management records
Identity & Access Management
Support user lifecycle management including onboarding, offboarding, account provisioning, and access changes
Manage and administer identity, access, and collaboration platforms such as Okta, Google Workspace, or similar systems
Support group management, permissions, and access policies
Assist with SSO integrations and SaaS application access management
Help implement secure access practices aligned with company security requirements
Site Infrastructure & Workplace Technology
Own day-to-day IT operations for the San Francisco office, including:
Workstations and peripherals
Printers and print services
Conference room technology and A/V systems
Network connectivity troubleshooting
Physical IT infrastructure
Support wired and wireless network troubleshooting, including switches, patch panels, and cabling
Partner with Facilities and vendors on office technology projects, expansions, and improvements
Assist with deployment and maintenance of physical technology infrastructure
Support specialized engineering and lab environments as needed
Linux Systems & Server Administration
Administer, patch, and maintain Linux servers and workstations supporting engineering, R&D, and office environments
Manage user accounts, permissions, and configuration via standard Linux tooling and scripting (Bash/Python)
Support Linux-based endpoint provisioning, imaging, and configuration management for engineering and lab users
Monitor system health, logs, and performance, and troubleshoot Linux-specific issues across compute and networked storage
Maintain security hardening, patch management, and compliance for Linux systems
Security & Compliance Support
Support implementation and maintenance of endpoint security standards and controls
Assist with device compliance monitoring, patch management, and security remediation activities
Follow established security processes and help improve operational controls
Support audits and compliance initiatives through documentation, reporting, and evidence collection
Partner with security teams to investigate and remediate endpoint-related issues
Process Improvement & IT Scaling
Identify opportunities to improve IT workflows, automation, and employee experience
Contribute to scalable processes that support Waabi’s growth
Improve documentation, knowledge sharing, and support practices across the IT organization
Qualifications
5+ years of experience in IT systems administration, desktop support, or IT operations roles
Experience supporting Windows and macOS environments in a business setting
Experience administering endpoint management tools such as Microsoft Intune, JumpCloud, Jamf, or similar platforms
Experience with identity and access management concepts, including user provisioning, permissions, and authentication
Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, networking, and user-facing technologies
Experience supporting onsite office infrastructure, including networking, printers, conferencing systems, and peripherals
Ability to prioritize multiple requests while maintaining excellent customer service
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to document technical processes clearly and with a customer service mindset
Willingness to participate in an IT support on-call rotation
Ability to lift and move material up to ~50 pounds
Experience supporting a multi-site organization with both onsite and remote users
Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, Okta, or similar identity platforms
Experience with SSO integrations using SAML and SCIM
Experience with automation and scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar)
Familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, or SOC 2
Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment
Bonus
Experience working in startups
Passionate about self-driving technologies, solving hard problems, and creating innovative solutions

The US yearly salary range for this role is: $115,000 - $135,000 USD in addition to competitive perks & benefits. Waabi US Inc.’s yearly salary ranges are determined based on several factors in accordance with the Company’s compensation practices. Note: The Company provides additional compensation for employees in this role, including equity incentive awards and an annual performance bonus.

Perks/Benefits:
Waabi provides a competitive benefits package that includes:
Competitive compensation and equity awards.
Health and wellness benefits encompassing Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
Paid parental, medical and family care leave.
Generous PTO Policy.
Retirement savings plans including 401(k) or RRSP options.
Health savings account contribution options.
Daily drinks, snacks, and catered meals (when in office).
Regularly scheduled team building activities and social events both on-site, off-site & virtually.
Additional benefits are offered and tailored to specific country locations.
As we grow, this list continues to evolve!

Waabi is a technology start-up building technologies to transform the way the world moves. Join our talented team to be a part of the future and to make an impact!

Waabi is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a supportive, inclusive, and accessible workplace for all our employees. We seek applicants of all backgrounds and identities, across race, color, ethnicity, national origin or ancestry, age, citizenship, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military or veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or parental status, caregiver status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. We make workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process please let our recruiting team know.

Position: Desktop Engineer

Location: Danvers, MA – Onsite

Duration: Long-Term Contract

Job Summary:

We are seeking a hands-on Desktop Engineer to support IT operations within a manufacturing/laboratory environment. jobs.description:
About The Team

OpenAI’s Client Platform Engineering (CPE) team delivers trusted devices at scale: secure by default, reliable by design, and effortless to use. We own platform capabilities across macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, and Linux, spanning endpoint posture and device trust, application delivery, onboarding, updates, telemetry, workflow orchestration, and employee-facing remediation. The team partners deeply with Security, Research, Applied, and specialized engineering groups to enable and protect OpenAI while reducing friction for the people advancing our mission.

About The Role

As an Engineering Manager for CPE, you will lead a team of engineers responsible for the strategy, delivery, and operation of OpenAI’s cross-platform client foundation. You will combine people leadership with strong technical judgment: setting direction, developing engineers, reviewing architecture and tradeoffs, and creating the operating mechanisms that turn ambiguous needs into durable platform outcomes. This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of security, reliability, developer velocity, and employee experience.

CPE is a highly technical platform engineering organization delivering first-party services, automation, observability, and safe fleet operations. We’re looking for a leader who can guide its next chapter, scaling the team and its systems, partnering across the company, and raising the bar for secure, reliable, low-friction experiences across every supported platform.

In This Role, You Will

Lead and develop a high-performing engineering team; hire thoughtfully, coach engineers, create clarity, and foster an inclusive, high-accountability culture that pushes perceived limits.Define and execute a multi-year client-platform strategy and roadmap across macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, and Linux, including how Codex and agents can reshape employee computing.Provide technical direction for endpoint posture, device trust, application delivery, device onboarding, updates, fleet telemetry, workflow orchestration, and employee-facing remediation. Lead the team to rethink the platform from first principles as Codex and agent capabilities advance: what software needs to be built, what agents can own end to end, and which employee workflows no longer need to exist.Guide architecture and engineering tradeoffs across first-party services, open-source tooling, SaaS platforms, IaC/GitOps, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure. Decide what to build, buy, standardize, retire, or redesign as AI changes what the platform can do.Establish clear goals, ownership, planning, design reviews, and execution rhythms that let the team move quickly without sacrificing quality.Raise the bar for reliability and evidence-backed security through observability, drift detection, staged rollouts, release gates, rollback paths, incident learning, runbooks, and healthy operational ownership. Use telemetry to see friction, measure outcomes, and improve before issues become tickets.Partner with Security, IT, Research, Applied, Product, and specialized engineering teams to align priorities and land company-wide changes, dogfood OpenAI products in real employee workflows, and continuously improve internal platforms.Balance strong security and compliance controls with developer velocity, employee experience, and operational simplicity. Define where agents can act, where humans approve, and how actions are evaluated, audited, and reversed.Use adoption, reliability, evidence-backed security posture, data freshness, employee experience, workflow completion, friction, agent effectiveness, and operational-load metrics to steer investment and communicate impact.Partner with IT and Security teams to compound CPE’s impact across employee experience, security posture, and operational scale.

You may be a fit for this role if you have:

Built and led teams that owned secure, reliable, mission critical services and infrastructure at scale, from strategy through production operations.Delivered internal platforms, tooling, and services that materially improved reliability, security, and employee experience.Made sound software and infrastructure engineering decisions at scale. Deep endpoint expertise is strongly preferred.Raised production readiness through direct technical review of architecture, automation, code, IaC/GitOps, CI/CD, observability, and operational tradeoffs.Operated infrastructure with material security or identity risk through staged rollouts, incidents, and decisions that balanced risk, compliance, and employee or developer experience.Committed to joining the team’s engineering on call rotation after ramp up and using firsthand operational context to improve reliability and reduce toil.Built inclusive teams that do excellent work, communicated with clarity and candor, and influenced partners across Security, IT, and Product/Engineering.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You Have

Deep experience with one or more client-platform tool ecosystems such as Jamf, Intune, Android Enterprise, FleetDM/osquery, Munki/AutoPkg, or Linux configuration management.Experience building internal platforms or services for app delivery, device posture/trust, onboarding, notifications, workflow orchestration, or fleet telemetry.Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, Terraform, Kubernetes/containers, service orchestration, and large-scale observability.Experience partnering with security, compliance, or privacy teams in high-assurance environments.Experience supporting research, developer, robotics, hardware-lab, or other specialized computing environments.A record of contributing to open-source tooling, engineering communities, or cross-company technical standards.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

jobs.description:
The Microsoft Configuration Management Engineer is responsible for engineering, administering, maintaining, and improving enterprise endpoint management services using Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) and Microsoft Intune. The engineer supports the full lifecycle of Windows endpoint management, including application packaging and deployment, operating system deployment, software patching, configuration management, compliance monitoring, vulnerability remediation, and endpoint troubleshooting across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud-managed environments. To join our team of outstanding professionals, apply today!

This position maintains and optimizes Configuration Manager and Intune capabilities, including device collections, task sequences, configuration items and baselines, software update deployments, application packages, compliance policies, configuration profiles, security baselines, and Windows update policies. The engineer works closely with enterprise architects, cloud engineers, cybersecurity teams, service desk personnel, and system owners to sustain existing services and support the transition of appropriate endpoint-management capabilities to Microsoft Intune and Azure-based services.

The engineer plans, schedules, executes, monitors, and validates endpoint deployments and remediation activities using enterprise reporting, endpoint telemetry, client diagnostics, and management tools. The position also supports endpoint-management infrastructure and develops the technical documentation necessary to ensure operational continuity, configuration control, auditability, security compliance, and effective lifecycle management.

Responsibilities

Administer and support Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) and Microsoft Intune, including application deployment, software updates, device collections, configuration profiles, compliance policies, security baselines, reporting, and client troubleshooting.

Package, test, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows applications across SCCM/MECM- and Intune-managed endpoints.

Plan and execute enterprise patching and update-management activities, including software update groups, automatic deployment rules, maintenance windows, phased deployments, update rings, feature updates, quality updates, and compliance reporting.

Support Windows operating system deployment and provisioning, including task sequences, PXE and boot media, driver management, imaging, Windows Autopilot, and deployment troubleshooting.

Develop and maintain device collections, configuration items, and compliance baselines to identify configuration drift, support targeted deployments, measure compliance, and automate remediation.

Troubleshoot endpoint-management issues using Configuration Manager logs, Intune monitoring data, Event Viewer, CMPivot, client diagnostics, PowerShell, and related administrative tools.

Support endpoint identity and security integration with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy, Conditional Access dependencies, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and enterprise security baselines.

Coordinate with cybersecurity and vulnerability-management teams to validate findings, identify affected endpoints, implement remediation actions, and track compliance through closure.

Develop PowerShell scripts and use Microsoft Graph, Graph PowerShell, REST APIs, and related automation capabilities to improve endpoint administration, reporting, remediation, and operational efficiency.

Support SCCM/MECM infrastructure, co-management, and migration to modern cloud-based endpoint management while following established change, configuration, release, documentation, and operational-readiness processes.

Qualifications

Active Top Secret security clearance.Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity, information systems, or a related field. Significant additional relevant endpoint-management or systems-administration experience may be considered as a substitute for a B.S. degree. Minimum of five (5) years of experience administering enterprise Windows endpoint-management services, including SCCM/MECM, Intune, or comparable endpoint-management platforms. IAT Level II Certification or equivalent.Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or the ability to obtain the certification within 6 months of employment. This certification ensures our lead engineer has the enterprise endpoint deployment, application management, policy administration, update management, monitoring, reporting, Intune, Entra ID, PowerShell, and related endpoint operations. Preferred Certifications:

Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate.Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, or a relevant cybersecurity, IT service management, or systems-administration certification.

$145,000 - $150,000
Benefits

Regular - The company offers a comprehensive benefits program, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(k) and a range of other voluntary benefits. Paid Time Off (PTO) is offered to regular full-time and part-time employees.
Company Description

Work Where it Matters

Suvi, an Akima company, is not just another federal mission services contractor. As an Alaska Native Corporation (ANC), our mission and purpose extend beyond our exciting federal projects as we support our shareholder communities in Alaska.

At Suvi, the work you do every day makes a difference in the lives of our 15,000 Iñupiat shareholders, a group of Alaska natives from one of the most remote and harshest environments in the United States.

For our shareholders, Suvi provides support and employment opportunities and contributes to the survival of a culture that has thrived above the Arctic Circle for more than 10,000 years.

For our government customers, Suvi delivers subject matter experts, an agile management approach, and innovative technologies that accomplish customers’ missions safely, securely, and efficiently.

As a Suvi employee, you will be surrounded by a challenging, yet supportive work environment that is committed to innovation and diversity, two of our most important values. You will also have access to our comprehensive benefits and competitive pay in addition to growth opportunities and excellent retirement options.

jobs.description:
This role offers the opportunity to work alongside a senior end-user computing engineering organization delivering impactful VDI migration, engineering, and automation outcomes across a large, complex enterprise desktop estate.

  Position Overview

  This role supports the engineering, migration, and ongoing development of a large-scale enterprise virtual desktop environment. The team is migrating workloads onto Omnissa Horizon and needs engineers who can build, configure, troubleshoot, and improve Windows virtual desktop services.

  Key Responsibilities

  Engineer and support enterprise Windows virtual desktop environments using Omnissa Horizon
  Support the migration and transition of workloads from existing VDI platforms to Horizon
  Build, configure, and maintain Windows 10/11 virtual desktop images and associated desktop services
  Engineer and optimize desktop images, profiles, policies, and application configurations
  Configure and support Horizon components including Connection Servers, Horizon Agents, desktop pools, and associated infrastructure
  Troubleshoot complex VDI issues across the Windows desktop, application, profile, authentication, and infrastructure layers
  Support Active Directory, Group Policy, and Windows security configuration within the virtual desktop environment
  Work with application, infrastructure, network, and security teams to resolve end-to-end desktop issues
  Support application delivery, packaging, and deployment into virtual desktop environments
  Automate repeatable desktop engineering and operational activities using PowerShell or equivalent tooling
  Monitor and optimize VDI performance, stability, capacity, and end-user experience
  Produce engineering documentation, operational procedures, and implementation plans

  Required Qualifications

  Strong hands-on experience in Windows desktop engineering, particularly Windows 10/11
  Strong experience supporting and engineering an enterprise VDI environment
  Experience with at least one major VDI platform, such as Omnissa/VMware Horizon, Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Azure Virtual Desktop, or other comparable enterprise VDI technologies
  Good understanding of VDI architecture and desktop delivery concepts
  Strong knowledge of Active Directory and Group Policy
  Experience with Windows image creation, configuration, optimization, and lifecycle management
  Experience troubleshooting desktop performance, application, profile, and authentication issues
  Strong PowerShell skills and an automation-first approach to engineering
  Understanding of enterprise networking concepts relevant to VDI, including DNS, load balancing, firewalls, and remote-access connectivity

  Preferred Qualifications

  Hands-on Omnissa Horizon engineering experience
  Experience migrating from Citrix to Horizon or between other enterprise VDI platforms
  Experience with Omnissa technologies such as Workspace ONE UEM or DEX
  Experience with profile-management technologies such as FSLogix, DEM, or Citrix Profile Management
  Experience with application packaging and deployment technologies
  Knowledge of F5, authentication/SSO technologies, and enterprise remote-access architectures
  Experience with infrastructure automation, scripting, and configuration management

jobs.title: Sr. Associate, Microsoft 365 Engineer
jobs.summary: SC Johnson has been leading with purpose for 140 years, building high-quality products and iconic brands found in homes, schools and businesses in virtually every country worldwide – including OFF!®, Raid®, Glade®, Windex®, Scrubbing Bubbles®, Ziploc®,...
jobs.description:
SC Johnson has been leading with purpose for 140 years, building high-quality products and iconic brands found in homes, schools and businesses in virtually every country worldwide – including OFF!®, Raid®, Glade®, Windex®, Scrubbing Bubbles®, Ziploc®, Mrs. Meyer’s Clean Day®, method®, Autan®, Baygon®, Mr Muscle®, Duck®, Lysoform® and more.

The 13,000 people of our global, fifth-generation family company are committed to making the world a better place today and for future generations.

 ABOUT THE ROLE

The Sr Associate Microsoft 365 Engineer is a member of the End User Productivity (EUP) team. The EUP team is a global team responsible for the management and delivery of client solutions that address current and future business needs while ensuring value realization in the shortest possible timeframe, most specifically involving Microsoft 365 platforms, physical and virtual endpoints, collaboration spaces, end-user enablement, and related services.

This position is responsible for the delivery and support of productivity and collaboration services focused on the Microsoft 365 platform. This includes Teams, Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Stream, Office applications, Power Platform and related Microsoft 365 services.

The appointee will lead service improvement efforts and work with Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to deliver solutions that promote ease of use, productivity and adherence to security requirements. The incumbent will also interact with departments across SCJ to understand requirements and deliver business value. This position also includes support of related EUP projects and platforms, service operations, and day-to-day level 3 support.

This is an onsite role in Racine, WI

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead continuous improvement efforts for the Microsoft 365 platform and collaboration tools. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas for improvement in processes, systems or products. Propose and implement enhancements, including automation where appropriate, to optimize efficiency and quality.

- Use and promote practical automation and AI-enabled approaches to improve recurring operational work, troubleshooting, documentation and service delivery, using capabilities such as Azure Automation, Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio and other approved Microsoft 365 tools.

- Stay current through research and industry connections to support a progressive approach within the Microsoft and collaboration space at SC Johnson. Collaborate with the Service Owner to develop and maintain knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem, including SharePoint, Teams, Exchange and related services.

- Ensure compliance to standards and SLAs/XLAs by Managed Service Providers. Serve as a first escalation point for MSPs for issues. Monitor and analyze product performance metrics.

- Partner with the Service Owner to implement and improve solutions for SCJ application and infrastructure owners. Assist in defining and prioritizing product and service enhancements for the Microsoft 365 platform.

- Explore and apply agentic AI capabilities, including ChatGPT and Microsoft 365 Copilot, to improve productivity and reduce repetitive work while following SCJ security, privacy and governance requirements.

- Ensure SCJ standard infrastructure management processes are being followed, identify procedural issues and lead actions to remediate and correct processing as needed (examples: change, work, problem management).

- Experience coordinating and managing escalations with vendors and service providers.

- Ability to coordinate with vendors and partners as needed for problem resolution.

- Support management of vendor and partner relationships as necessary.

- Lead and/or participate in strategic and operational projects and initiatives.

- Document processes, procedures and operational standards for maintenance and support.

- Participate in the development of team plans, service roadmaps and operational priorities.

- Provides 3rd level operational support for platforms. Off-hours support and a flexible schedule to accommodate a global team will be required.

 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE YOU’LL BRING

- Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science or related technical discipline

- Minimum 3 years of experience with a global enterprise-level service.

- 3 years of experience with Microsoft 365 management and administration

- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States

 PREFERRED EXPERIENCES AND SKILLS

- Working with Managed Service Providers

- The ideal candidate will have a skill-set that includes a wide breadth of infrastructure related technologies.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- User-centric design thinking.

- Communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences

- Ability to troubleshoot complex problems

- Strong customer service skills, attention to detail, sense of urgency, and the ability to offer guidance and mentorship to junior team members

- Excellent interpersonal skills and a “can do” attitude in a team environment

- Self-motivated, self-directed person

- Ability to work with and support a globally dispersed team

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills – evaluates information/data to make decisions; anticipates obstacles and develops plans to resolve; creates actionable operational plans and involves others as needed

- Design Thinking

- Demonstrated interest in applying generative AI and agentic AI tools, including ChatGPT and Microsoft 365 Copilot, to business and technology workflows.

- Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform, Azure Automation and automation/agent development tools.

- Service Strategy and Product Strategy

 JOB REQUIREMENTS

- Full-time

- Remote work is available once a week for eligible employees

- This role is not eligible for domestic relocation

 BENEFITS AND PERKS

SC Johnson’s total compensation packages are at or above industry levels. In addition to salary, total packages may include bonuses, long-term incentives, matching 401(k) contributions and profit sharing based on company profitability, job level and years of service. As a family company, we’re committed to providing benefits such as subsidized health care plans, maternity/paternity/adoption leave, flexible work arrangements, vacation purchase options, recreation and fitness centers, childcare, counseling services and more.

 Inclusion & Diversity

We’re a global business, with people from every culture, ethnicity, race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age and ability. We recognize the breadth of human experience, and we work to celebrate it. It is our goal to build a diverse, inclusive and supportive work environment where all people can thrive.

We’re committed to ongoing efforts that help us attract, hire, and retain diverse talent who want to build a positive, inclusive environment. Read more about our ongoing initiatives at https://jobs.scjohnson.com/inclusion .

 Better Together

   At SC Johnson, we believe people achieve their best when they collaborate and work together in person. We value connection to strengthen teamwork, accelerate problem solving, and drive innovation.

 Equal Opportunity Employer

The policy of the Company is to ensure equal opportunity for all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, gender, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, citizenship, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in any active or reserve component of the U.S. or state military forces, genetic history or information or any other category protected by law.

 Accommodation Requests

If you are an individual with a disability and you need an accommodation or other assistance during the application process, please call our Human Resources department at 262-260-3343 or email your request to SCJHR@scj.com . All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply. Download the EEO Know Your Rights poster for more information.

jobs.title: Workplace Endpoint Engineer (Hybrid set up), Madrid (M, ES)
jobs.summary: **Location:** Madrid, M, ES Are you a seasoned endpoint engineer with deep roots in traditional device management, but with an eye on the future of cloud-native workplace technology? Do you thrive in complex enterprise environments where SCCM, task...
jobs.description:
**Location:** Madrid, M, ES

Are you a seasoned endpoint engineer with deep roots in traditional device management, but with an eye on the future of cloud-native workplace technology? Do you thrive in complex enterprise environments where SCCM, task sequences, and Windows imaging are your daily toolkit — while also embracing the shift towards modern management? If you're passionate about keeping large-scale endpoint estates running smoothly while helping bridge the gap to the cloud, this could be the role for you!

**About the Team**

We are a leading organisation committed to enhancing our digital workplace to support over 17,000 employees globally. Our goal is to provide seamless connectivity and collaboration through innovative technology solutions.

The Digital Workplace (DWP) team is a dynamic, forward-thinking group dedicated to enabling seamless connectivity and collaboration for all employees. We embrace agile methodologies and leadership practices to drive innovation and excellence across the organisation. We are a team of technology enthusiasts who are passionate about making a real difference — and we'd love for you to be part of that mission

**About the Role**

We're looking for an experienced Workplace Engineer to join our Digital Workplace team in Madrid. In this role, you'll be the go-to expert for our traditional endpoint management infrastructure — owning and evolving our SCCM environment, Windows 11 deployment strategies, OSD task sequences, and enterprise imaging. At the same time, you'll actively contribute to our journey towards cloud-native management, working with Microsoft Intune, Azure AD / Entra ID, and modern security tooling. You'll play a critical role in maintaining stability and security across our 17,000+ employee endpoint estate. If you love solving complex endpoint challenges and have a passion for both structured endpoint management and modern workplace innovation, we'd love to meet you!

**About Yo****u**

You are a hands-on endpoint engineering specialist who brings structured thinking, meticulous attention to detail, and a strong sense of ownership to everything you do. You are well-versed in ITSM best practices and understand how structured service management processes underpin reliable, high-quality IT operations. You take pride in building scalable, well-documented solutions and in sharing your knowledge with those around you. You're equally comfortable working independently on complex technical challenges and collaborating closely with colleagues. You thrive in agile environments, value continuous improvement, and are genuinely excited about contributing to the evolution of enterprise endpoint management.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Design, deploy and manage enterprise endpoint solutions using Microsoft SCCM (Configuration Manager) as the primary management platform, including site administration, software distribution, patch management and client health management across large enterprise environments.
- Build, maintain and optimise OS Deployment (OSD) task sequences for Windows 11 bare metal imaging, in-place upgrades, driver management and WIM customisation at scale.
- Own and manage the Windows 11 lifecycle, including compatibility assessment, feature update planning, phased rollouts and end-user impact assessment.
- Manage enterprise software packaging and deployment, including application creation, detection methods, dependency management and deployment targeting within SCCM.
- Administer and optimise SCCM infrastructure, including site servers, distribution points, management points and boundary configuration.
- Act as the L3 escalation point for complex endpoint incidents and problems, providing deep technical investigation, root cause analysis and permanent resolution for issues beyond the reach of L1/L2 support teams — operating in alignment with ITSM best practices including incident, problem and change management processes.
- Apply ITSM frameworks (such as ITIL) in day-to-day operations, ensuring consistent and structured handling of service requests, incidents, problems and changes within the endpoint environment.
- Implement and maintain endpoint security using Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Conditional Access policies and Zero Trust principles.
- Create and maintain PowerShell scripts, including automation via Microsoft Graph API, for endpoint configuration, compliance remediation and administrative tasks.
- Collaborate with the agile Endpoints team to develop and integrate new workplace features, products and services.
- Maintain thorough documentation of configurations, processes, task sequences and known issues to support knowledge sharing and operational resilience.
- Champion Swiss Re's healthy and transparent risk culture by actively engaging in continuous risk accountability activities.

**These are additional nice to haves:**

- Familiarity with Windows Autopilot for zero-touch provisioning as a complement to traditional OSD approaches.
- Experience with co-management (SCCM + Microsoft Intune) and familiarity with transitioning workloads from on-premise to cloud-native endpoint management.
- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, including device configuration profiles, compliance policies and application deployment in an enterprise environment.
- Working knowledge of Azure AD / Entra ID, including Conditional Access policies, SSO and MFA in the context of endpoint security and identity management.
- Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, including endpoint security management, threat and vulnerability management and security baseline application.
- Experience with BIOS/UEFI management and hardware vendor tools (e.g., Dell Command, HP BIOS Config Utility) for enterprise device configuration.
- Understanding of Active Directory and Group Policy administration in the context of endpoint management.
- Experience with Microsoft Deployment Toolkit (MDT) as a complement to SCCM-based deployments.
- Knowledge of Windows 365 and/or Azure Virtual Desktop environments.
- Familiarity with Windows Autopatch for automated update management.
- Experience with mobile device management (MDM) for iOS and Android platforms, including device enrolment, configuration profiles, compliance policies and app management — ideally managed through Microsoft Intune,
- University degree or equivalent qualification in engineering, computer science or a related field.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

*For Spain the* ***base salary range*** *for this position is between EUR 42,000 and EUR 70,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:*

- *the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,*
- *the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.*

*In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.*

*In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.*

**About Swiss Re**

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

jobs.description:
DESCRIPCIóN

¿Te gustaría formar parte de un proyecto donde la gestión eficiente de la tecnología y la experiencia digital de los usuarios sean clave para el negocio?

En Nunsys Group buscamos incorporar un/a especialista en gestión de activos IT, **Microsoft Intune** y movilidad corporativa para participar en un proyecto estable y de alta visibilidad, donde la experiencia digital del usuario y la seguridad de los dispositivos son fundamentales.

## **EL PROYECTO**

Te incorporarás a un entorno tecnológico consolidado, participando en la gestión integral de activos IT, dispositivos móviles y puesto de trabajo digital para un importante cliente del sector industrial. El puesto combina trabajo en oficina con presencia en las instalaciones del cliente, manteniendo una interlocución cercana con usuarios y diferentes áreas técnicas.

Se trata de una posición orientada a profesionales con autonomía, capacidad organizativa y vocación de servicio, que quieran aportar valor en la administración de entornos modernos de movilidad y gestión de dispositivos.

## **¿QUÉ HARÁS EN ESTA POSICIÓN?**

Entre tus principales responsabilidades estarán:

- Gestión y control del inventario de activos IT.
- Administración operativa de Microsoft Intune.
- Alta, baja y actualización de activos en herramientas corporativas de gestión.
- Preparación, configuración y entrega de equipos y dispositivos.
- Gestión del ciclo de vida de smartphones, tablets y dispositivos corporativos.
- Soporte de nivel N2 a usuarios sobre dispositivos Android e iOS.
- Configuración y revisión de perfiles y políticas de dispositivos.
- Gestión de aplicaciones corporativas.
- Resolución de incidencias relacionadas con movilidad y puesto de trabajo digital.
- Coordinación con fabricantes y operadores cuando sea necesario.
- Elaboración de documentación técnica y actualización de inventarios.

## **¿QUÉ BUSCAMOS?**

- FP Superior en Informática, Administración de Sistemas Informáticos o titulación equivalente.
- Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en administración de sistemas e infraestructuras IT.
- Experiencia trabajando con:
- Microsoft Intune.
- Android Enterprise.
- Dispositivos iPhone y iPad.
- Windows 10 y Windows 11.
- Microsoft 365.
- Herramientas ITSM para gestión de incidencias.
- Gestión de inventario y activos IT.
- Configuración de smartphones y tablets corporativos.
- Active Directory y Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) a nivel operativo.

Será un plus contar con experiencia o conocimientos en:

- Microsoft Endpoint Manager.
- Certificación ITIL Foundation.
- Gestión logística de almacenes tecnológicos y activos IT.
- Soporte a dispositivos industriales como Honeywell, Zebra, handhelds, pickers o impresoras industriales.

## **¿QUÉ TE ESPERA EN NUNSYS GROUP?**

- Contratación indefinida.
- Horario: L-V 8.00-18.30 con descanso para comer.
- Modalidad: Presencial en A Coruña.
- Proyecto estable con recorrido profesional.
- Participación en un entorno tecnológico moderno basado en soluciones Microsoft.
- Formación continua y acceso a certificaciones.
- Plan de carrera personalizado.
- Beneficios sociales y retribución flexible.
- Programas de bienestar físico, mental y social.
- Entorno colaborativo con profesionales especializados.
- Posibilidad de trabajar en proyectos con impacto real en la operación del cliente.

jobs.title: MECM/SCCM/Infrastructure Engineer (Bilingual English)
jobs.summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Microsoft MECM/SCCM/Intune Customer Engineer to serve as a trusted consultant and technical advisor for customers. In this role, you will design, assess, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize Microsoft Endpoint...
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Microsoft MECM/SCCM/Intune Customer Engineer to serve as a trusted consultant and technical advisor for customers. In this role, you will design, assess, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager, System Center Configuration Manager, and Intune environments while helping customers achieve their endpoint management goals. You will partner directly with technical teams and customer leadership to deliver practical guidance, reliable solutions, and measurable outcomes. This is a bilingual English role.

## **Responsibilities**

- Work directly with customers as a consultant, technical advisor, and trusted infrastructure expert.
- Design, deploy, review, and assess the health of MECM/SCCM infrastructure and client environments.
- Upgrade, update, maintain, and troubleshoot SCCM hierarchy components.
- Diagnose and resolve issues across MECM/SCCM infrastructure, clients, software updates, task sequences, and related endpoint management services.
- Tune and optimize SCCM environments for performance, reliability, and scalability.
- Assist customers with reporting needs using SCCM reporting capabilities, SSRS, and/or Power BI.
- Support setup, configuration, planning, and troubleshooting of SCCM Co-Management with Intune.
- Assist in planning, reviewing, and troubleshooting Software Updates features.
- Assist in planning, reviewing, and troubleshooting Task Sequences for operating system deployment and upgrades.
- Provide customer training across SCCM/MECM capabilities to support adoption, knowledge transfer, and customer success.
- Present technical recommendations, assessments, findings, and solutions to multiple levels of customer leadership.
- Act as a consultant and architect across multiple customer environments, balancing technical depth with customer-focused communication.

## **Qualifications**

- Bachelor’s degree in IT or a related field.
- 10+ years of experience as a deep technical expert, technology owner, or consultant for MECM/SCCM.
- Deep expertise in Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager, System Center Configuration Manager, and Intune.
- Ability to consult with customers, assess complex environments, and recommend practical infrastructure improvements.
- Ability to present clearly and confidently to technical teams, stakeholders, and customer leadership.
- Broad knowledge across multiple endpoint management and infrastructure scenarios, with deep expertise in at least three of the following:
  - Windows desktop/server management using MECM/SCCMSQL Server,
  - Active Directory,
  - certificates, IIS, DNS/networking, and security
  - Package and application creation
  - Desktop operating system upgrades using multiple approaches
  - Intune and Co-Management
  - SSRS reporting and/or Power BIPowerShell scripting
- Broad knowledge of MECM capabilities, with deep understanding of at least four of the following:
  - Infrastructure design, deployment, upgrades, maintenance, health, tuning, and troubleshooting
  - Windows desktop upgrades
  - Software updates
  - Compliance
  - Software distribution
  - Security
  - Intune
  - SQL Server
  - Report development
  - Network troubleshooting, including DNS Active Directory
- Experience with IIS and related infrastructure components.
- Hands-on experience with tools such as SQL Profiler, PowerShell, and Process Monitor.
- Excellent communication, problem-solving, consulting, and organizational skills.
- Fluent in English and Spanish, written and verbal.

At **Sequoia Connect** , we are a **Talent-First Technology Ecosystem** that redefines how elite professionals interact with the global digital landscape. We move beyond traditional models to act as a catalyst for the top 1% of global talent, connecting human potential with complex industrial execution. By joining our inner circle, you are not simply taking a position; you are aligning with a strategic partner dedicated to updating your "Human OS" and accelerating your growth through world-class, high-impact projects.

We are currently partnering with a rapidly growing, automation-led powerhouse that serves 31 Fortune 500 companies across the financial, healthcare, and manufacturing sectors. With a global workforce of over 32,000 employees and a presence in 28 countries, our client is a titan of digital transformation. Their "Automate Everything, Cloudify Everything" strategy ensures you will be working at the absolute forefront of AI-driven automation and cloud solutions.

This is your chance to thrive in a "Customer Success, First and Always" environment that prizes continuous learning and radical ownership. You will collaborate within an international network of expertise across 39 delivery centers worldwide, gaining exposure to complex engineering challenges that redefine industrial standards. If you are a driven professional looking for a dynamic, forward-thinking workplace where your growth is the priority, this is where you belong.

We are currently searching for a **Big Data Lead:**

**The Challenge (Responsibilities)**

* Provide technical leadership, engineering delivery, and ensure the overall quality of the Data Foundation platform.
* Lead the team responsible for building and maintaining enterprise data pipelines, data products, canonical data models, and data services.
* Enable advanced analytics, AI, system integration, and operational reporting through robust data architectures.
* Partner closely with the Service Owner, Architecture Team, and Platform Engineering Lead to deliver scalable, trusted, and maintainable data solutions aligned with enterprise standards and strategic objectives.
* Take accountability for engineering execution, solution quality, and operational reliability across the data platform.
* Drive the development, mentorship, and continuous improvement of a high-performing data engineering team.

**Your Profile (Requirements)**

* Proven experience as a hands-on technical leader with deep expertise in enterprise data engineering.
* Strong background in modern data architectures, distributed processing, and engineering excellence (specifically utilizing PySpark).
* Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Master Data Management (MDM) principles and canonical data models.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams while remaining hands-on with pipeline creation and architectural design.
* Exceptional communication skills to partner seamlessly with cross-functional architecture and platform teams.
* **High-Performance Mindset:** Resilience, emotional intelligence, and a focus on agile delivery.
* **Technologist DNA:** A deep understanding of the difference between "coding" and "engineering."

**Desired**

* Experience deploying data solutions within modern cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Familiarity with cloud-native foundations or AI coding assistants.

**Languages**

* **Advanced Oral English:** For seamless collaboration with global teams.
* **Advanced Spanish.**

**Special Notes**

* Position ID: AR 681618

**Work Arrangement**

We value flexibility to support your lifestyle. This position is available as:

* **Remote**

If you meet these qualifications and are pursuing new challenges, **start your application on our website** to join an award-winning employer. Explore all our job openings \| **Sequoia Career's Page** : https://www.sequoia-connect.com/careers/

* Lead team building enterprise data pipelines, data products, canonical data models, and data services.
* Partner closely with Service Owner, Architecture Team, and Platform Engineering Lead.
* Deliver scalable, trusted, and maintainable data solutions.
* Hands-on technical leader with deep expertise in data engineering.
