jobs.description:
**About Us**

Machines will make decisions, move value, and coordinate on behalf of organizations, instantly, autonomously, and at unprecedented scale. But the systems that govern today’s economy weren’t designed for that world. Turnkey is building the infrastructure for this future: programmable guardrails that enable autonomy without sacrificing control.

Founded by the team who scaled Coinbase Custody to $100M+ ARR and secured over $100B in crypto assets, we know how to move at pace without ever compromising on security.

Our mission is to help the world operate an economy on autopilot, safely. We're low-ego, high-agency, and deeply technical. Our team consists of experts in cryptography, security, and systems who believe great infrastructure is invisible. We're building the trustless, programmable foundation for the autonomous economy, and we're hiring people who understand what that requires.

**Your role**

This is not a config-and-tickets DevOps role. We're looking for someone who treats infrastructure as a programming problem: writing real software (in Go) to automate, scale, and harden the systems that run a security-critical platform.

- Own best practices for managing production infrastructure, including provisioning, application scaling, configuration management, capacity planning, and monitoring
- Build and maintain our multi-region Kubernetes infrastructure at scale, along with the Terraform-provisioned cloud resources that sit underneath it
- Write custom automation and tooling in Go to reduce manual work and eliminate entire classes of operational risk
- Build infrastructure to manage and deploy applications in secure enclaves
- Improve operations across our infrastructure and systems, including deployment, logging, monitoring, and alerting
- Assist in scaling out a world-class engineering team

**What we're looking for**

- Strong multi-cloud infrastructure experience, AWS strongly preferred
- Real programming ability in Go. You should be comfortable writing production software, not just scripts or configuration
- Hands-on experience running Kubernetes at scale and managing infrastructure as code with Terraform
- A learning mindset and high agency. We care more about how fast you pick things up and how much ownership you take than about years of experience on paper
- An understanding of modern application architectures, with opinions on how they should be developed and deployed
- Experience working in extremely security conscious environments
- A healthy amount of paranoia :)
- People who think Web3/cryptocurrency has the potential to radically change the world for the better, and a sincere desire to help facilitate that change
- Based in the US

**Style points**

- Experience with trusted execution environments, secure enclaves, hardware security modules, or other attestable compute environments
- A deep understanding of Linux and how to reduce the surface area of applications deployed on top of it
- Expertise in threshold signing systems and a desire to stay on the cutting edge of production-grade cryptography
- Actively tracking developments in the crypto ecosystem and opinionated on where it's going

**What We Offer**

- Full benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, HSA/FSA, 401(k)
- Paid parental leave
- Unlimited PTO
- $3,000/yr learning and development budget to attend industry conferences
- Multiple team offsites per year
- Lunch stipend

Please note that while the team is remote, we are only considering candidates who are physically based in the United States and Canada at the current time.

_Turnkey is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply._

Compensation range

$200,000—$240,000 USD

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

 About the role

Data Center Security Engineering (DCSE) secures Anthropic's data center footprint; this role covers how the sites are designed and built to be secure. Much of that footprint is designed and built with partners, so a site's security is decided early: in what Anthropic hands the people who build it, and in how rigorously the delivered systems are tested against it.

You'll design and specify the physical security systems for a site: perimeter and vehicle barriers, intrusion detection, video, security lighting, and the site penetrations and utility entry points that bypass them. Design firms and integrators produce the site drawings and install; you specify, review, and verify. You'll write the performance requirement and verification method behind each control, review every site design against them at each stage with redlines a design team can act on, test in the field that what was built performs as specified, and re-verify post-acceptance changes.

This is a foundational role. You'll own Anthropic's physical security reference design package (typical details, reference drawings, schedules, and test procedures) in the form partners build from, and keep it current against each site's threat basis and the sites actually being built. You'll set the technical position for a site and decide what applies where; where a requirement can't be met as written, you'll engineer the compensating control and document the deviation. You'll work with the rest of DCSE, with Anthropic's design, construction, and real estate counterparts, and directly with the vendors who build to the package. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.

The same seat covers the team's security operations control rooms. You'll set their design and operational requirements and accept delivered systems against them, working day to day alongside the team's platform engineers, who own the software and compute that run in them.

This role involves regular travel to data center sites. These are critical services, and this role participates in an on-call rotation for them.

 Key responsibilities

-

 Produce a vendor-ready design package for perimeter barriers and hostile vehicle mitigation, intrusion detection and its zoning, video coverage, security lighting matched to camera performance, and penetration protection: performance specifications, typical details and reference drawings, and device and zone schedules, written so a design firm can build to them and a test can prove them

-

 Define the per-site engineering basis: which requirements apply to a site based on its risk profile and the threats it faces, with compensating controls and documented deviations

-

 Write the acceptance criteria and test methods: the verification method behind each requirement and the evidence a site must produce to pass acceptance

-

 Set standoff, structural hardening, and site layout criteria for new designs, tied to the threat basis they derive from

-

 Run field verification: commissioning and acceptance testing of perimeter, detection, video, and lighting against performance criteria (detection coverage tests, photometric measurements, video quality checks)

-

 Write the operational and design requirements for security operations control rooms: console layout, wall versus workstation content, supervisor placement; room network, power, backup, and resilient communications to the team's segmentation and hardening baseline

-

 Own control room acceptance: factory and site acceptance criteria written before the build, then accept or reject delivered systems (video wall, consoles, cabling, fit-out) against them

 Minimum qualifications

-

Have designed or specified physical security systems (perimeter barriers, intrusion detection, video, security lighting) for campus-scale sites: multiple buildings, a secured perimeter, many detection zones

-

Read and produce construction documents (site plans, civil and electrical drawings, device schedules, submittals) using standard design and markup tools such as AutoCAD, Revit, or Bluebeam, and find what is missing as readily as what is wrong

-

Write performance requirements that are testable: each states what must be true, how it will be verified, and what evidence shows it

-

Have run commissioning and acceptance tests against performance criteria and rejected work that did not meet them

-

Derive requirements from a threat basis rather than a product catalog: you can say which adversary a control stops and where the next weakest point is

-

Have owned an engineering domain where you set the approach, chose what applied to each site, worked directly with vendors, and answered for the result

 Preferred qualifications

-

Experience carrying a physical security design from construction documents through construction to acceptance testing

-

Experience engineering the security scope of colocation or partner-delivered facilities

-

Working knowledge of published standards for standoff, hostile vehicle mitigation, and intrusion detection zoning

-

Photometric and video quality measurement experience

-

Control room, AV, or network design experience: console layouts, video wall systems, resilient communications

-

Experience using AI-assisted tooling for drafting and review as a core part of your workflow

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

 $320,000 - $405,000 USD

 Logistics

 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

 How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

 Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description:
## **About Suno**

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

### **About the role**

The Lead Corporate Security Engineer will be our domain expert for securing our Corporate IT environment. You’ll work closely with colleagues in IT, Business Systems, Security, and Engineering to ensure that our corporate systems are implemented and maintained securely. As a senior member of the team, your impact will be split between building your team, enabling others, and doing hands-on work to mature our systems, processes, and behaviors.

You'll lead the corporate security domain end to end: identity and access governance, endpoint and vulnerability management, detection and response, third-party integration risk, vendor assessment, and SaaS posture. You'll set the standard, own the roadmap, and be accountable for the outcome. IT Engineering runs the platforms day to day and are your closest partners.

**Listen to the song we made about it:** [https://suno.com/s/BiNdRVfLZRJXlfSW](https://suno.com/s/BiNdRVfLZRJXlfSW)

### **How this role works with IT**

Ownership splits by layer, not by system. IT Engineering owns the run; you own the standard and the direction.

- **You set the corporate security roadmap.** What we secure, in what order, to what bar with buy-in from leadership and XFN stakeholders

- **IT engineering owns platform operations.** Our SaaS portfolio is administered and integrated by them. You define what those platforms must enforce

- **You raise the bar around you.** You make your reasoning explicit so that partners make good security calls without you in the room, and you build the tooling and defaults that make the secure path the default path

### **What you'll own**

**Identity and access governance**

- Own the access model at Suno: the RBAC and entitlement design, least-privilege defaults, and the governance layer in Lumos that enforces them

- Set the standard for what access review, certification, and approval should look like here — then build toward it rather than importing someone else's framework

- Drive access lifecycle automation so joiner/mover/leaver is correct by default and exceptions are visible

- Get ahead of non-human identity: service accounts, agents, and automations are a growing share of what holds access at Suno, and we need a model for them before it's urgent

**Endpoint security and vulnerability management**

- Own the security standard for our fleet: hardening baseline, compliance signals, device trust, and how endpoint posture feeds access decisions

- Own third-party vulnerability management as a program — coverage, risk-based remediation SLAs, reporting, and the negotiation with teams whose tools are the problem

- Partner with the IT engineer who owns Kandji so the standard becomes deployed policy without degrading how people work

**Detection and response**

- Own our EDR deployment and maintenance

- Collaborate with Detection and Response on corporate security incidents to closure

**Third-party and integration risk**

- Own how Suno evaluates third-party access: integration and OAuth review for Slack, Google Workspace and the rest of the portfolio, plus vendor security assessment at purchase and renewal

- Define our risk appetite in practice and make it legible enough that others apply it without you

- Turn recurring decisions into policy, scope guidance, and tooling so the review queue shrinks as the company grows

**SaaS security posture**

- Build and own the program: the bar for our SaaS applications, the assessment cadence, and the remediation that follows

- Improve tenant-level configuration across the portfolio — SSO and SCIM coverage, MFA and session policy, admin role hygiene, OAuth grant and token management, data sharing defaults

**Cross-functional leadership**

- Work with IT, Security, Engineering, AI Enablement, and Legal to shape how Suno builds and buys

- Influence the scope of what comes next: how our GRC function plugs in, what we automate versus staff, where the next investment goes

- Mentor and raise the technical bar for people around you, including partners who aren't security specialists

### **What success looks like**

- **First 90 days:** you've formed your own view of our security posture, built working relationships with the IT engineers the broader Security team, and told us the three things we're wrong about

- **First 6 months:** a corporate security roadmap exists that IT and the CISO are aligned behind, with the sequencing and the tradeoffs made explicit; the highest-risk items are already moving

- **First year:** entitlement sprawl and vulnerability backlog are measurably down, detection reflects our real risks, third-party review is fast enough that nobody routes around it, and the standard holds because it's built into tooling and shared judgment rather than into you

### **What you'll bring**

- ~8+ years in corporate/enterprise security or security engineering, including having owned identity, endpoint, or SaaS security as a domain rather than as a set of tickets

- Deep hands-on expertise with a modern IdP and with IGA or access-governance tooling (Lumos, Veza, ConductorOne, Opal, or similar)

- You've designed an entitlement or RBAC model across a large SaaS portfolio and lived with the consequences long enough to know what breaks

- Endpoint security depth in a macOS-primary fleet: MDM-delivered hardening, compliance and device trust, third-party patch and vulnerability management at scale

- Strong command of OAuth, SAML, OIDC, and SCIM, and of the risk model behind third-party integrations

- A track record of setting a security standard that other people applied without you enforcing it — written policy, tooling, defaults, or all three

- Experience influencing engineering and business teams who don't report to you, early enough in their process to change the outcome

- Automation fluency: Python or TypeScript, REST APIs, and a habit of building integrations and internal tooling as a normal part of the job

- Excellent writing and judgment under ambiguity. You can hold a position with an executive and change it when the evidence says to

- A calibrated sense of risk and how to communicate likelihood, impact, and tradeoffs

**Helpful, not required:** insider risk or DLP programs, zero-trust network access, SOC 2 or ISO program ownership, just-in-time access patterns or identity-as-code, securing AI agent and non-human identity access, prior experience as the first or second security hire at a fast-growing company.

### **Work Location Policy**

This role is expected to work from Suno's NYC or Cambridge, MA office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

### **Additional Notes**

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Willingness to travel (up to 25%) to lead team members and support offices across Suno locations, with a deliberate cadence in Cambridge and NYC during the first six months.

### **Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees**

- Company Equity Package

- 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

- Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

- 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

- 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

- Creative Education Stipend

- Generous Commuter Allowance

- In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 IT SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR, TEST OPERATIONS (2ND SHIFT)

SpaceX is looking for a highly skilled and knowledgeable IT Systems Administrator to support the networking, compute administration, and application support needs of our test operations environment. This role will be pivotal to the enablement of safe and sustained test operations cadence, directly supporting our goals of making humanity a multiplanetary species. Candidate must be comfortable working on mission-critical systems with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities while maintaining attention to detail and operational excellence.

 RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Augment and deploy new IT infrastructure, including networking, server, and desktop hardware directly supporting mission critical networks across the country.

- Perform periodic systems upgrades and patches in between critical operations, sometimes on weekends and evenings.

- Monitor IT services and respond aggressively to incidents to maintain systems performance.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to proactively identify and resolve potential technical issues with systems deployments.

- Author and maintain documentation for IT systems, from systems overview documents and design drawings to procedures.

- Leverage automation tools and contribute to IT systems engineering efforts.

- Ensure that systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g. ITAR, ISO, NIST).

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

- 3+ years of experience in IT systems administration.

- Hands-on experience with Linux or Windows server administration.

- Experience with enterprise network administration and deployment.

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Working knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, NTP, PTP etc), firewalls administration and cybersecurity technologies.

- Proficiency in scripting (Bash/Powershell/Python) and automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet).

- Familiarity with Active Directory and multi-platform authentication/identification environments.

- Experience with virtualization platforms and tools.

- Understanding of Layer 1 configuration best practices and multiplexing technologies.

- Working knowledge, including the ability to setup, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot, Windows-based systems and services (i.e. SCCM, Active Directory).

- Exposure to real-time systems and industrial telemetry networks.

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and other DevOps concepts and tools.

- Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Ability to pass Air Force background checks for Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg.

- Must have valid driver's license.

- Ability to lift up to 30lbs.

- Ability to work at heights.

- Willing to be on after-hours on-call rotation.

- Willingness to work extended hours and weekends as needed.

- Must be available for the second shift beginning at 1:30pm.

 ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here .

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com .

 - Drive access lifecycle automation so joiner/mover/leaver is correct by default and exceptions are visible

 - Get ahead of non-human identity: service accounts, agents, and automations are a growing share of what holds access at Suno, and we need a model for them before it's urgent

Endpoint security and vulnerability management

 - Own the security standard for our fleet: hardening baseline, compliance signals, device trust, and how endpoint posture feeds access decisions

 - Own third-party vulnerability management as a program — coverage, risk-based remediation SLAs, reporting, and the negotiation with teams whose tools are the problem

 - Partner with the IT engineer who owns Kandji so the standard becomes deployed policy without degrading how people work

Detection and response

 - Own our EDR deployment and maintenance

 - Collaborate with Detection and Response on corporate security incidents to closure

Third-party and integration risk

 - Own how Suno evaluates third-party access: integration and OAuth review for Slack, Google Workspace and the rest of the portfolio, plus vendor security assessment at purchase and renewal

 - Define our risk appetite in practice and make it legible enough that others apply it without you

 - Turn recurring decisions into policy, scope guidance, and tooling so the review queue shrinks as the company grows

SaaS security posture

 - Build and own the program: the bar for our SaaS applications, the assessment cadence, and the remediation that follows

 - Improve tenant-level configuration across the portfolio — SSO and SCIM coverage, MFA and session policy, admin role hygiene, OAuth grant and token management, data sharing defaults

Cross-functional leadership

 - Work with IT, Security, Engineering, AI Enablement, and Legal to shape how Suno builds and buys

 - Influence the scope of what comes next: how our GRC function plugs in, what we automate versus staff, where the next investment goes

 - Mentor and raise the technical bar for people around you, including partners who aren't security specialists

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - First 90 days: you've formed your own view of our security posture, built working relationships with the IT engineers the broader Security team, and told us the three things we're wrong about

 - First 6 months: a corporate security roadmap exists that IT and the CISO are aligned behind, with the sequencing and the tradeoffs made explicit; the highest-risk items are already moving

 - First year: entitlement sprawl and vulnerability backlog are measurably down, detection reflects our real risks, third-party review is fast enough that nobody routes around it, and the standard holds because it's built into tooling and shared judgment rather than into you

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - ~8+ years in corporate/enterprise security or security engineering, including having owned identity, endpoint, or SaaS security as a domain rather than as a set of tickets

 - Deep hands-on expertise with a modern IdP and with IGA or access-governance tooling (Lumos, Veza, ConductorOne, Opal, or similar)

 - You've designed an entitlement or RBAC model across a large SaaS portfolio and lived with the consequences long enough to know what breaks

 - Endpoint security depth in a macOS-primary fleet: MDM-delivered hardening, compliance and device trust, third-party patch and vulnerability management at scale

 - Strong command of OAuth, SAML, OIDC, and SCIM, and of the risk model behind third-party integrations

 - A track record of setting a security standard that other people applied without you enforcing it — written policy, tooling, defaults, or all three

 - Experience influencing engineering and business teams who don't report to you, early enough in their process to change the outcome

 - Automation fluency: Python or TypeScript, REST APIs, and a habit of building integrations and internal tooling as a normal part of the job

 - Excellent writing and judgment under ambiguity. You can hold a position with an executive and change it when the evidence says to

 - A calibrated sense of risk and how to communicate likelihood, impact, and tradeoffs

Helpful, not required: insider risk or DLP programs, zero-trust network access, SOC 2 or ISO program ownership, just-in-time access patterns or identity-as-code, securing AI agent and non-human identity access, prior experience as the first or second security hire at a fast-growing company.

WORK LOCATION POLICY

This role is expected to work from Suno's NYC or Cambridge, MA office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

ADDITIONAL NOTES

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Willingness to travel (up to 25%) to lead team members and support offices across Suno locations, with a deliberate cadence in Cambridge and NYC during the first six months.

PERKS & BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Company Equity Package

 - 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

 - Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

 - 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

 - 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

 - Creative Education Stipend

 - Generous Commuter Allowance

 - In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.description:
About Emesent
Emesent is a Brisbane-based world leader in autonomous LiDAR mapping and drone autonomy. Our flagship product, Hovermap, delivers autonomous LiDAR mapping in GPS-denied environments for the Mining and Defence sectors. Our newly launched GX1 brings high-performance handheld LiDAR to surveying and the built environment. Behind both sits a pipeline of future hardware products and a team that takes hard engineering problems from concept to the field.

Role Description
The System Administrator reports to the Director of IT & AI and sits within a small IT team. The role is responsible for the design, operation, security, and continuous improvement of the organisation's corporate IT environment. This spans on-premises and cloud infrastructure, Microsoft and Linux platforms, identity and access management, SaaS integrations, endpoint fleet management, and internal engineering compute clusters.
The role is both hands-on and enabling, keeping day-to-day operations running reliably while helping engineering and business teams adopt new technologies, tools, and workflows safely. The successful candidate will act as a technical escalation point (L2/L3) for the service desk and will contribute to governance, disaster recovery, and cybersecurity initiatives across the business.

Key Responsibilities:
Infrastructure & Operations
Administer Windows Server environments, including Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file and certificate services.
Provide L2/L3 operational support, resolving escalations from the Service Desk and complex infrastructure incidents.
Mentor and support L1/L2 Service Desk staff, building their technical capability.
Prioritise tickets in the infrastructure queue, ensuring incidents and requests are resolved within agreed SLAs.
Administer Microsoft 365, including Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, and Intune.
Manage endpoint provisioning and lifecycle for a globally distributed workforce across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Administer VMware and Linux compute clusters and AWS environments, including capacity planning and performance management.
Maintain VPN infrastructure for remote and on-site personnel.
Administer network configuration for Brisbane HQ and remote sites (switching, routing, firewalls, wireless).
Own DR and business continuity initiatives, including backups, restore testing, and infrastructure resilience.
Enable teams to safely adopt new technologies and workflows, including internally developed tools.
Support the secure adoption and governance of AI tools and services across the business, including access controls, data protection, and integration with existing platforms.

Identity & Access Management
Maintain Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, and hybrid identity sync.
Improve access management through Entra ID integrations with SaaS platforms and AWS (SAML/OIDC/SCIM), including automated provisioning and deprovisioning.
Implement least-privilege RBAC and manage the joiner/mover/leaver process; conduct periodic access reviews.

Cybersecurity
Enforce endpoint security policies across Windows, macOS, and Linux using Intune, Defender, and equivalent tooling.
Own patch management and vulnerability management across servers, endpoints, and network devices.
Maintain firewalls, email security (DMARC/DKIM/SPF), web filtering, and endpoint detection and response.
Monitor security alerts, investigate and contain incidents, and support penetration test remediation.
Harden systems against recognised baselines (CIS, Microsoft baselines, ASD Essential Eight).
Support cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance initiatives.

Governance
Maintain documentation, network topology, and the asset register.
Operate and improve change management, including risk assessment, approvals, and rollback planning.
Contribute to IT policies and standards and support audits and compliance.
Track licensing compliance, maintain the IT risk register, and contribute to DR/BC planning (RTO/RPO, DR exercises).
Contribute to and uphold the organisation\u2019s AI policy.

Skills & Experience
5+ years in systems administration within a mixed Windows/Linux enterprise environment.
Windows Server, Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID, including Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, certificate services, Conditional Access, MFA, and hybrid identity.
Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, Intune.
Linux administration (Ubuntu and/or RHEL-based).
VMware vSphere/ESXi and AWS, including cluster and capacity management.
Networking and network security: TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, firewalls, enterprise Wi-Fi, VPN.
Scripting and automation in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical issues and risks to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong documentation discipline: runbooks, network diagrams, change records.
Strong understanding of AI tools and their security, privacy, and data governance implications.

Desirable
Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft (AZ-104, SC-300), AWS Solutions Architect, CCNA, or RHCSA.
Experience applying security baselines (CIS, Microsoft, ASD Essential Eight) in a compliance or audit context.
Experience supporting engineering or HPC compute environments.

The Perks
9-day fortnight \u2014 every second Friday off.
Employee Share Option Plan (ESOP) \u2014 share in Emesent's success.
Genuine learning and development opportunities, including LinkedIn Learning.
Flexible working arrangements and a casual dress code.
Employee Assistance Program and Qoctor online telehealth.
A full day of leave each year for your work anniversary.

Who we are
Emesent builds LiDAR mapping and autonomy technology for the world's most challenging environments. Founded in 2018 from Australia's CSIRO, our products \u2014 Hovermap, GX1, and the Aura software platform \u2014 capture spatial data in hazardous, GPS-denied, and hard-to-reach places for mining, survey, and infrastructure customers worldwide. With multiple product lines spanning hardware, desktop, and cloud, we're at an inflection point \u2014 and this role sits at the technical heart of it.

jobs.description:
WHAT IS BOX?

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

Box IT End User Services' primary role is to provide technical services and support to all employees world-wide. We provide major services such as: desktop and audio video support, new hire on-boarding, advanced application configuration and event support. Our vision is to deliver end user solutions, capabilities and experiences that bring out the ultimate potential of every employee. Our team values: Be passionate to deliver great service, pursue growth and development, and build a positive team spirit.

The Senior IT Support Engineer will join a global team comprised of the most talented IT professionals in the industry. As a Senior Support Engineer, you will manage and resolve an array of mobile, desktop, audio/video, network, and telecommunications issues, ensuring that our employees remain as productive as possible. You must be agile enough to adapt to the rapid growth and change of our business, but also disciplined enough to deal with complex challenges, processes, and people. Your role will involve coaching and mentoring your peers, leading cross-functional projects, and driving end-user technology decisions that will impact Boxers around the world.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

-

Troubleshooting and support for all IT end user issues: mobile, desktop, audio/video, peripherals, etc.

-

Procurement, asset and inventory management for all IT hardware and software

-

Cross-departmental collaboration with teams like Facilities, Sales, and Engineering, People Operations

-

Managing IT communication between headquarters and remote office

-

Perform system imaging, application configurations, and security policy enforcements

-

Daily onsite office support, from Monday to Friday

 WHO YOU ARE

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

-

4+ years of working experience in an IT Support role

-

Working knowledge of Windows and OSX operating systems

-

Working knowledge of Lenovo and Apple hardware

-

Knowledge of networking concepts

-

Lead complex initiatives to scale and transform the business

-

Comprehensive understanding of networking (Network certification a plus)

-

Working knowledge with voice and video conferencing solutions (Zoom, RingCentral a plus)

-

High energy and passion for your work and achievements

-

Excel at everything you put your heart and mind to

-

Willingness to go above and beyond

-

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Polish

-

Excellent teamwork skills

-

Technical certification in desktop operating systems

-

Experience leading large, complex enterprise initiatives on a global scale

- Preferred skills:

  - Mac certification

  - PMP certification

  - Demonstrate that you continue to keep your knowledge and skills up to date

  - Network certification

  - Working knowledge with voice and video conferencing solutions (Zoom, RingCentral a plus)

Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office 5 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.

At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. If you are head-over-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 Join the Growing Solutions Engineering Team!

Solutions Engineers (SEs) at Okta play a pivotal role in the customer journey, helping organizations solve complex identity challenges. We engage with customers at every stage, combining our technical curiosity with business insight to drive meaningful conversations. We’re looking for team players who can create impactful sales presentations, build compelling product demonstrations, and educate a wide audience on modern cloud security solutions.

If you have a strong background in technology, a mindset of continuous learning, and a passion for customer engagement, this role is for you.

 What You’ll be doing:

- Support customers throughout the sales journey (discovery, validation, proposal, due diligence), demonstrating the value of the Okta Platform through live demos and presentations.

- Communicate with stakeholders at all levels of the customer's organization, including CxO, security, developers, Product Managers, and IT administrators.

- Bridge the gap between business and technology for diverse audiences, from security engineers and developers to CISOs and CIOs.

- Partner with the sales team as the go-to technical counterpart, enabling customers to validate the value and potential of the Okta platform.

- Focus on our Okta Workforce Identity solutions, confidently addressing product features and in-depth technical inquiries from customers.

- Design and execute well-defined, outcome-driven Proof of Concepts (POCs).

- Develop a growing understanding of the Okta product line and the underlying technologies and protocols.

- Stay curious, and continuously grow your knowledge in Identity, Security, and more.

- Occasionally, participate in local and regional events, representing Okta as both a speaker and an attendee.

- Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering to provide direct customer feedback and influence product roadmaps.

 What we’re looking for:

- 5+ years of pre-sales engineering experience or a similar customer-facing technical role (e.g., consulting, professional services).

- A strong passion for serving the customer and our partners, ensuring their success.

- Strong communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts and deliver compelling presentations to diverse audiences - even on the fly on a whiteboard.

- Strong problem-solving aptitude, with the ability to troubleshoot integration and identity federation issues

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, MIS, or a related field.

- Interest in Identity and Access Management, cloud technologies, and security concepts.

- Some familiarity with Okta Single Sign-on, Multi-factor Authentication, Passwordless authentication, Universal Directory, Privileged Access, Device Access (or similar) is preferred

- A growth mindset and eagerness to learn technical topics on the job.

- Experience or knowledge of enterprise systems (e.g., Active Directory, HRIS, SaaS applications).

- Familiarity with Zero Trust architecture and modern security concepts.

- Fluency in Polish and English is required.

 Bonus Point For:

- Experience working with customers in any capacity (sales, consulting, support, project management, university projects involving stakeholders).

- Understanding of identity protocols (e.g., SAML, OIDC, OAuth, FIDO, SCIM, LDAP).

- Understanding of identity-related cybersecurity topics (e.g., phishing, MFA bypass attacks, privilege escalation).

- Experience with REST APIs, Postman, or scripting languages (Python, JavaScript, PowerShell).

- Familiarity with AI tools and a basic understanding of how they work.

- Fluency in an additional European language (Dutch, French, or German preferred).

 Why Okta?

Okta is a forward-thinking company that values individuality, career growth, and employee well-being. We are committed to providing opportunities for professional development while making a positive impact in our local communities.

Join us and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of Identity Security!

jobs.description:
A job at TSMC Arizona offers an opportunity to work at the most advanced semiconductor fab in the United States. TSMC Arizona’s first fab will operate its leading-edge semiconductor process technology (N4 process), starting production in the first half of 2025. The second fab will utilize its leading-edge N3 and N2 process technology and be operational in 2028. The recently announced third fab will manufacture chips using 2nm or even more advanced process technology, with production starting by the end of the decade. America’s leading technology companies are ready to rely on TSMC Arizona for the next generations of chips that will power the digital future.

As an IT Client Services Engineer, you will demonstrate a strong sense of reliability and enthusiasm and will possess an attitude that embodies our core values – Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust.

 IT Client Services Engineer

 TSMC Arizona is seeking a highly skilled and motivated IT Client Services Engineer to deliver reliable, secure, and high-quality IT services and technical support to end users across the organization. This role focuses on the deployment, administration, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of end-user computing technologies, including PCs, laptops, mobile devices, printers, and meeting room / collaboration systems.

The engineer will work closely with users, IT infrastructure teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to resolve technical issues, deliver IT projects, improve service quality, and drive standardization and automation across the client environment.

Responsibilities

 End User Computing & Client Service

 Support Windows operating systems, endpoint configurations, software deployment, patching, and lifecycle management. Troubleshoot complex hardware, software, endpoint, connectivity, and application issues. Support large-scale PC/NB deployment, refresh, migration, and technology lifecycle programs.

 Mobile Device Services

 Manage device provisioning, enrollment, configuration, security policies, application deployment, replacement, and lifecycle activities for corporate smartphones, tablets, and other mobile computing devices. Support MDM and enterprise mobility initiatives while ensuring compliance with corporate security standards. Coordinate device deployment and support activities with external vendors and service providers.

 Printer & Peripheral Services

 Manage enterprise printers, multifunction devices, scanners, related peripherals and backend servers across the site. Perform printer deployment, configuration, troubleshooting, monitoring, and lifecycle management. Coordinate with vendors and system integrators for installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and service improvement. Monitor service performance and identify opportunities to improve availability and cost efficiency.

 Meeting Room & Collaboration Technology

 Partner with AV and collaboration technology vendors to deliver reliable and standardized meeting room solutions. Perform installation, configuration, testing, troubleshooting and lifecycle management of meeting room technology. Support meeting room technology upgrades, expansions, and new site deployments.

 IT Projects & Service Improvement

 Lead or participate in IT technology deployment and infrastructure projects across manufacturing and office environments. Support new building, facility, and workspace deployments, including endpoint, mobile, printing, and collaboration technologies. Coordinate project activities across IT teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and contractors. Support technology rollouts while minimizing operational impact to manufacturing and business operations. Work with external vendors, system integrators, and managed service providers to deliver IT services and projects. Evaluate technical solutions, service quality, and vendor performance.

Minimum Qualifications/Requirements

 Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Experience: Minimum 2 years’ experience in IT client services, endpoint computing, desktop engineering, workplace technology, or a related field. Technical Skills: Strong hands-on experience with Windows PC and laptop hardware, operating systems, peripherals, and enterprise applications. Experience supporting mobile devices and enterprise mobility environments. Experience with printer deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting. Experience supporting meeting rooms, video conferencing, or collaboration technologies. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues across hardware, software, network, and application layers. Interpersonal Skills: Strong communication and customer service skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical users. Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple tasks, and manage projects in a fast-paced enterprise environment. Physical Requirements: This role requires the ability to work across office, clean-room, and data center environments, performing tasks that range from standard office duties to specialized operations in controlled spaces, including the ability to occasionally stand, walk, reach, bend, and carry light objects. Occasionally lift or move up to 40 pounds. Ability to use a computer, keyboard, mouse and other standard office equipment for prolonged periods of time. Ability to wear clean-room suit while standing and/or walking in the FAB as needed. Ability to complete occasional local travel requirements.
Shift Expectations

 Standard work hours: Monday through Friday 9am to 6pm Support TSMC Arizona’s 24/7/365 operations by participating in a rotational on-call schedule (approximately one full week every two months), requiring 24/7 responsiveness during your designated shift to meet urgent business needs.

Application Consideration Consent

By applying to this position, I acknowledge and agree that my application and qualifications may be considered for other roles within the company. However, I reserve the right to withdraw my consent for future consideration of other roles within the company at any time.

Candidates must be willing and able to work on-site at our Phoenix Arizona facility.

Benefits

As a valued member of the TSMC family, we place a significant focus on your health and well-being. When you are at your best—physically, mentally, and financially—our company thrives. TSMC offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits program that includes:

 Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans: Choose the options that best fit your and your family’s needs. Income-Protection Programs: Financial assistance during injury or illness. 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan: Secure your financial future with competitive employer contributions. Paid Time-Off Programs and Holidays: Recharge and spend quality time with loved ones.

 Work Location : 5088 W. Innovation Circle, Phoenix, AZ 85083

TSMC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and welcome applications from diverse backgrounds and experiences. Candidates must be able to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation. If you need an accommodation as part of the application process, please contact P_LOA@tsmc.com .

TSMC Arizona maintains the right to change or assign other duties to this position.

All offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of TSMC Arizona’s pre-employment screening process. This process may include verifying the candidate’s identity, confirming legal authorization to work in the offered position's location, educational background and a comprehensive background check, where permitted by local regulations.

About the Role:

The Systems & Endpoint Administrator provides end-user support, administers endpoint devices and Microsoft 365 services, and supports technology operations across the organization. The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills with a customer-focused approach and enjoys solving problems in a collaborative environment.

We directly serve approximately 500 children annually through our school, home-based programs, and community partnership sites. As a proud member of the Educare Learning Network and the Head Start community, we are deeply committed to providing high quality early childhood education through a whole-child, whole-family approach. Our unique location on a 20-acre historic campus in Denver is the foundation for our strategic vision to become a thriving neighborhood center to serve the community more fully, addressing needs including food security and health care access. Our team of over 125 dedicated professionals works in a supportive environment of collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

 Problem-solving with resilience, emotional intelligence, and a solution-oriented mindset.
 Exceptional customer service and communication skills.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Technical Skills

The perks:

 Mental health support through our medical plan and EAP
 Long-term disability coverage
 401(k) with 5% employer match after 1 year
 FSA plans
 College 529 investment options
 Identity theft protection and more

Clayton's Core Values

At Clayton Early Learning, we believe that our core values help to drive actions and create habits that allow our belief in the unlimited potential of young children to become a reality. We seek candidates who demonstrate our core values and are motivated by a value-driven environment.

 Collaboration builds trust and relationships and brings new ideas, skills, and knowledge to help us do better work.

Our focus is on enabling our clients to deliver their mission most efficiently and effectively – anytime, anywhere, securely. We combine technical expertise, mission awareness, and an empowered workforce to produce meaningful results.

 SkyePoint Decisions is seeking a Senior Intune Engineer to support a Department of State (DOS) customer.

 This senior-level Windows engineering position provides IT support in integrating and operating Microsoft Configuration Manager (MCM) and Intune for managing and maintaining department endpoints. The preferred candidate will be a senior IT engineer with extensive hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, and MCM. Direct hands-on experience in providing Tier 3 support for MCM and Intune issues within a large government organization.

  This position follows a hybrid work schedule, requiring on-site attendance three days per week in Washington, D.C.

  Participate in a dedicated engineering team to configure, operate and maintain endpoint patching services with MCM and Intune AutoPatch at an enterprise level.
  Identify and configure endpoint collections to be added to the Intune Rings for testing and production rollout.
  Develop and generate tailored Intune performance reports.
  Plan, package, and deploy recurring Windows quality and feature updates with Intune.
  Support policy, app and device configuration management for endpoints, including test, deployment, and maintenance activities.
  Develop Intune related technical documentation such as system administrator guides, knowledge articles, quick reference guides, SOPs, FAQs.

  Required Qualifications:

  Bachelor degree in computer science or a related field and 9 years or more of related experience or a Masters degree and 7 years of related experience.
  Hands-on Microsoft system administrator experience in operating and maintaining Microsoft 365 services using Intune and MS Entra ID.
  Prior experience in providing Tier 3 support for Intune, MCM, and Distribution Points.
  Experience with configuring and maintaining Microsoft AzureArc in a hybrid environment.
  Experience in packaging and deploying Windows and application patches using MCM.
  Experienced with implementing and managing endpoints at scale using MCM, MS Intune, Windows Autopatch, and MS Entra ID for endpoint.
  Experienced in developing complex status reports from multiple data sources using Power BI.
  Must have an Active Secret clearance with ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance.
  Must be a U.S. citizen.

  Preferred Qualifications:

  PowerShell scripting and Group Policy management.
  Prior work experience supporting U.S. government agencies.

  Compensation:

jobs.description:
## **Descripción:**

En Grupo de Empresas eXperience seguimos creciendo y apostando por el talento tecnológico. Somos un grupo con más de 25 años de trayectoria, especializado en soluciones y servicios IT, y trabajamos con clientes de primer nivel en proyectos estables y de larga duración.

Buscamos un/a Técnico/a Senior Endpoint con experiencia en Microsoft Intune y gestión de Modern Desktop para incorporarse a un proyecto en un entorno corporativo de media/alta complejidad, en modalidad híbrida en Barcelona.

**Misión**

Administrar y evolucionar el puesto de trabajo moderno de la organización, garantizando la correcta gestión de los dispositivos Windows 10/11 mediante Intune y ConfigMgr, y aportando explotación de datos y reporting técnico que ayude a tomar decisiones.

**Funciones**

Administración de dispositivos Windows 10/11 en entornos corporativos mediante Microsoft Intune (Endpoint Manager).

Gestión de Modern Desktop: despliegue, configuración, políticas y ciclo de vida del puesto de trabajo.

Uso de Microsoft Graph para consultas, explotación de datos y automatización de procesos técnicos.

Soporte funcional en entornos híbridos con SCCM / ConfigMgr.

Elaboración y mantenimiento de informes técnicos a partir de bases de datos (SQL) y Excel avanzado (macros/VBA, integración de datos externos).

Troubleshooting avanzado de incidencias de endpoint.

Interlocución técnica con equipos internos, clientes y fabricantes (Microsoft, Google, Apple, etc.).

**¿Qué ofrecemos?**

Proyecto estable y de larga duración.

Modalidad híbrida en Barcelona.

Horario flexible de lunes a viernes, dentro de una franja de cobertura de 8:00 a 20:00.

Entorno tecnológico moderno basado en el ecosistema Microsoft.

Crecimiento profesional en un entorno colaborativo y dinámico.

## **Requisitos:**

- Titulación de Grado Superior en Administración de Sistemas Informáticos.
- Al menos 2 años de experiencia en un puesto similar.
- Experiencia demostrable, a nivel senior, en Microsoft Intune (Endpoint Manager), gestión de Modern Desktop y administración de Windows 10/11 en entornos corporativos.
- Conocimientos sólidos y experiencia práctica con Microsoft Graph (imprescindible) para consultas, explotación de datos y procesos técnicos.
- Reporting y explotación de bases de datos, con SQL a nivel de consulta.
- Excel avanzado: grandes volúmenes de datos, estructuración tipo BBDD, fórmulas avanzadas, informes técnicos y automatización con macros/VBA o integración con datos externos.
- Conocimiento funcional de SCCM / ConfigMgr en entornos híbridos.
- Experiencia en entornos empresariales de media/alta complejidad.
- Capacidad de troubleshooting avanzado, trabajo autónomo y comunicación técnica con equipos y clientes.
- Inglés técnico de nivel medio, suficiente para seguir conversaciones técnicas con proveedores y fabricantes y para explicar incidencias y hacer seguimiento de casos, tanto de forma oral como escrita.

**Valorable**

- Experiencia en MDM / movilidad: Android Enterprise e iOS / iPadOS.
- Conocimientos de Entra ID (Azure AD).
- Seguridad del endpoint: Microsoft Defender y compliance policies.
- Automatización con PowerShell.
- Certificaciones Microsoft, especialmente Endpoint Administrator (MD-102), Intune / Modern Desktop, SCCM / ConfigMgr o Azure / Security.

En Grupo de Empresas eXperience creemos en la igualdad de oportunidades y valoramos la diversidad. Todas las candidaturas serán consideradas sin distinción de género, edad, origen, orientación sexual, discapacidad o cualquier otra condición personal o social.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer – MDM
jobs.summary: **DataSpurs** es *Partner Platinum en España y Portugal de Informatica by SalesForce* . Con un equipo liderado por personas con una dilatada trayectoria reconocida dentro del sector, como compañía se centra en su único ámbito de actuación en el que es...
jobs.description:
**DataSpurs** es *Partner Platinum en España y Portugal de Informatica by SalesForce* . Con un equipo liderado por personas con una dilatada trayectoria reconocida dentro del sector, como compañía se centra en su único ámbito de actuación en el que es especialista: ***Data*** . En DataSpurs defendemos una ***alta especialización*** para la definición, desarrollo e implantación de soluciones en el ámbito de *Big Data, Data Governance y Cloud Data Management*, especialmente con productos de la Plataforma Informatica IDMC.

Nuestro modelo de negocio está centrado en la realización de acciones puramente de *consultoría estratégica* en *cliente final*; nuestro crecimiento no viene determinado por la asignación de consultores a clientes, sino por la incorporación de personas a un equipo interno que contribuyan a desarrollar conocimiento y soluciones que posteriormente serán implantadas en cliente para dar respuesta a esas acciones de consultoría estratégica.

Debido al proceso de desarrollo interno que *DataSpurs* está atravesando, en la actualidad queremos ampliar el equipo dentro del áreade consultoría con perfiles de **CONSULTOR** para iniciativas de **Master Data Management (MDM)** . Incorporando a una persona con amplia trayectoria técnica para nuestra oficina de **MADRID** en un modelo de trabajo principalmente en remoto.

**FUNCIONES**:

Participará activamente en la puesta en marcha de iniciativas de MDM multidominio en entornos Cloud o híbridos, contribuyendo en la definición de la estrategia y enfoque más adecuado en función de las distintas casuísticas planteadas ya sea en el ámbito técnico y/o funcional. Contribuirá al diseño de soluciones realizando, entre otras funciones:

* definición e implementación del *framework* de MDM para garantizar una única fuente de verdad (*single source of truth*) en los datos más críticos de la organización
* consolidación e integración de datos maestros provenientes de múltiples sistemas origen (ERP, CRM, *eCommerce* , etc.) con diferentes patrones de ingesta (*batch, realtime, cdc*...)
* diseño y creación de reglas de calidad, limpieza y duplicación de registros inconsistentes o duplicados
* definición de políticas de gobierno de datos y flujos de trabajo (*workflows*) para establecer reglas claras sobre la creación, modificación y mantenimiento de datos maestros
* definición de las reglas de *match, merge, survivorship* para la generación del*golden record*
* modelado de datos maestros y diseño de arquitecturas para la distribución de la versión correcta de los datos a todos los sistemas consumidores
* gestión de requerimientos con el cliente y colaboración estrecha con otros miembros del equipo

**REQUISITOS**:

* experiencia previa de 3 años en proyectos de gestión de datos, idealmente enfocados en Master Data Management (MDM)
* conocimientos sólidos de:
* modelado de datos (modelos relacionales) y lenguaje SQL
* arquitecturas de datos y flujos de integración
* aspectos funcionales en los distintos procesos de negocio involucrados en la gestión de datos maestros (clientes, proveedores, productos)
* definición de reglas: calidad y aplicabilidad de las reglas de calidad propuestas
* experiencia real y demostrable con herramientas líderes de mercado, con especial interés en Informatica MDM (MDM cloud / IDMC), o soluciones similares como *SAP Master Data Governance, IBM Master Data Management, Stibo Systems o Semarchy*
* alta capacidad de interlocución con los diferentes *stakholders* implicados
* capacidad para trabajar en entornos ágiles y colaborativos
* perfil analítico, orientado a la calidad y resolución de problemas

**IMPORTANTE**:

* CERTIFICACIONES: debido al nivel de *partnership* que mantenemos y el *expertise* ofrecido, se mantiene un programa de certificaciones muy activo ayudando al equipo a obtener las certificaciones necesarias

**¿POR QUÉ DATASPURS?:**

* Visión a largo plazo: incorporarmos profesionales para que crezcan con nosotros en nuestras disciplinas clave, más allá de contrataciones para proyectos concretos
* proyectos tecnológicamente punteros y de alta especialización en el área de Data Management
* trabajo principalmente en remoto y flexibilidad horaria
* programa de inglés individualizado y 100% financiado por la compañía
* entorno de trabajo con calidad y calidez, en contenido y forma
* retribución flexible (cheques restaurant, seguro médico, cheque guardería)
* desarrollo profesional personalizado, considerando los intereses y motivaciones de cada persona
* ambiente de trabajo: informal a la vez que altamente profesional y competente

*DATASPURS está comprometida con la diversidad, la inclusión y la igualdad de trato, promoviendo una política transparente de atracción, selección y contratación que garantice la igualdad de oportunidades a todos los candidat@s, sin hacer ninguna exclusión por motivos de sexo, edad, raza u otra condición no relacionada con el buen desempeño del puesto que se desea cubrir.*

jobs.description:
Create a better #TomorrowWithUs 🚀

At Siemens, we build technology solutions to shape the world we live in. We transform industries and societies by combining the real and digital worlds. With over 300.000 of the world's most forward-thinking minds and the power of a presence in more than 190 countries, we make a truly global impact.

The Cyber Defense Endpoint Detection and Response specialist is a member of the Siemens Cyber Defense Center, whose primary mission is to defend Siemens against cybersecurity threats worldwide.

This role combines hands-on technical expertise in close collaboration with multi-disciplinary Cyber Security Team members (Security Analysts, Threat Hunting, Incident Response, Data Science, SecDevOps, Threat Intelligence etc) to help improving Siemens cyber threat protection posture. As an Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) specialist, you should have a team-oriented, client-facing mindset and proven experience in EDR infrastructure and platform deployments.

You will play a key role in supporting the design, deployment, configuration, optimization, operation, and monitoring of large-scale EDR deployments across Siemens using leading vendor technologies. This role requires the ability to respond to a wide range of issues, from enhancing existing detection and prevention measures to maintaining and expanding deployments and supporting customer end users.

Are you ready to be part of the change? Come join us! ⭐

Your mission will be..

* Actively contribute to an international team of Siemens cybersecurity professionals supporting globally deployed EDR solutions.
* Be engaged in the evaluation, design, implementation and management of new approaches leveraging the EDR solutions and capabilities of our state-of-the-art detection platforms.
* Interface with cybersecurity groups across business units and with supported end users to resolve EDR-related challenges.
* Contribute to cybersecurity-related events and provide status information to the management team to support effective response and decision-making.
* Help improve Siemens' security posture by supporting governance policies, increasing EDR coverage, and maintaining a strong company-wide security posture.
* Help drive new EDR capabilities by applying automation methods, API-based integrations, and CI/CD approaches.
* Contribute to knowledge creation and sharing.
* Participate in 24x7 on-call support for EDR platform management and vendor escalation.

We are looking for someone with...

* Minimum 2 years of practical proven experience with CrowdStrike Falcon Platform administration.
* Availability for performing 24x7 On Call Management Support.
* Proficiency in written and spoken English.
* Good interpersonal communication skills and strong collaboration in international and virtual teams.
* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with peers, partners, and customers especially in translating security topics into business language.
* Proactive monitoring and ownership mentality while maintaining a collaborative international group approach to support our Global EDR deployments.
* Operating system (Windows and Linux) advanced troubleshooting knowledge.
* Experience writing structured technical documentation.
* University degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a similar field, or equivalent overall experience in cybersecurity.
* Willingness to build up and share your technical knowledge.
* Ability to travel internationally and nationally as business and time permits.
* CrowdStrike Falcon Platform certification, such as CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA), is a plus.
* IP networking fundamentals are a plus.
* Knowledge of global deployment, configuration, automation methods, and related toolsets is a plus.
* Project and delivery management experience is a plus.

What We Offer

FTE:

* Belong \& Innovate: Work in diverse teams where every idea matters and innovation grows through collaboration and trust.
* Flexibility that Works: Hybrid model, flexible hours, and a home office budget --- because balance fuels performance.
* Health \& Well-being: Comprehensive health insurance, mental health support, and active sports communities to keep you feeling your best.
* Grow Without Limits: Access world-class learning platforms, mentoring, and continuous development opportunities.
* Purpose \& Perks: Contribute to sustainability and volunteer initiatives, enjoy partner discounts, and take advantage of our convenient shuttle service.

Please attach your CV in English to your application.

#Siemens

Siemens is deeply committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourage applications from a wide array of talented individuals!

jobs.description:
The L2 Endpoint Engineer is responsible for **administration, support, and optimization of Apple device management platforms** , primarily **JAMF Pro** , covering **macOS and iOS/iPadOS devices**.

This role includes **device lifecycle management, application packaging \& deployment, patching, policy enforcement, and compliance management** . The engineer is expected to **troubleshoot complex Apple endpoint issues and ensure a seamless user experience**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**JAMF Platform Administration**

* Administer and support **JAMF Pro** environment
* Manage:
* Device inventory and smart groups
* Policies and configuration profiles
* Enrollment workflows (DEP/Automated Device Enrollment)
* Monitor JAMF health, sync status, and device communication

**Device Lifecycle Management (macOS \& iOS)**

* Handle end-to-end lifecycle:
* Enrollment (Automated \& manual)
* Provisioning and configuration
* Decommissioning
* Support:
* macOS devices (laptops/desktops)
* iOS/iPadOS devices (iPhones, iPads)
* Ensure devices are compliant with corporate standards

**Application Packaging \& Deployment (macOS)**

* Package and deploy applications using:
* PKG / DMG formats
* JAMF policies
* Handle:
* App testing and validation
* Version upgrades and patching
* Troubleshoot installation failures and dependency issues

**Patch Management (macOS \& iOS)**

* Manage OS and third-party patching using JAMF
* Define and deploy patch policies and schedules
* Monitor patch compliance and remediation
* Troubleshoot patch deployment failures

**Policy \& Configuration Management**

* Create and manage:
* Configuration profiles (Wi-Fi, VPN, security settings)
* Restrictions and compliance policies
* Integrate with:
* Apple Business Manager (ABM)
* Identity providers (Azure AD / Okta)
* Ensure alignment with security baselines

**Incident \& Problem Management**

* Act as L2 resolver for:
* Device enrollment failures
* Application deployment issues
* Patch failures
* Policy conflicts
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues
* Escalate to L3/vendor with proper logs when required

**Automation \& Scripting**

* Use scripting for automation:
* Bash / Shell scripting (primary for macOS)
* Basic Python (good to have)
* Automate:
* Application deployments
* Device configurations
* Remediation tasks

**Compliance, Reporting \& Documentation**

* Generate reports on:
* Device compliance
* Patch status
* Application deployment success
* Maintain SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge base
* Support audit requirements

**Collaboration \& Support**

* Work with L1 team for triage improvements
* Collaborate with:
* Security teams (compliance \& policies)
* Identity teams (SSO, conditional access)
* Provide clear communication to end users and stakeholders

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

**Technical Skills (Core)**

* Strong hands-on experience in:
* **JAMF Pro administration**
* macOS device management
* iOS/iPadOS device management (MDM)
* Good understanding of:
* Apple Business Manager (ABM)
* Automated Device Enrollment (DEP)
* Apple Volume Purchase Program (VPP / Apps \& Books)

**Packaging \& Scripting**

* Application packaging:
* PKG / DMG
* Scripting:
* Bash / Shell (mandatory for macOS support mindset)

**Integration Knowledge**

* Identity integration:
* Azure AD / Okta (preferred)
* Basic understanding of:
* Certificates, profiles, and device trust

**Process Knowledge**

* ITIL processes:
* Incident, Problem, Change Management
* Experience in patch cycles and compliance reporting

**Soft Skills**

* Strong troubleshooting mindset (must understand Apple ecosystem behavior)
* Clear communication with global users
* Attention to detail (Apple policies can be strict and sensitive)

**Experience \& Education**

* 3--6 years of experience in Apple endpoint / JAMF support
* Bachelor's degree in IT or related field
* Certifications (good to have):
* JAMF 100/200
* Apple Device Support

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Device compliance rate (%)
* Patch compliance (macOS \& iOS)
* Application deployment success rate
* Incident resolution time (MTTR)
* Reduction in repeat issues
* User experience / CSAT
