With 1,700 employees and 14 factories across 3 continents, STERIMED is the world's leading manufacturer of materials and packaging systems for the sterilization of medical devices. Sterimed develops, produces, converts, and markets various solutions such as bacterial barrier substrates and preformed sterilization packaging, serving both hospitals and medical device manufacturers.

Sterimed stands out with its strong entrepreneurial DNA and has been pursuing a highly dynamic external growth policy for several years. Since its founding in 2016, the group's size has quadrupled, and 10 acquisitions have been completed since 2017.

To support this growth, we are looking for a Sales Manager M/F for our MDM business unit covering Costa Rica and Mexico.

Reporting to the MDM Sales Team Leader Americas, the Sales Manager is responsible for managing, developing, and closing profitable new business across Costa Rica and parts of Mexico, primarily the surrounding areas of Mexico City. The primary focus of this role is selling medical packaging solutions to medical device manufacturers while also managing and growing an existing portfolio of customers. This is a remote role based in in Costa Rica.

This position requires a strong commercial mindset, excellent prospecting skills, and the ability to convert business opportunities into sustainable and profitable orders. The Sales Manager will work closely with customers, internal technical teams, and key stakeholders to support product validation, strengthen customer relationships, and drive order intake and market growth.

The ideal candidate will be a collaborative and transparent team player who can operate successfully in a multicultural, cross-border environment. This role also requires strong project management skills, the ability to build annual sales forecasts and budgets, and a commitment to delivering results in a dynamic, international business setting.

The position involves frequent travel throughout the assigned territory, including surrounding areas of Mexico City and Costa Rica and France for company seminars and business meetings.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

• Grow sales within the assigned territory of surrounding areas of Mexico City and Costa Rica

• Develop new business opportunities with medical device manufacturers.

• Manage and expand an existing customer portfolio.

• Prospect actively to identify and convert new commercial opportunities.

• Support product validation projects in coordination with customers and the technical department.

• Act as the link between customers and internal stakeholders to ensure effective communication and follow-up.

• Turn business opportunities into profitable orders.

• Build annual sales budgets based on customer forecasts and new business opportunities.

• Maintain accurate reporting and CRM updates.

• Apply company marketing and commercial policies consistently.

• Travel regularly within the territory and occasionally internationally as required.

**Qualifications**

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, International Trade, Business Negotiation, Packaging En-gineering, or a related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an export sales or B2B sales position.

• Experience in medical sterile packaging is preferred; experience in general packaging or food packaging will also be considered.

• Strong understanding of sales processes, customer development, and account management.

• Experience working with technical or project-based sales cycles is an asset.

**Skills and Competencies**

• Strong prospecting and business development skills.

• Excellent negotiation and communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and customer projects simultaneously.

• Strong reporting, planning, and forecasting capabilities.

• Proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and CRM tools.

• Knowledge of Incoterms is preferred.

• Able to work effectively in an international and multicultural environment.

• Customer-focused, proactive, self-driven, and results-oriented.

• Strong relationship-building and problem-solving abilities.

• Adaptable and eager to learn about a new industry or market segment.

**Language Requirement**

• Bilingual in English and Spanish is required.

**Travel Requirement**

• Travel approximately 50% to 70% of the time within the assigned territory.

• Occasional travel outside of territory but within the Americas and France for company seminars or business meetings.

*Sterimed is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible work environment. Feel free to let us know about any accommodations you may need to participate in the recruitment process.*

jobs.summary: This role leads Employee Technology & Digital Workplace, a significant function within Digital and Technology, directing the Service Desk and ServiceNow ITSM platform, employee lifecycle technology (onboarding/offboarding), digital workplace engineering,...
jobs.description:
This role leads Employee Technology & Digital Workplace, a significant function within Digital and Technology, directing the Service Desk and ServiceNow ITSM platform, employee lifecycle technology (onboarding/offboarding), digital workplace engineering, field/deskside support, and M365 and collaboration platform delivery through subordinate management. The Executive Director determines the organizational structure and operational direction for the function and participates with senior management in developing the strategic plans and objectives that govern it, ensuring the function's direction remains tied to company-wide performance and responds effectively to Regeneron's constantly changing business needs.

The Executive Director brings in-depth knowledge of the functional area, Regeneron's business strategies, and the company's goals to reposition employee-facing IT as a modern, consumer-grade digital experience. Decisions on strategy, investment, and operating model in this function have a measurable, long-term effect on employee productivity, cost-to-serve, and the company's ability to attract and retain talent — the Executive Director is expected to bring strength and clarity to the function during periods of growth or major change, and to lead effectively even where direction is ambiguous.

This is the next iteration of IT service delivery at Regeneron — evolving the function from a ticket- and SLA-driven operation into a proactive, experience-led organization measured on employee sentiment, self-service adoption, and time-to-resolution, not just uptime. The Executive Director partners closely with Enterprise Architecture on technical standards and platform decisions, and with IT Strategy & Transformation, which sponsors chartered modernization initiatives into this tower without assuming direct reporting authority.

Where and When

This is an on-site position 4 days/week, primarily based at our Sleepy Hollow, NY or Warren, NJ office. If eligible, we can offer relocation benefits; we cannot offer a fully remote option.

What You'll Lead

Employee Technology Strategy & Digital Experience Vision

Participate with senior IT and business leadership in developing the strategic plans and objectives for employee technology, ensuring the function's direction stays tied to company-wide performance and adapts to constantly changing business needs.

Define and own the vision, roadmap, and operating model for Employee Technology & Digital Workplace, positioning IT as a modern, consumer-grade digital experience rather than a traditional service organization.

Translate employee and business feedback into a prioritized modernization roadmap across service desk, ITSM, endpoint, and lifecycle technology.

Champion a "digital-first, self-service-first" philosophy, shifting volume away from live support and toward intuitive, automated, and AI-enabled experiences.

Partner with IT Strategy & Transformation to align sponsored modernization initiatives (e.g., virtual agent/AI deflection, unified employee portal) with this tower's operational roadmap and capacity.

Service Desk & ITSM Operations (ServiceNow)

Own end-to-end Service Desk operations, including tiered support, major incident management, and escalation processes across a global, follow-the-sun model.

Drive continuous modernization of the ServiceNow platform — intelligent routing, virtual agent/chatbot deflection, knowledge management, and workflow automation — to reduce ticket volume and resolution time.

Establish and monitor experience-led metrics (CSAT, first-contact resolution, deflection rate, mean time to resolve) as the primary measures of success, alongside traditional SLAs.

Ensure ticketing, request, and knowledge processes are simple, consistent, and easy for employees to navigate regardless of how they choose to engage (portal, chat, phone, walk-up).

Own GRC, vendor risk management (VRM), and policy exception workflows on the ServiceNow platform, ensuring timely processing and audit-ready records.

Own portal and content management for the ServiceNow platform, ensuring employees can easily find and act on the right services and policies.

Employee Lifecycle Technology (Onboarding & Offboarding)

Own the technology experience for onboarding, transfers, and offboarding, ensuring new hires are productive on day one and departures are secure and frictionless.

Modernize onboarding/offboarding into an automated, orchestrated workflow spanning identity, access provisioning, equipment, and collaboration tools — eliminating manual handoffs across HR, IT, and Security.

Partner with HR, Security, and Facilities to design a seamless, employee-centric lifecycle journey, with clear accountability for every step and status transparent to the employee and their manager.

Continuously reduce time-to-productivity for new hires and time-to-deprovision for departures, tracking both as core experience and risk metrics.

Digital Workplace Engineering & Endpoint Experience

Own engineering and lifecycle management for employee-facing technology: endpoints, mobility, unified endpoint management (UEM), collaboration tools, and meeting room/AV technology.

Drive modernization of the digital workplace — proactive device health monitoring, zero-touch provisioning, self-healing endpoints, and simplified software deployment — to minimize disruption to employees.

Ensure collaboration and meeting technologies (video, conferencing, messaging) provide a consistently excellent experience across office, lab, and hybrid work settings.

Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Security to ensure digital workplace standards remain secure, scalable, and aligned to enterprise architecture principles.

M365 & Collaboration Platform Delivery

Own service delivery for the M365 platform — Teams, SharePoint, Exchange, OneDrive, and Power Automate — including platform guardrails, governance, and adoption.

Own voice and unified communications service delivery, ensuring reliable, modern calling and conferencing capability across the enterprise.

Drive continuous improvement of collaboration tooling to reduce friction and support hybrid and global ways of working.

Partner with Enterprise Architecture on platform roadmap decisions and with Security on data governance within M365 workloads.

Field & Deskside Support Operations

Own field and deskside support across all Regeneron sites, ensuring consistent, high-quality in-person support where self-service and remote resolution aren't sufficient.

Right-size the deskside support model as digital self-service and remote resolution capabilities mature, reallocating capacity toward higher-value, in-person needs (labs, executive support, events).

Ensure support models scale appropriately across site types (corporate, R&D/lab, manufacturing) with services tailored to how each site's population actually works.

Own end-to-end lifecycle management of end-user assets — procurement coordination, deployment, tracking, refresh cycles, and secure disposal/decommissioning.

Maintain accurate asset inventory and compliance reporting to support audit, cost management, and security requirements.

Experience Measurement & Continuous Improvement

Establish a consistent employee experience measurement framework (CSAT, NPS, effort scores) across every touchpoint in this tower, replacing purely operational SLA reporting.

Run a continuous improvement cadence — mining ticket, sentiment, and usage data to identify friction points and prioritize fixes before they become recurring complaints.

Report employee technology experience trends and improvement outcomes to executive stakeholders, connecting operational data to business and workforce impact.

Vendor & Platform Management

Own vendor relationships and contracts for service desk, ITSM, endpoint, and digital workplace tooling, ensuring value, performance, and roadmap alignment.

Establish a vendor governance cadence — performance scorecards, quarterly business reviews, and value/ROI tracking — holding vendors accountable to continuous improvement commitments rather than static contract terms.

Partner with Finance and Procurement to manage the cost-to-serve for employee technology, balancing experience improvements against operating budget discipline.

Evaluate emerging digital workplace and AI-enabled support technologies, building the business case for adoption where they meaningfully improve employee experience or reduce cost-to-serve.

People Leadership, Mentoring & Team Culture

Determine the organizational structure and operational direction for the function, directing critical work through subordinate managers and senior leaders.

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing, globally distributed organization across service desk, lifecycle technology, digital workplace engineering, and field support.

Mentor and coach people leaders across the organization, investing in career growth, succession planning, and bench strength.

Model and reinforce a customer-obsessed, continuous-improvement culture, holding the team accountable to employee experience outcomes, not just ticket throughput.

Champion development and team culture within the function, fostering collaboration across a global, follow-the-sun operating model.

Key Working Relationships

This role is viewed across Regeneron as a role model for employee-centric technology delivery and is regularly sought out by leaders at all levels for advice on employee technology matters. Because much of this role's influence runs through governance and partnership rather than direct authority over every function it touches, it also serves as the principal spokesperson for employee technology and digital workplace matters on highly significant issues, and is expected to negotiate difficult matters with senior management and functional heads, both internally and externally.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Engineering, or a related field is required. A master's degree or MBA is preferred.

17+ years of progressive experience in IT service delivery, end-user computing, digital workplace, or IT operations leadership roles.

Deep expertise in ITIL or equivalent service management frameworks, and hands-on experience modernizing an ITSM platform (ServiceNow strongly preferred).

Proven experience redesigning employee lifecycle technology (onboarding/offboarding) into an automated, cross-functional workflow spanning IT, HR, and Security.

Strong grounding in digital workplace and end-user computing technologies — unified endpoint management, collaboration platforms, mobility, and AV/conferencing.

Track record of building and using experience metrics (CSAT, NPS, deflection rate, first-contact resolution) to drive continuous improvement, not just SLA compliance.

Experience leveraging automation, self-service, and AI/virtual agent technologies to reduce support volume and improve employee experience.

Proven ability to build, scale, and lead large, globally distributed service organizations, including hiring, developing, and retaining talent across a follow-the-sun model.

Experience operating in a matrixed, governance-driven environment — partnering with peers in Enterprise Architecture and IT Strategy & Transformation without direct authority over their teams.

Strong vendor and contract management experience, including negotiating and managing platform and outsourced support relationships, with a track record of driving ongoing vendor performance and value through structured governance (scorecards, business reviews).

Sound business and financial acumen, with experience managing cost-to-serve and building business cases for employee technology investment.

Proven ability to bring strength and clarity to a business during periods of growth or major change, exercising sound judgment and taking a positive leadership role amid ambiguity or limited direction.

jobs.description:
**Consultor MDM Senior**

**Habilidades Requeridas:**

* Experiencia sólida en iniciativas de Data Governance y Master Data Management (MDM).
* Experiencia realizando assessments de capacidades de Gobierno de Datos y gestión de datos maestros.
* Conocimiento en modelos operativos de Gobierno de Datos, incluyendo roles de Data Owner, Data Steward y Data Custodian.
* Experiencia en evaluación e implementación de procesos de Data Quality, Data Stewardship y Data Ownership.
* Conocimiento de marcos de referencia de Gobierno de Datos y Gestión de Datos (DAMA-DMBOK, DCAM o similares).
* Capacidad para evaluar la adopción y efectividad de plataformas MDM a nivel organizacional.
* Experiencia en definición de políticas, estándares, controles y métricas de datos.
* Conocimiento de regulaciones y requerimientos de cumplimiento aplicables al sector financiero.
* Habilidad para facilitar workshops y sesiones de levantamiento con áreas de negocio y tecnología.
* Experiencia elaborando diagnósticos ejecutivos, análisis de brechas y roadmaps de transformación.
* Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, análisis y gestión de stakeholders.

**Deseable:**

* Experiencia en banca, seguros o instituciones financieras.
* Conocimiento de herramientas MDM como Informatica MDM, Reltio, Profisee, SAP MDG, Semarchy o IBM MDM.
* Experiencia en iniciativas de transformación digital y modernización de capacidades de datos.
* Conocimiento de Data Quality Management, Metadata Management y Data Lineage.
* Experiencia trabajando con arquitecturas de datos en la nube (Azure, AWS o GCP).
* Certificaciones relacionadas con Gobierno de Datos, Gestión de Datos o Arquitectura Empresarial.
* Conocimiento de metodologías ágiles y gestión de programas de transformación.

**Responsabilidades:**

* Ejecutar un assessment integral de las capacidades actuales de Data Governance y Master Data Management.
* Evaluar la madurez organizacional en la gestión de datos maestros y gobierno de datos.
* Analizar el modelo operativo de gobierno, incluyendo roles, responsabilidades, procesos y mecanismos de control.
* Evaluar la adopción, uso y efectividad de la plataforma MDM por parte de las áreas de negocio y tecnología.
* Revisar procesos de Data Quality, Data Stewardship, Data Ownership y Data Governance para identificar oportunidades de mejora.
* Analizar políticas, estándares, controles, indicadores y métricas relacionadas con la gestión de datos maestros.
* Identificar brechas organizacionales, operativas, tecnológicas y regulatorias que impacten la gestión de datos.
* Facilitar workshops con stakeholders de negocio, tecnología, riesgo y cumplimiento para comprender necesidades y desafíos actuales.
* Aplicar modelos y marcos de madurez para evaluar las capacidades de Gobierno de Datos y MDM.
* Definir recomendaciones estratégicas para fortalecer la gobernanza de datos y maximizar el valor de la plataforma MDM.
* Diseñar un roadmap de evolución con iniciativas priorizadas a corto, mediano y largo plazo.

jobs.description:
Job Title

Systems Engineer – IT Salesforce Platform

Position Overview

Shaw Industries Group, Inc. is a leader in flooring and other surface solutions designed for residential housing, commercial spaces and outdoor environments. Leveraging strengths in design, innovation and operational excellence, the company takes a people-centered, customer-focused, and growth-minded approach to meet diverse market needs. It creates differentiated customer experiences through its expansive portfolio of brands: Anderson Tuftex, COREtec, Shaw Floors, Patcraft, Philadelphia Commercial, Shaw Contract, Shaw Sports Turf, Shawgrass, Southwest Greens, Watershed Geo and more. Headquartered in Dalton, Georgia, Shaw is a wholly owned subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway, Inc. with more than $6 billion in annual sales and 18,000 associates worldwide.

Position Overview

Our mission is to design, engineer, and continuously evolve enterprise-grade system solutions that enable Shaw to remain a market leader. As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will play a critical role in architecting and delivering scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions on the Salesforce platform (SFDC), the world’s leading Customer Relationship Management system.

This role goes beyond development to include solution architecture, technical leadership, and strategic alignment with business objectives. You will partner closely with Commercial Sales, Product Owners, Enterprise Architecture, and cross-functional technology teams to design future-state capabilities across Desktop and Mobile platforms.

This position offers a dynamic opportunity to lead complex initiatives, influence platform strategy, and mentor engineering talent while driving innovation within a cloud-first ecosystem.

Responsibilities

Solution Architecture & Design

Support the end-to-end design and architecture of Salesforce-based solutions aligned to enterprise standards and long-term platform strategy.

Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing technical solutions, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and integration frameworks.

Define and enforce design patterns, coding standards, and development best practices across the Salesforce ecosystem.

Technical Leadership

Serve as a technical expert and subject matter expert for Salesforce (Apex, Lightning, integrations, and platform capabilities).

Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers, fostering engineering excellence and continuous learning.

Provide oversight and governance for development activities, including code reviews, CI/CD practices, and release management.

Enterprise Integration & Data Strategy

Design and implement complex integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems (e.g., middleware, MDM, data platforms).

Ensure robust data architecture, including data quality, governance, and performance optimization.

Collaborate with integration teams to define API strategies and event-driven architecture.

Delivery & Execution

Lead the development and implementation of complex features, enhancements, and large-scale initiatives.

Allocate time across design, development, troubleshooting, and production support, with a strong emphasis on high-impact engineering work.

Drive automation, DevOps, and continuous delivery improvements within the Salesforce ecosystem.

Stakeholder Engagement

Partner with business leaders and product stakeholders to shape roadmaps and prioritize initiatives.

Communicate technical solutions and trade-offs effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Act as a trusted advisor to Sales and Business teams on technology capabilities and innovation opportunities.

Quality, Security & Compliance

Ensure solutions adhere to security, compliance, and governance standards, including MFA, data protection, and regulatory requirements.

Establish and maintain testing strategies, quality assurance practices, and performance benchmarks.

Conduct solution reviews to ensure scalability, resiliency, and operational readiness.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

3 - 5 + years of experience in enterprise application development, with deep expertise in Salesforce platform engineering preferred.

Proven experience in solution architecture, technical leadership, and large-scale system implementations.

Strong experience in Salesforce technologies: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, APIs, and platform configuration.

Experience with enterprise integrations (e.g., REST/SOAP APIs, middleware platforms such as Informatica, MuleSoft, TIBCO).

Strong understanding of data modeling, system integration patterns, and cloud architecture principles.

Familiarity with DevOps practices, including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with content management systems (e.g., Kentico or similar platforms)

Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS

Experience with monitoring, logging, or observability tools

Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processes

Experience supporting high-traffic or customer-facing websites

How We Work

Our team operates in a highly collaborative, remote-first environment. We leverage Microsoft Teams for communication and use Agile/Scrum methodologies to plan and deliver work. Our technology stack includes ASP.NET, Web APIs, and SQL Server, supporting applications hosted primarily in cloud environments.

Shaw Core Competencies

Strategic Thinking & Execution – Aligns technical solutions with long-term business strategy. Technical Leadership – Guides teams, sets standards, and drives engineering excellence. Stakeholder Influence – Builds strong partnerships and communicates effectively at all levels. Innovation & Continuous Improvement – Identifies opportunities to enhance systems and processes. Adaptability & Change Leadership – Thrives in dynamic, evolving environments. Trust & Accountability – Demonstrates ownership, transparency, and reliability.#ShawIND#LI-AK1

Work Shift

8 Hr non-rotating shift, Hrs fall to in punch day, Observed Calendar, shift starts AM

Shaw Industries is an equal opportunity employer as to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

jobs.description:
Our StoryTopDog Law is not your typical law firm.

  Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

  The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior IT Security System Administrator to own both sides of a critical mandate: keeping our systems running reliably and keeping them secure. This is a hands-on individual contributor role reporting directly to the IT Director. You'll split your time roughly equally between systems administration Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, endpoint management, identity, and SaaS platforms) and security operations (policy enforcement, access control, compliance, threat monitoring, and incident response).

You'll be the person who implements, monitors, and enforces security controls across a rapidly growing distributed workforce. The ideal candidate is technically sharp, operationally disciplined, and comfortable owning both the "does it work" and "is it safe" questions simultaneously. This role is essential for maintaining the reliability, performance, and security of our systems.

  What You Will Own

- Administer Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 environments, while facilitating the setup and full migration to Microsoft 365.

- Manage a mix of Windows and Mac endpoints using MDM tools for device enrollment, configuration, compliance, and patch management policies.

- Administer SSO, MFA, and directory integrations; maintain identity provider configuration and authentication policy.

- Administer and manage security toolsets (DLP, EDR, email security, and SIEM logs) to ensure effective threat detection and policy enforcement.

- Provide tier 2/3 support for firm-wide SaaS applications as necessary.

- Monitor, triage, and respond to security alerts across endpoint, email, identity, and cloud environments.

- Support compliance activities and internal audits; maintain evidence and documentation for security controls.

- Contribute to incident response: detection, containment, remediation, and post-incident review.

- Assist with vulnerability management, including patch cadence tracking and endpoint hygiene reporting.

- Identify gaps in security coverage or operational process and drive remediation.

- Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and best practices relevant to a remote-first professional services environment.

- Develop dashboards & reports for security metrics, compliance status, and operational health.

- Manage relationships with key vendors and service providers, ensuring service level agreements (SLAs) are met.

- Oversee security operations and ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and internal policies.

- Strategy and planning: Translate business needs into operational capability, capacity planning, DR/BCP design, cloud migration strategy, and lifecycle roadmaps.

  What You Bring

  Required:

- Minimum of 7 years experience in IT systems administration, security, operations, or a combined role.

- Proven expertise in managing modern, complex IT environments.

- Enterprise level collaboration suite administration experience (Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace)

- Security fundamentals: Identity/access controls, patching, vulnerability management, and secure configuration practices.

- Disaster recovery & backups: Design and testable DR plans, RTO/RPO understanding, and backup validation.

- Working knowledge of EDR, email security (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, anti-phishing), DLP, or SIEM tooling in an operational capacity

- Hands-on MDM/UEM experience across Mac and Windows (Jamf, Microsoft Intune, or equivalent); comfortable managing device compliance at scale

- Demonstrated experience administering SSO, MFA, and an identity provider (Okta, Google Identity, Azure AD / Entra ID, or equivalent)

- Solid understanding of security fundamentals: identity lifecycle management, endpoint hygiene, phishing defense, zero-trust principles

- Experience supporting a fully remote or distributed workforce.

- Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.

  Preferred (Nice to Have):

- Experience in a law firm, legal technology, or professional services environment.

- Exposure to compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, NIST CSF, or similar).

- Minimum of 1-3 years of experience in a leadership or management role, overseeing a team of IT professionals.

- Understanding of monitoring and logging tools (i.e. Nagios, Splunk, ELK stack).

- Scripting or automation experience (n8n, Python, Bash, Google Apps Script).

- Experience with cloud security posture management or SaaS security review.

- Demonstrated experience with disaster recovery planning and testing.

  Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

-
  Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"

-
  Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.

-
  No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.

-
  Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.

-
  Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

  What We Offer

- Base Salary: $115,000 and $135,000 per year, commensurate with experience

- Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.

- Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

  Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or being a qualified disabled veteran or qualified veteran of the Vietnam era or any other category protected by Federal or State law.

The position serves as a primary technology service owner responsible for enterprise endpoint management practices including software distribution, OS and Application patching, antivirus, application deployments, desktop virtualization, device provisioning, application testing, license management, and device configuration. These technologies support a dynamic learning environment that empowers 15,000 staff to deliver a world class education for 80,000+ students.

jobs.description:
BKF is a multi-service infrastructure consulting firm providing civil engineering, construction management, environmental, planning, and surveying services across California, the Pacific Northwest, and beyond. With offices throughout California and the Portland area, BKF has served transportation, water resources, land development, government, and federal clients for over 110 years.

At BKF, you’ll find a unique opportunity to grow your career with intention. Our culture values professional autonomy, innovation, and meaningful collaboration across offices. We are proud to be recognized with the Great Place to Work certification for the second year in a row.

The Systems Engineer – M&A Integration executes technical integration activities associated with mergers and acquisitions. The role supports the onboarding of acquired companies into BKF’s technology environment, with a primary focus on Microsoft 365, identity, collaboration services, security controls, and related cloud technologies.

Reporting to the M&A Integration Lead and receiving technical direction from the Senior M&A Technology Integration Engineer, this position performs hands-on migration, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, cutover, and hypercare activities across multiple acquisitions each year.

The ideal candidate is a technical generalist with strong Microsoft cloud and identity experience who can work independently while following established integration architecture, standards, and migration plans.

 Responsibilities

- Execute technical integration activities for acquired companies in accordance with approved architecture, migration plans, and BKF standards.

- Perform migrations into BKF’s standard platforms, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive-to-Box migrations.

- Support migrations from Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 tenants, and other source environments.

- Execute identity and access integration activities involving Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, SSO, MFA, conditional access, provisioning, and account lifecycle management.

- Support the technical dependencies associated with endpoint deployment, including identity, Intune enrollment, application access, security policies, and user authentication.

- Support Azure and related cloud-integration activities when required, including access, permissions, subscriptions, and coordination with Cloud Operations.

- Work with acquired-company IT teams, internal stakeholders, consultants, and vendors to gather technical information and complete assigned integration work.

- Follow migration runbooks, cutover plans, validation procedures, rollback plans, and hyper care processes.

- Troubleshoot technical issues during migration, cutover, and stabilization.

- Support the integration of security, compliance, endpoint-protection, and IT-management platforms.

- Document source environments, migration activities, configurations, dependencies, risks, and completion status.

- Contribute to reusable integration playbooks, standards, checklists, scripts, and automation.

- Escalate technical risks, blockers, and design decisions to the Senior M&A Technology Integration Engineer.

- Hands-on experience administering and migrating Microsoft 365 environments.

- Experience with tenant, email, collaboration-platform, or enterprise IT migrations.

- Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, identity synchronization, MFA, SSO, and conditional access.

- Experience with Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.

- Experience with Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Configuration Manager, or similar endpoint-management platforms.

- Experience supporting endpoint readiness, device enrollment, application deployment, and user onboarding.

- Familiarity with Azure administration, access, permissions, subscriptions, networking concepts, and cloud services.

- Ability to troubleshoot across identity, email, collaboration, endpoint, and cloud environments.

- Strong PowerShell, documentation, and technical-procedure skills.

- Ability to support multiple concurrent acquisition projects and planned after-hours or weekend cutovers.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to work with internal teams, consultants, vendors, and acquired-company personnel.

- Ability to work independently while escalating risks and technical decisions appropriately.

- Experience with Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migrations.

- Experience migrating Google Workspace environments to Microsoft platforms.

- Experience with BitTitan MigrationWiz, Quest, AvePoint, ShareGate, or similar migration tools.

- Experience automating Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Intune, or Azure activities with PowerShell.

- Familiarity with Microsoft Defender, Purview, Sentinel, or related security platforms.

- Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve-outs, or enterprise onboarding.

- Experience working with managed service providers, consultants, and integration vendors.

- Familiarity with ITSM, change-management, and technical project-tracking processes.

- Relevant Microsoft certifications.

Physical Demands: Must be able to regularly talk, hear and operate a computer, keyboard and mouse and occasionally lift, pull/push and carry up to 20 pounds with accommodations.

Work Conditions: Exposure to constant or intermittent sounds at a low or moderate level consistent with an office setting. Exposure to high-stress, fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment. Travel to other BKF locations and client sites may be required.

- The typical base salary range for this position is $85,000- $110,000 annualized depending upon skills, experience, education, and geographical location. This is a salary position paid biweekly.

- Competitive salaries, profit sharing, and 401k.

- Generous paid time off packages.

- 9 Paid Holidays.

- Flexible schedules.

- Education reimbursement, Paid annual dues for professional and societal organizations.

- BKF offers competitive and award-winning benefits and perks. To learn more click here.

We are looking for a Systems Engineer to join our Operations team and provide operational support for SCADA systems deployed across remote renewable energy plants worldwide. This role combines systems administration, infrastructure troubleshooting, automation, and customer interaction. You will help ensure the availability, performance, and reliability of mission-critical systems supporting renewable energy operations across multiple geographies. The ideal candidate is hands-on, highly organized, comfortable working in fast-paced environments, and passionate about automation and continuous improvement.

Key responsibilities:

- Provide operational support for SCADA infrastructures deployed in remote customer sites.
- Investigate and resolve incidents affecting servers, virtualization platforms, networking components, and databases.
- Maintain and troubleshoot Windows and Linux-based environments.
- Support virtualized infrastructures and ensure platform availability.
- Contribute to incident resolution, root cause analysis, and preventive actions.
- Automate repetitive operational tasks through scripting and tooling.
- Collaborate closely with engineering teams, customers, and other internal stakeholders to ensure service continuity and high service quality.
- Participate in operational improvement initiatives, standardization efforts, and knowledge-sharing activities.

You will be part of a global team supporting the technology that enables renewable energy assets to operate safely and efficiently. This position offers the opportunity to work with a wide range of technologies while contributing directly to the energy transition through reliable and scalable infrastructure operations.

- Competitive salary
- Medical scheme
- Commuting allowance
- Life insurance
- Pension plan
- Kindergarten allowance

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

- Strong knowledge of Windows Server administration, including Active Directory, Domain Controllers, Group Policies, and PowerShell.
- Experience supporting and troubleshooting infrastructure environments, preferably within SCADA, industrial, or critical systems environments.
- Experience with virtualization platforms, with Hyper-V as a primary technology. Exposure to VMware and Proxmox is a plus.
- Basic Linux administration knowledge and troubleshooting capabilities.
- Understanding of networking fundamentals, including switches, firewalls, TCP/IP, DNS, and connectivity troubleshooting.

jobs.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today's risks into tomorrow's opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are---with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody's is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we're advancing AI to move from insight to action---enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Extensive experience managing Windows endpoint operating systems, including security features, configuration management, and compliance controls
* Strong knowledge of vulnerability management lifecycle processes, including identification, assessment, prioritization, remediation, and validation of security risks
* Proven expertise administering Microsoft Intune to configure endpoint policies, deploy operating system updates, and maintain device compliance
* Experience using vulnerability and patch management platforms such as Qualys to analyze security findings and drive remediation activities
* Proficiency in PowerShell and/or Bash scripting to automate endpoint management, patch deployment, and remediation processes
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex endpoint, deployment, and compliance issues
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to engage technical teams and business users to support remediation efforts and improve endpoint security posture
* Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in endpoint management, vulnerability remediation, patch management, or a related systems engineering role
* Relevant certifications in endpoint management, Microsoft Intune, Qualys, PowerShell, Windows, macOS, or related technologies are preferred

**Responsibilities**

* Manage endpoint vulnerability remediation and patch management activities to maintain secure, compliant, and reliable Windows and macOS environments.
* Manage and maintain the security baseline of Windows and macOS endpoints to ensure performance, security, and compliance with organizational standards
* Develop, implement, and manage operating system and security patch deployment processes using endpoint management and vulnerability management tools
* Perform vulnerability scans, analyze remediation requirements, and implement corrective actions while minimizing disruption to end-user productivity
* Partner with Information Technology and Cyber Security teams to prioritize and remediate vulnerabilities in accordance with security policies and compliance requirements
* Monitor, track, and report on patch compliance and vulnerability remediation progress, providing regular updates to stakeholders
* Develop and enhance automation scripts to improve the efficiency, consistency, and reliability of patching and remediation activities
* Troubleshoot endpoint management, patch deployment, and policy enforcement issues to ensure successful implementation across the environment
* Communicate effectively with business users to support vulnerability remediation efforts, including targeted outreach and follow-up for non-compliant devices and participation in planned maintenance, on-call support, and security initiatives as needed

**About The Team** Our Technology Infrastructure and Endpoint Management team is responsible for maintaining secure, reliable, and compliant endpoint environments across the organization. The team works closely with Cyber Security, Information Technology, and business stakeholders to strengthen the organization's security posture through proactive vulnerability management, operating system patching, endpoint governance, and operational excellence. By joining this team, you will contribute to critical security initiatives, leverage modern automation and endpoint management technologies, and help advance the adoption of innovative solutions that improve efficiency and support responsible use of emerging technologies.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

  OT SYSTEMS ENGINEER, PROPELLANT GENERATION & INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS

 SpaceX is looking for a highly skilled and versatile OT (Operational Technology) Systems Engineer to implement and support the backend infrastructure for our next-generation controls and industrial software platforms critical to our launch, manufacturing, and commodities generation environments. This role is embedded within the mission IT organization to provide support to dedicated controls engineering organizations while leveraging adjacent IT expertise, tooling, and technologies. This role will balance support of legacy controls support systems with modernization and continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate thrives in high-stakes settings, brings a strong sense of urgency balanced with operational excellence, and combines deep OT expertise with IT technologies such as virtualization, VDI, GitOps, network-level redundancy and edge compute solutions to create streamlined and secure ICS environments.

  RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Design, deploy, and augment next-generation OT environments that support plant and launch systems across multiple sites.

- Install, configure, maintain, and support industry-standard controls software platforms as well as internally developed HMIs.

- Integrate established and emergent IT technologies to simplify management, improve security, and create scalable plant environments.

- Deploy and maintain development, test, and staging environments to enable controlled, systematic change introduction.

- Provide direct support during launch, test, and production campaigns.

- Perform systems/software upgrades and maintenance between critical operations (including evenings and weekends as needed).

- Proactively monitor services and respond rapidly to incidents to maintain high availability and performance.

- Leverage automation tools and contribute to infrastructure-as-code and broader DevOps initiatives with a focus on ICS environments.

- Work with internal controls engineers to iterate on simulation and emulation environment to enhance test coverage and augment change control processes.

- Write and maintain standards, architectures, best practices, and documentation (including system overviews, design drawings, and operational procedures), with emphasis on highly reliable and secure industrial environments, especially at data boundaries.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (IT, security, controls, and operations) as well as external customers and integrators to design robust OT architectures and resolve technical issues.

- Ensure OT systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g., Purdue Model, IEC 62443).

  BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or other STEM discipline and 3+ years of professional experience in OT systems engineering or industrial control systems administration; OR 5+ years of professional experience in OT systems engineering or industrial control systems administration in lieu of a degree.

- Experience with multiple industry standard controls software platforms and tools.

- Experience designing, deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting OT environments in high-reliability settings.

  PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Demonstrated project management experience leading multiple concurrent projects from planning through execution and closeout, including scope definition, scheduling, resource coordination, and stakeholder communication across cross-functional engineering and operations teams.

- Experience supporting real-time systems, industrial control networks, or operational technology (OT) environments in aerospace, defense, energy, or similar high-reliability industries.

- Experience designing architectures that incorporate hyperconverged, rugged industrial edge, and distributed compute technologies.

- Working knowledge of industrial protocols, controls networks, and OT cybersecurity best practices.

- Proficiency in scripting (Bash/PowerShell/Python) and automation frameworks (Puppet, Terraform, Ansible, etc.).

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and DevOps concepts/tools.

- Familiarity with Active Directory, multi-platform authentication, and identity environments in OT contexts.

- System administration experience managing Windows and Linux servers, rudimentary database administration exposure, and storage/backup experience.

- Network administration experience and understanding of the OSI model, especially Layer 1/2/3 considerations as they apply to industrial and controls networks.

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, and management in both formal and informal situations.

  ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Ability to pass DoD background check for launch site access.

- Willingness to participate in an after-hours on-call rotation and work extended hours or weekends as necessary.

- Willingness to travel (up to 20%, including flying to other sites worldwide) and potential time at sea supporting marine systems.

- Ability to lift 30 lbs.

- Ability to work at heights.

- Ability to drive (active valid driver's license).

 ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here .

jobs.title: Senior Systems Administrator, Classified IT
jobs.summary: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the...
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Systems Administrator to independently administer, troubleshoot, maintain, and secure enterprise Windows and Linux systems in classified environments. Senior Systems Administrators are expected to perform nearly all routine and advanced administration with little to no assistance, serve as a technical escalation point, mentor other administrators, and lead operational work. Assistance should generally be limited to unfamiliar technologies, high-risk changes, architecture decisions, or issues requiring specialized engineering expertise.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Independently administer and troubleshoot Windows Server/desktop and Linux systems, Active Directory, enterprise authentication, permissions, services, applications, and domain-connected systems.

- Administer and troubleshoot enterprise Windows services including Group Policy (GPO), WSUS/patch management, DNS, DHCP, file services, certificates/PKI dependencies, and related system components.

- Create, modify, test, validate, and troubleshoot GPOs, including inheritance, precedence, OU targeting, security filtering, gpresult, and Resultant Set of Policy (RSoP).

- Administer WSUS or equivalent patching solutions, including synchronization, targeting, approvals, deployment status, failed updates, reporting, and patch-compliance remediation.

- Interpret DISA STIG requirements; use applicable STIG tools/checklists; implement and validate remediations, including GPO-based security configurations; document findings; and troubleshoot operational impacts.

- Independently administer and troubleshoot existing VMware, Hyper-V, or similar virtualization environments and virtual machines.

- Troubleshoot complex issues across operating systems, identity, applications, virtualization, storage, certificates, and network dependencies using logs and diagnostic tooling.

- Use PowerShell, Bash, and other scripting/automation methods for administration, bulk changes, data collection, troubleshooting, and repeatable tasks.

- Research and resolve unfamiliar issues using vendor documentation, technical references, logs, DISA guidance, and available tooling before requiring escalation.

- Plan and lead system changes, maintenance, upgrades, and migrations with implementation, validation, rollback, documentation, and change-control considerations.

- Serve as an escalation point and mentor for Junior Systems Administrators and Systems Administrators; provide peer review and technical guidance.

- Identify recurring problems, technical debt, security/configuration gaps, and process deficiencies and lead practical improvements within established architecture.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Active TS/SCI security clearance.

- Active CompTIA Security+ certification or higher DoD 8140/8570-aligned certification.

- Strong hands-on Windows and Linux systems administration experience with demonstrated ability to work independently.

- Hands-on experience with Active Directory, GPO administration/troubleshooting, enterprise patch management/WSUS, and domain-connected systems.

- Experience interpreting and remediating DISA STIG findings within secure or regulated environments.

- Working knowledge of VMware, Hyper-V, or comparable virtualization technologies.

- Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, subnetting, and network troubleshooting.

- Experience with PowerShell, Bash, or similar administrative scripting.

- Demonstrated ability to independently research and resolve complex technical problems, lead technical work, mentor others, and produce effective documentation.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Advanced Microsoft, Linux, VMware, networking, or cybersecurity certifications.

- Experience supporting engineering, manufacturing, or specialized technical applications.

- Experience leading infrastructure upgrades, migrations, maintenance events, or cross-functional technical efforts.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

A successful Senior Systems Administrator can be given an existing environment or system and independently run, secure, maintain, and troubleshoot it. They do not need every answer memorized, but are expected to research unfamiliar problems and drive them to resolution with limited assistance. Systems Engineering engagement is primarily required when work crosses into new architecture, major redesign, specialized engineering, or high-risk technical decisions.

US Salary Range

 $146,000 - $194,000 USD

 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

 Benefits

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

 No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

  - Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

  - Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 Data Privacy

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
Job Description
Would you enjoy improving stability and safety of one of the largest global networks?
Would you enjoy doing hands-on network operations work on a global scale to improve our operational efficiency?
Join our critical Network Infrastructure Engineering team
Our Network Infrastructure Engineering Team takes ownership of planning, building, maintaining and operating our global platform. We design, develop, deploy, and maintain critical technologies. This includes the hardware, software, and network infrastructure that provide the technical underpinnings for all of Akamai's products. Our team ensures consistent availability and performance for our customers.
Partner with the best
As a Network Infrastructure Engineer, you will design and deploy secure server clusters, diagnose hardware and network connectivity problems, facilitate critical infrastructure repairs, and manage Akamai's hardware assets. You will be coordinating efforts among teams of locally-based field technicians and work closely with external partners and internal cross-functional teams to ensure the service we deliver is exceptional.
As a Network Infrastructure Engineer, you will be responsible for:
Partnering across teams to ensure the reliability, scalability and usability of our products and services
Traveling regularly to datacenters to receive, deliver, install, and maintain hardware assets, ensuring optimal functionality and compliance with standards
Diagnosing, troubleshooting, and monitoring network connectivity issues at Layer 1, 2 and 3.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams during execution to provide end-to-end support for deployment projects, network installations, and maintenance
Working closely with field technicians, ISPs and Akamai partners, and 3rd party client vendors for installation, maintenance, and fulfillment of Akamai Network Infrastructure
Monitoring, triage, and resolution of incoming maintenance tickets, ensuring adherence to SLA targets
Maintaining and exceeding high SLA targets, ensuring robust system uptime and performance
Lifting at least 50 pounds of equipment
Do What You Love
To be successful in this role you will:
Have 2 years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field or its equivalent
Have experience with Datacenter operations and protocols, network technologies, Security concepts, Unix/Linux internals, distributed systems, and systems design
Possess solid organizational skills with proven experience in scheduling and operational planning
Demonstrate an ability to work efficiently under strict time constraints, adhering to all procedural guidelines
Be willing to travel up to 60% domestically within the U.S.
Be required to undergo or possess and maintain a successfully adjudicated USG Tier 3 background investigation
About Us
At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.
Our Focus Is Simple
Cloud and Edge:
 Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security
: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery
: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI
: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.
At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.
Benefits at Akamai:
 We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.
FlexBase adapts to your job's needs
Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.
We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.
Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!
Compensation
Akamai is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For US based candidates only - the base salary for this position ranges from $65,700 - $118,300/year; a candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and location. Compensation for candidates outside the US will vary. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of annual bonus or incentives, equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Akamai provides industry-leading benefits including healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, vacation (in the form of PTO), sick time, family friendly benefits including parental leave and an employee assistance program including a focus on mental and financial wellness; Eligibility requirements apply.

jobs.description:
**Humanizando la Tecnología.**

Somos una gran empresa con alma de start-up. Nos organizamos por unidades de conocimiento expertas que colaboran entre sí.

Por ello buscamos **personas inquietas,** que les **motiven los retos y con ganas de crecer personal y profesionalmente** , que se unan a nuestro equipo para tener un **impacto positivo** en el mundo a través de la tecnología.

**¿TE APUNTAS AL RETO?**

Como **Técnico de Sistemas N2 GNU/Linux y Gestión de Dispositivos (UEM)**formarás parte de nuestro equipo en el Centro de Soporte donde realizarmos resolución de incidencias especializadas en dar respuesta rápida a las peticiones de servicio relacionadas con Microsoft, Azure y entornos on premise.

Nuestro Centro de Soporte tiene establecida una gestión del talento enfocada en potenciar el bienestar y el rendimiento del equipo.

**¿QUÉ HARÁS EN TU DÍA A DÍA?**

Tus funciones principales serán:

* Gestionar y resolver incidencias y peticiones de segundo nivel sobre entornos Linux e infraestructuras críticas, garantizando la continuidad del servicio.
* Analizar, diagnosticar e implementar soluciones técnicas, aplicando las correcciones necesarias a través de las herramientas y procedimientos definidos en el proyecto.
* Colaborar con diferentes equipos técnicos en la resolución de incidencias complejas, problemas recurrentes y situaciones de alta criticidad.
* Realizar tareas de administración, mantenimiento y mejora continua de las plataformas, asegurando su estabilidad, rendimiento y disponibilidad.
* Monitorizar el estado de los sistemas, identificando de forma proactiva posibles riesgos o incidencias antes de que impacten en el servicio.
* Participar en el análisis, seguimiento y escalado de incidencias, contribuyendo a la optimización de procesos y a la evolución de la infraestructura.

**¿QUÉ ESPERAMOS DE TI?**

* Ciclo formativo de grado superior en Administración de Sistemas Informáticos.
* Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en soporte técnico de segundo nivel.
* Experiencia demostrable en entornos GNU/Linux, herramientas UEM y gestión centralizada de dispositivos.
* Capacidad de resolución de incidencias, peticiones y cambios en entornos corporativos
* Idiomas:
* Euskera nivel C1 (acreditado)
* Inglés nivel B2 (acreditado)

**¿QUE ENCONTRARÁS EN SEIDOR?**

* **Un equipo diverso**. Respetamos las diferencias que nos hacen más humanos. 💜
* **Compañerismo**. Trabajamos en equipo y aprendemos los unos de los otros.
* **Flexibilidad y conciliación**. El teletrabajo está en nuestro ADN. Promovemos la flexibilidad horaria, y tenemos jornada intensiva los viernes y los meses de julio y agosto. 🙌
* **Aprendizaje continuo**. Formaciones en idiomas, técnicas, certificaciones, etc.
* **Carrera profesional individualizada**, para que seas tú quien decide hasta dónde quieres llegar. 🚀
* **Autonomía** y posibilidad de proponer y promover nuevas oportunidades.
* **Programa de retribución flexible.**Tickets guardería, restaurante, transporte, y seguro médico.
* **Descuentos exclusivos y condiciones especiales** en tecnología, ocio, viajes, etc. 🌟
* Podrás formar parte de**iniciativas solidarias y relacionadas con el medio ambiente**.
* Si tienes inquietudes internacionales,**estamos en 45 países**. 🌍

**¡Únete a nuestro equipo y ayúdanos a humanizar el mundo a través de la tecnología!**

**Role:** Microsoft 365 Intune Architect / SME

**Location:** Mexico

**Experience:**10+ years overall IT experience with 5+ years of Microsoft Intune Architecture experience

**Job Type:** FTE

**Mandatory 3 Skills:** Microsoft Intune \| Windows Autopilot \| Microsoft Entra ID

**About Position**

The Microsoft 365 Intune Architect is responsible for designing, governing, and implementing enterprise endpoint management solutions using Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Defender, Conditional Access, and Microsoft 365 services. The role provides technical leadership, architecture governance, security best practices, migration strategy, and operational excellence for modern device management.

**What You'll Do**

* Design enterprise-scale Microsoft Intune architecture across Windows 10/11, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, Android Enterprise, and Windows 365 Cloud PCs.
* Define endpoint management strategy, governance frameworks, and technology roadmaps.
* Create High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs), solution architectures, and implementation plans.
* Design hybrid and cloud-native endpoint management solutions.
* Design and implement Microsoft Entra ID integration, Conditional Access, MFA, and Zero Trust frameworks.
* Define compliance and security baselines aligned with CIS and NIST best practices.
* Design and govern Windows Autopilot, Apple Business Manager (ABM), ADE, and Android Enterprise deployment strategies.
* Establish enterprise application management standards including Win32 packaging and Microsoft 365 Apps deployment.
* Establish RBAC models, Scope Tags strategy, PIM, and privileged access models.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, governance, and operational support frameworks.
* Build PowerShell automation solutions and utilize Microsoft Graph API integrations.
* Lead large-scale enterprise migration, merger, separation, and MDM/MAM transformation initiatives.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* 10+ years of overall IT experience with at least 5 years specializing in Microsoft Intune Architecture.
* Expert-level experience with Microsoft Intune Administration.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and Zero Trust architecture.
* Hands-on experience with Windows Autopilot design, deployment, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.
* Experience managing Apple Business Manager (ABM), ADE, Android Enterprise, and multi-platform device management.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Graph API, PowerShell automation, PKI, SCEP, PKCS certificates, and Microsoft Sentinel integration.
* Experience managing compliance policies, security baselines, update rings, feature updates, and App Protection Policies.
* Ability to troubleshoot enrollment failures, ESP issues, policy conflicts, certificate issues, Conditional Access failures, and co-management challenges.
* Proven experience supporting large enterprise migrations, mergers \& acquisitions (M\&A), and device transformation programs.
* Microsoft certifications such as Endpoint Administrator Associate, Enterprise Administrator Expert, Cybersecurity Architect Expert, or Identity and Access Administrator Associate are preferred.

**Success Measures**

* Successfully delivers and governs enterprise-scale endpoint management architectures.
* Implements secure, compliant, and scalable Microsoft Intune and Entra ID environments aligned with Zero Trust principles.
* Drives successful migration, MDM/MAM transformation, merger, and separation initiatives for large enterprises.
* Ensures operational excellence through automation, governance, security controls, and compliance monitoring.
* Provides technical leadership and mentorship while maintaining high standards for endpoint security and administration.

**Benefits:**

* 30 days Christmas bonus (Aguinaldo)
* 13% Saving fund, capped to the law limit.
* 12% Grocery coupons, capped to the law limit.
* 12 vacation days first year + 6 floating days -- number of vacation days increase according to seniority.

* Free courses available at internal platforms.

* Minor medical insurance (Spouse and children Included)
* Dental Insurance (Spouse and children Included)
* Visual Insurance (Spouse and children Included)
* Life insurance.
* Preferential price on car insurance (car fleet).

* Accelerate growth, both professionally and personally
* Impact the world in powerful, positive ways, using the latest technologies

jobs.title: Senior Lead Engineer, Cybersecurity, Endpoint Security
